products.description:
ASRock A620M-HDV/M.2 AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The ASRock A620M-HDV/M.2 AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard is designed for maximum performance with support for AMD Socket AM5 Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Processors. This motherboard features a robust 4+1+1 Power Phase with Dr.MOS, dual DDR5 DIMM slots supporting up to 6400+ (OC), and integrated AMD RDNA 2 Graphics. It offers versatile connectivity with 1 PCIe 4.0 x16, 2 PCIe 3.0 x1 slots, and an M.2 Key E slot for WiFi. The storage options include 1 Hyper M.2 (PCIe Gen4x4), 1 M.2 (PCIe Gen3x2), and 2 SATA3 connectors, ensuring fast data transfer and ample space. The ASRock A620M-HDV/M.2 AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard also provides a variety of USB ports, including 5 USB 3.2 Gen1 ports (2 rear, 1 rear Type-C, 2 front), and 6 USB 2.0 ports for extensive peripheral support. Audio enthusiasts will appreciate the Realtek ALC897 7.1 CH HD Audio Codec with Nahimic Audio. For network connectivity, it features Realtek Gigabit LAN. Additional unique features include a BIOS Flashback Button for easy BIOS updates and ASRock's Auto Driver Installer. The ASRock A620M-HDV/M.2 AM5 boasts a sleek Micro ATX form factor with dimensions of 9.6-in x 8.9-in and a 2oz Copper PCB for durability. It supports dual channel DDR5 memory up to 128GB, with XMP and EXTended Profiles for Overclocking (EXPO). This motherboard also offers high-quality video output with HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4, both supporting up to 4K 120Hz resolution. With comprehensive software support including ASRock Motherboard Utility (A-Tuning) and Instant Flash, this ASRock A620M-HDV/M.2 AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard is the ideal choice for users seeking top-tier performance, durability, and easy updates, compatible with Windows 10 and 11 64-bit operating systems.

products.description:
ASRock B650 PG Lightning AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard

The ASRock B650 PG Lightning Motherboard supports AMD's Ryzen 8000 & 7000-series processors with up to 16 Zen 4 cores as well as dual-channel DDR5 memory, Maximum Memory Capacity of up to 128GB. It features a 14+2+1 Power Phase, Dr.MOS design that features the latest SPS (Smart Power Stage) technology. The 8 Layer PCB provides stable signal traces and power shapes delivering lower temperature and higher energy efficiency, ensuring a reliable and long-lasting system while delivering ultimate performance without any compromise. The ASRock B650 PG Lightning Motherboard features Nahimic Audio. Whether you are using headphones, a headset, external or internal speakers, via USB, Wi-Fi, analog output, or even HDMI, Nahimic Audio offers you the most engaging listening experience, vibrant and rich with details. The Powerful algorithms to ensure the best noise-free conversation, giving a constant vocal level no matter the distance from your mic. The Nahimic audio engine dynamically clears the sound and removes interference noise and lowers the voice variation. The result is better comprehension and less fatigue. The ASRock B650 PG Lightning Motherboard offers the ultimate gaming experience. The Sound Tracker is a visual indicator that points out the directions from which predominant sounds are coming. Each sound is properly positioned at 360° on the radar for full immersion during the game. The ASRock B650 PG Lightning Motherboard comes with built-in RGB illumination, it also features onboard RGB headers and an addressable RGB header that allow the motherboard to be connected to compatible LED devices such as strips, CPU fans, coolers, chassis, and so on. The Blazing M.2 accommodates the latest PCI Express 5.0 standard to perform twice the bandwidth compared to the previous generation, with a breathtaking 128GB/s transfer speed, it is ready to unleash the full potential of future ultrafast SSDs. The extra large aluminum alloy M.2 heatsink effectively improves heat dissipation to keep those high-speed M.2 SSDs as cool as possible, it is able to give better stability while maintaining top performance. The enhanced M.2 heatsink with an anti-drop screw design makes sure installation process more easily. This motherboard has a pair of onboard Type-A and Type-C USB 3.2 Gen2 ports built on the rear i/o for supporting next-generation USB 3.2 Gen2 devices and delivering up to 10 Gbps data transfer rates. The ASRock B650 PG Lightning Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

products.description:
ASRock B650M PG Riptide AMD AM5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The ASRock B650M PG Riptide Motherboard supports AMD's Ryzen 8000 & 7000-series processors with up to 16 Zen 4 cores as well as dual-channel DDR5 memory, Maximum Memory Capacity of up to 128GB. It features a 12+2+1 Power Phase, Dr.MOS design that features the latest SPS (Smart Power Stage) technology. The ASRock B650M PG Riptide features Nahimic Audio. Whether you are using headphones, a headset, external or internal speakers, via USB, Wi-Fi, analog output, or even HDMI, Nahimic Audio offers you the most engaging listening experience, vibrant and rich with details. The Powerful algorithms to ensure the best noise-free conversation, giving a constant vocal level no matter the distance from your mic. The Nahimic audio engine dynamically clears the sound and removes interference noise and lowers the voice variation. The result is better comprehension and less fatigue. The ASRock B650M PG Riptide offers the ultimate gaming experience. The Sound Tracker is a visual indicator that points out the directions from which predominant sounds are coming. Each sound is properly positioned at 360° on the radar for full immersion during the game. The Lightning Gaming Ports are aimed at die-hard gamers and enthusiasts! Lightning Gaming Ports are sourced from two different controller interfaces that assist gamers in connecting the high-speed mice/keyboard with the lower jitter and latency. The ASRock B650M PG Riptide comes with built-in RGB illumination, it also features onboard RGB headers and an addressable RGB header that allow the motherboard to be connected to compatible LED devices such as strips, CPU fans, coolers, chassis, and so on. The Blazing M.2 accommodates the latest PCI Express 5.0 standard to perform twice the bandwidth compared to the previous generation, with a breathtaking 128GB/s transfer speed, it is ready to unleash the full potential of future ultrafast SSDs. The extra large aluminum alloy M.2 heatsink effectively improves heat dissipation to keep those high-speed M.2 SSDs as cool as possible, it is able to give better stability while maintaining top performance. The enhanced M.2 heatsink with an anti-drop screw design makes sure installation process more easily. This motherboard has a pair of onboard Type-A and Type-C USB 3.2 Gen2 ports built on the rear i/o for supporting next-generation USB 3.2 Gen2 devices and delivering up to 10 Gbps data transfer rates. The ASRock B650M PG Riptide comes with 3 years of warranty.

products.description:
ASRock B650M PG Riptide WiFi AMD AM5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The ASRock B650M PG Riptide WiFi Motherboard supports AMD's Ryzen 8000 & 7000-series processors with up to 16 Zen 4 cores as well as dual-channel DDR5 memory, Maximum Memory Capacity of up to 128GB. It features a 12+2+1 Power Phase, Dr.MOS design that features the latest SPS (Smart Power Stage) technology. The ASRock B650M PG Riptide WiFi features Nahimic Audio. Whether you are using headphones, a headset, external or internal speakers, via USB, Wi-Fi, analog output, or even HDMI, Nahimic Audio offers you the most engaging listening experience, vibrant and rich with details. The Powerful algorithms to ensure the best noise-free conversation, giving a constant vocal level no matter the distance from your mic. The Nahimic audio engine dynamically clears the sound and removes interference noise and lowers the voice variation. The result is better comprehension and less fatigue. The ASRock B650M PG Riptide WiFi offers the ultimate gaming experience. The Sound Tracker is a visual indicator that points out the directions from which predominant sounds are coming. Each sound is properly positioned at 360° on the radar for full immersion during the game. WiFi 6E technology has extended to the whole new 6GHz spectrum band, providing more WiFi capability and giving even better and faster internet traffic. In addition, to deliver higher speeds, the WiFi 6E also enhances the lower latency and supports service levels that are equivalent to 5G networks. The Lightning Gaming Ports are aimed at die-hard gamers and enthusiasts! Lightning Gaming Ports are sourced from two different controller interfaces that assist gamers in connecting the high-speed mice/keyboard with the lower jitter and latency. The ASRock B650M PG Riptide WiFi comes with built-in RGB illumination, it also features onboard RGB headers and an addressable RGB header that allow the motherboard to be connected to compatible LED devices such as strips, CPU fans, coolers, chassis, and so on. The Blazing M.2 accommodates the latest PCI Express 5.0 standard to perform twice the bandwidth compared to the previous generation, with a breathtaking 128GB/s transfer speed, it is ready to unleash the full potential of future ultrafast SSDs. The extra large aluminum alloy M.2 heatsink effectively improves heat dissipation to keep those high-speed M.2 SSDs as cool as possible, it is able to give better stability while maintaining top performance. The enhanced M.2 heatsink with an anti-drop screw design makes sure installation process more easily. This motherboard has a pair of onboard Type-A and Type-C USB 3.2 Gen2 ports built on the rear i/o for supporting next-generation USB 3.2 Gen2 devices and delivering up to 10 Gbps data transfer rates. The ASRock B650M PG Riptide WiFi comes with 3 years of warranty.

products.description:
ASRock B650M Pro RS WiFi AM5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The ASRock B650M Pro RS WiFi AM5 Micro ATX Motherboard is a high-performance motherboard that supports AMD Socket AM5 Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors. It is equipped with an 8+2+1 Power Phase VRM design, featuring Dr.MOS technology for stable and efficient power delivery, making it ideal for demanding tasks like gaming and content creation. The motherboard supports up to four DDR5 DIMMs in dual-channel mode, with speeds reaching up to 7200+ MHz when overclocked, ensuring exceptional memory performance. It offers 1 PCIe 4.0 x16 slot and 1 PCIe 3.0 x16 slot, allowing for flexible graphics cards and peripheral installations. The board also provides versatile display options through HDMI and DisplayPort outputs. On the audio front, it includes the Realtek ALC897 7.1 Channel HD Audio Codec and Nahimic Audio, delivering an immersive sound experience. Storage options are plentiful with 4 SATA3 ports, a Blazing M.2 slot (PCIe Gen5 x4), a Hyper M.2 slot (PCIe Gen4 x4), and an additional M.2 slot (PCIe Gen4 x2), catering to both high-speed NVMe SSDs and traditional SATA drives. Connectivity is robust with a Dragon 2.5G LAN for fast wired networking, along with 802.11ax Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth for seamless wireless connections. The motherboard also features a variety of USB ports, including 1 USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A and Type-C port at the rear, a USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-C port at the front, and 6 USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-A ports (2 rear, 4 front), providing ample options for connecting peripherals. Overall, the ASRock B650M Pro RS WiFi is a feature-rich motherboard that delivers excellent performance, making it a strong choice for building a high-end PC.

products.description:
ASRock B840M-HVS AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard

The ASRock B840M-HVS AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard is built for AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series processors. This offers DDR5 memory support, PCIe 4.0 expansion, and advanced storage options. With features like BIOS Flashback, Auto Driver Installer, and Post Status Checker, the ASRock B840M-HVS makes updates and troubleshooting simple. Compact in micro-ATX form, it delivers stability, productivity, and flexibility for modern PC builds.

Memory and Performance

The ASRock B840M-HVS supports dual-channel DDR5 memory up to 6800+(OC) with a maximum capacity of 128GB. It includes XMP and EXPO profiles for overclocking. Integrated AMD RDNA graphics provide HDMI 2.1 output up to 4K 120Hz and D-Sub up to Full HD, making this ASRock DDR5 Motherboard suitable for gaming and productivity.

Expansion and Storage

This ASRock motherboard offers one PCIe 4.0 x16 slot, two PCIe 3.0 x1 slots, and an M.2 socket for WiFi modules. Storage options include one Hyper M.2 Gen4x4 slot, one Ultra M.2 Gen3x4/SATA slot, and two SATA3 connectors. RAID 0, 1, and 10 are supported for M.2 NVMe devices, making the ASRock B840M-HVS AMD AM5 Motherboard versatile for different setups.

Connectivity and I/O

Rear I/O includes HDMI, D-Sub, four USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-A ports, four USB 2.0 ports, Gigabit LAN, HD audio jacks, and a BIOS Flashback button. Internal headers support USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-C, RGB, and addressable LED strips. With Realtek ALC897 7.1 HD audio and RTL8111H Gigabit LAN, this ASRock AM5 Motherboard ensures reliable connectivity and multimedia performance.

Durability and Design

Built with a 4+1+1 power phase design and Dr.MOS for Vcore, the ASRock B840M-HVS provides stable power delivery. It features a 2oz copper PCB, smart fan speed control, and multiple chassis/water pump fan connectors. EZ update and troubleshooting tools like BIOS Flashback and Post Status Checker make maintenance straightforward.

Form Factor and Accessories

The ASRock B840M-HVS comes in a micro-ATX form factor (24.4 × 22.9 cm) with VESA mounting support. Accessories include an I/O shield, SATA cables, and an M.2 screw. Compatible with Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), this ASRock B840M-HVS AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard is ready for modern PC builds.

products.name: ASRock B850 Pro-A WiFi AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard
products.description:
ASRock B850 Pro-A WiFi AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The ASRock B850 Pro-A WiFi AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard is a powerful and future-ready platform built to support AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series processors on the Socket AM5 architecture. This ASRock B850 Pro-A WiFi AM5 DDR5 Motherboard is equipped with the AMD B850 chipset and features an advanced 8-layer ATX PCB, making it ideal for high-performance gaming and productivity. With support for up to 256GB of DDR5 RAM across 4 DIMM slots, and memory speeds reaching 8000+ MHz (OC), it delivers exceptional multitasking and overclocking potential. The ASRock B850 Pro-A WiFi Motherboard includes a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot, a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot, and a Key-E M.2 slot for Wi-Fi modules, ensuring top-tier expansion and GPU support. Its storage interface features four M.2 slots—including Blazing Gen5x4, Hyper Gen4x4, and Ultra Gen3x4—plus four SATA3 ports, with full RAID support for both NVMe and SATA drives. For graphics, this motherboard supports integrated AMD RDNA graphics (CPU-dependent) with HDMI 2.1 output at 4K 120Hz and a USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-C port that supports DP 1.4 HBR3 for up to 4K 60Hz via DisplayPort Alt Mode. Network performance is enhanced with 2.5G Dragon RTL8125BG LAN and Wi-Fi 6E (802.11axe), along with Bluetooth 5.2, ensuring blazing-fast wireless connectivity (Wi-Fi 6E is supported only on Windows 11 with a 6GHz-capable router). Rear I/O options on the ASRock B850 Pro-A WiFi include dual antenna ports, HDMI, USB Type-C (Gen2 and Gen1 with DP-alt), USB 3.2 Gen1, USB 2.0, LAN, and HD audio jacks. The board also features a BIOS Flashback button, ASRock Post Status Checker, and support for utilities like Polychrome SYNC, A-Tuning, and Dragon 2.5G LAN software. Engineered with a 14+2+1 phase 80A Dr.MOS power design, PCIe Gen5 lanes for both GPU and SSDs, and extensive thermal and durability enhancements, the ASRock B850 Pro-A WiFi AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard offers unmatched performance, connectivity, and reliability for modern AM5 desktop builds.

The ASRock B850M Pro-A WiFi AM5 DDR5 mATX Motherboard is designed for maximum productivity, durability, and next-generation performance, making it an ideal choice for gamers, creators, and professionals that want powerful features in a small micro ATX package. Supporting AMD Socket AM5 Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors with the AMD B850 chipset, it provides cutting-edge performance with PCIe Gen5 graphics and M.2 storage support, enabling rapid data transmission and future-proof compatibility. The ASRock B850M Pro-A WiFi AM5 DDR5 mATX Motherboard supports AMD RDNA graphics and includes HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 with resolutions of up to 4K 120Hz, HDR, and HDCP 2.3. The ASRock B850M Pro-A WiFi AM5 DDR5 mATX Motherboard offers expansion slots, including a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot with reinforced 15μ gold contacts and a PCIe 4.0 x4 slot. Rear I/O features HDMI, DisplayPort, two antenna ports, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A and Type-C, USB 3.2 Gen1, USB 2.0, LAN, BIOS Flashback, and HD audio jacks. Other notable features include BIOS Flashback, ASRock Auto Driver Installer, Post Status Checker, RGB and addressable LED headers, smart fan speed control, and ASRock Polychrome SYNC. Powered by the AMD B850 chipset and supporting AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors on the latest AM5 socket, this board brings superior processing power and next-gen features in a compact 9.6" x 9.6" form factor. The ASRock B850M STEEL LEGEND WIFI DDR5 ATX Motherboard offers exceptional memory performance with four DDR5 DIMM slots, supporting up to 256GB of ECC/non-ECC un-buffered memory with overclocking potential beyond 8000MHz (OC), and is compatible with XMP and EXPO memory profiles for advanced tuning. This ASRock B850M STEEL LEGEND WIFI Motherboard stands out with its 2.5G Dragon RTL8125BG LAN featuring smart bandwidth control and a visual UI for optimized gaming, streaming, or browsing. It’s further equipped with next-gen Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be 2x2), supporting tri-band (2.4GHz/5GHz/6GHz) connectivity, MU-MIMO, 160MHz bandwidth, and Bluetooth 5.4 for seamless wireless experiences. Rear I/O options include USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-C and Type-A, USB 3.2 Gen1, USB 2.0, and HD Audio jacks powered by a Realtek ALC1220 7.1CH codec enhanced with Nahimic Audio, impedance sensing, and individually layered PCB for left/right audio channels. ASRock B850M-X R2.0 WiFi AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard

The ASRock B850M-X R2.0 WiFi AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard is designed for AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series processors, offering PCIe Gen5 support, DDR5 memory compatibility, and ultrafast connectivity. With built-in Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5G LAN, and advanced storage options, the ASRock B850M-X R2.0 WiFi delivers strong performance for gaming and productivity. Features like BIOS Flashback, Auto Driver Installer, and Post Status Checker make updates and troubleshooting simple, while its micro-ATX form factor ensures flexibility for compact builds.

Memory and Performance

The ASRock B850M-X R2.0 WiFi supports dual-channel DDR5 memory up to 8200+(OC) with a maximum capacity of 128GB. It includes XMP and EXPO profiles for overclocking. Integrated AMD RDNA graphics provide HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 outputs up to 4K 120Hz, making this ASRock DDR5 Motherboard suitable for gaming, streaming, and productivity.

Expansion and Storage

This motherboard offers one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot, one PCIe 4.0 x1 slot, and one PCIe 4.0 x16 slot (x4 mode). Storage options include one Blazing M.2 Gen5x4 slot, one Hyper M.2 Gen4x4 slot, and four SATA3 connectors. RAID 0, 1, and 10 are supported for both SATA and M.2 NVMe devices, making the ASRock B850M-X R2.0 WiFi AMD AM5 Motherboard versatile for modern builds.

Connectivity and I/O

Rear I/O includes HDMI, DisplayPort, USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-C, three USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-A ports, two USB 2.0 ports, Gigabit LAN, Wi-Fi antenna ports, HD audio jacks, and a BIOS Flashback button. Internal headers support RGB and addressable LED strips, multiple fan connectors, and USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-C. With Realtek ALC897 7.1 HD audio and Nahimic Audio, this ASRock AM5 Motherboard ensures immersive sound and reliable connectivity.

Durability and Design

Built with a 6+1+1 power phase design and Dr.MOS for VCore, the ASRock B850M-X R2.0 WiFi provides stable power delivery. It features smart fan speed control, multiple chassis/water pump connectors, and a 2oz copper PCB for durability. EZ update and troubleshooting tools like BIOS Flashback and Post Status Checker make maintenance straightforward.

Form Factor and Accessories

The ASRock B850M-X R2.0 WiFi comes in a micro-ATX form factor. Accessories include an I/O shield, SATA cables, and Wi-Fi antennas. Compatible with Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), this ASRock B850M-X R2.0 WiFi AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard is ready for modern PC builds.

products.description:
ASRock X870E Nova WiFi AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The ASRock X870E Nova WiFi AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard is a next-generation platform engineered for high-performance gaming, content creation, and productivity. Designed to support AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series processors on the AM5 socket, this advanced ASRock X870E Nova WiFi Motherboard delivers top-tier processing power and efficiency. Built on the robust AMD X870E chipset, it features a durable 8-layer, 2oz copper PCB and a 20+2+1 power phase design with 110A SPS for VCore+SOC, complemented by an enlarged heatsink armor for superior thermal performance. The ASRock X870E Nova WiFi AM5 DDR5 Motherboard supports up to 256GB of ultra-fast DDR5 memory (8200+ MHz OC) via four DIMM slots, with full support for XMP and EXPO profiles, making it ideal for enthusiasts and overclockers. Integrated graphics via AMD RDNA are supported through HDMI 2.1 (4K @120Hz) and dual USB4 Type-C ports (up to 8K @30Hz, HDCP 2.3), delivering exceptional visual output. Storage performance is unmatched, with one PCIe Gen5x4 M.2 slot, three PCIe Gen4x4 Hyper M.2 slots, one SATA/PCIe Gen3x2 M.2 slot, and four SATA3 ports (including two via ASMedia ASM1061), along with RAID 0/1/10 support. Expansion is equally powerful, with a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for graphics and additional PCIe 3.0 slots for peripherals. The ASRock X870E Nova WiFi also offers top-tier connectivity including 5 Gigabit LAN (Realtek RTL8126), blazing-fast Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be tri-band), Bluetooth 5.4, and MU-MIMO support for seamless online experiences. Rear I/O is loaded with 2x USB4 Type-C (40 Gb/s), 5x USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A, 3x USB 3.2 Gen1, HDMI 2.1, SPDIF, gold-plated audio jacks, and buttons for BIOS Flashback and Clear CMOS. The Realtek ALC4082 codec ensures high-definition 7.1 channel audio. Premium features such as Lightning Gaming Ports, Ultra USB Power, 20K-hour black capacitors, and a server-grade low-loss PCB make the ASRock X870E Nova WiFi AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard exceptionally durable and reliable. With bundled utilities like Polychrome SYNC, Phantom Gaming Tuning, and a Full HD UEFI BIOS, the ASRock X870E Nova WiFi AM5 DDR5 Motherboard is the perfect foundation for a high-end, future-ready PC build.

products.description:
ASRock Z890 Pro RS WiFi White LGA1851 DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The ASRock Z890 Pro RS WiFi White LGA1851 DDR5 ATX Motherboard is a powerhouse built for optimal productivity and robust durability. Supporting Intel Core Ultra Processors and Intel Hybrid Technology, it ensures high-speed performance with features like 16+1+1+1+1 Power Phase Dr. MOS, Enlarged Heatsink Armor, and Memory OC Shield for enhanced stability. With dual-channel DDR5 memory technology, four DDR5 DIMM slots supporting up to 9066MHz+(OC), and a maximum capacity of 256GB, it caters to demanding applications and multitasking needs. The ASRock Z890 Pro RS WiFi White LGA1851 DDR5 ATX Motherboard's ultrafast connectivity is evident with PCIe Gen5 for graphics and M.2, Thunderbolt 4 Type-C ports delivering up to 40 Gb/s, 2.5G LAN, and an 802.11axe Wi-Fi 6E module for seamless, high-speed networking. It also supports a wide range of USB ports, including USB 3.2 Gen2x2 Type-C, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A, USB 3.2 Gen1, and USB 2.0, ensuring versatile peripheral connectivity. Integrated Intel® Xe LPG Graphics Architecture provides superior visual output through HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4, supporting resolutions up to 8K 60Hz. The ASRock Z890 Pro RS WiFi White LGA1851 DDR5 ATX Motherboard's advanced audio system, powered by Realtek ALC897 7.1 CH HD Audio Codec with Nahimic Audio, delivers immersive sound quality. Storage is expansive with multiple M.2 sockets supporting both PCIe and SATA modes, and four SATA3 connectors, supporting various RAID configurations. Additional features like the BIOS Flashback Button, ASRock Auto Driver Installer, and EZ Troubleshooter enhance user convenience, while software tools such as ASRock A-Tuning, Dragon 2.5G LAN Software, and Polychrome SYNC provide comprehensive control. With a form factor of 12.0-in x 9.6-in and 2oz Copper PCB, this ASRock Z890 Pro RS WiFi White LGA1851 DDR5 ATX Motherboard is designed for durability and performance, making it an excellent choice for users seeking a high-performance, future-proof solution for their computing needs.

The Asus B850 MAX GAMING WIFI W AM5 ATX Motherboard is a performance-driven solution designed for gamers and power users who demand cutting-edge features and next-gen compatibility. The Asus B850 MAX GAMING WIFI W ATX Motherboard supports up to 256GB DDR5 RAM across four DIMM slots, delivering exceptional memory speeds up to 8000+ MT/s (OC) and full support for ECC and non-ECC unbuffered memory, dual-channel architecture, AMD EXPO, and ASUS AEMP profiles. Designed for high-performance expansion, the Asus B850 MAX GAMING WIFI W Motherboard includes PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 slots, and three ultra-fast M.2 slots, alongside four SATA 6Gb/s ports with full RAID support. The rear I/O panel provides 10 USB ports, including 2 USB4 (40Gbps) and fast-charging USB Type-C options, while the internal I/O offers additional fan headers, RGB headers, USB headers, and TPM support. Designed for effortless DIY builds, it features ASUS Q-Design, pre-mounted I/O shield, BIOS FlashBack, and robust thermal solutions like VRM and M.2 heatsinks. Integrated with ASUS Armoury Crate, Aura Sync, and multiple software utilities, the Asus B850 MAX GAMING WIFI W delivers a complete package of performance, reliability, and aesthetics, making it a top choice for gamers and content creators building with the AM5 platform.

Asus B850M AYW GAMING WIFI AM5 m-ATX Motherboard

The Asus B850M AYW GAMING WIFI AM5 m-ATX Motherboard is a compact yet powerful solution designed for modern AMD builds, offering robust performance and top-tier features for gamers and PC enthusiasts. Built with the AMD B850 chipset, the Asus B850M AYW GAMING WIFI Motherboard supports the latest Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors via the AM5 socket. It accommodates up to 128GB of DDR5 RAM through 2 DIMM slots, with memory speeds reaching up to 8400+MT/s (OC) depending on the processor. Its micro-ATX form factor (24.4 x 22.1 cm) makes it ideal for compact gaming setups without sacrificing capability. The Asus B850M AYW GAMING WIFI micro-ATX Motherboard features built-in Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, and Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet with ASUS LANGuard, ensuring fast, stable connectivity for gaming, streaming, and multitasking. Rear I/O connectivity includes 8 USB ports (2 x USB 10Gbps, 2 x USB 5Gbps, 4 x USB 2.0), while the front panel supports 7 additional USB ports, including a USB Type-C® connector with 5V/3A power delivery. The motherboard supports one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for Ryzen 9000/7000 and PCIe 4.0 x16/x8/x4 slots for Ryzen 8000, enhancing GPU and expansion card options. Premium cooling is ensured with dedicated M.2 and VRM heatsinks, and ASUS Q-Design features like Q-LED, Q-DIMM, and M.2 Q-Latch enhance user-friendly installation and diagnostics. The Asus B850M AYW GAMING WIFI Motherboard also delivers immersive audio through the Realtek 7.1 Surround Sound CODEC, supporting 24-bit/192kHz playback and enhanced by premium capacitors and audio shielding. ASUS B860M AYW GAMING WIFI LGA 1851 Micro-ATX Motherboard

The ASUS B860M AYW GAMING WIFI motherboard is a powerful micro-ATX solution designed for Intel Core Ultra Processors (Series 2) with the LGA1851 socket. It fully supports Intel Turbo Boost Technology 2.0 and Turbo Boost Max Technology 3.0. The storage is sturdy, with two M.2 slots and four SATA 6Gb/s connectors. The M.2_1 slot supports PCIe 5.0 x4, while the M.2_2 slot supports PCIe 4.0 x4, with RAID 0/1/5/10 capability provided by Intel Rapid Storage Technology. This ASUS B860M AYW GAMING WIFI LGA 1851 Micro-ATX Motherboard supports Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet with ASUS LANGuard, Wi-Fi 6 (1x1) with dual-band compatibility, and Bluetooth v5.3. Rear I/O features one USB 10Gbps Type-A, two USB 5Gbps Type-A, and three USB 2.0 ports, while front USB compatibility includes one USB 5Gbps Type-C connector, one 5Gbps header, and two USB 2.0 headers that provide four additional ports. The ASUS B860M AYW GAMING WIFI Micro-ATX Motherboard features audio driven by the Realtek 7.1 Surround Sound codec, which supports 24-bit/192kHz playback, audio shielding, quality capacitors, and dedicated PCB layers. Internal I/O includes fan headers, power connectors, storage connectors, several USB headers, and addressable Gen2 RGB. ASUS' features include 5X Protection III, Q-Design elements for easier DIY building, thermal solutions for VRM and M.2, and Aura Sync lighting. Asus TUF GAMING A520M-PLUS II AMD AM4 microATX Motherboard

The Asus PRIME B550M-K ARGB motherboard is a dependable and performance-oriented option for those building a modern AMD system, providing the ideal blend of efficiency, connection, and longevity. It is built with the AMD B550 chipset and AMD Socket AM4 and supports a wide range of processors, including Ryzen 5000 Series, 5000 G-Series, 4000 G-Series, and 3000 Series desktop CPUs. For memory, the Asus PRIME B550M-K ARGB motherboard has two DIMM slots that can support up to 64GB DDR4 at speeds of up to 5100MHz when overclocked, and it uses a dual-channel design with ECC support depending on the CPU. In terms of graphics, the motherboard includes one DisplayPort 1.4 and one HDMI 2.1 port, both of which may support 4K at 60Hz, though performance may vary depending on the CPU. The Asus PRIME B550M-K ARGB motherboard offers three expansion slots: a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for Ryzen 5000 and 3000 series processors, a PCIe 3.0 x16 slot for Ryzen G-Series CPUs, and a PCIe 3.0 x1 slot for extra cards. Storage is diverse, with two M.2 slots and four SATA 6Gb/s ports that support PCIe and SATA modes, as well as RAID 0, 1, and 10. The Asus PRIME B550M-K ARGB motherboard includes Realtek 1Gb Ethernet networking, as well as Realtek 7.1 Surround Sound High Definition Audio CODEC with superior capacitors, shielding, and 24-bit/192 kHz playback. The back panel features USB 3.2 Gen 1, USB 2.0, DisplayPort, HDMI, Ethernet, audio connectors, and a PS/2 combination port. Internal interfaces include CPU and chassis fan headers, addressable Gen 2 headers, M.2 slots, SATA ports, USB 3.2 Gen 1 and USB 2.0 headers, a TPM, and more. The Asus PRIME B550M-K ARGB motherboard includes ASUS 5X Protection III, Q-Design, Aura Sync ARGB support, AI Suite 3, Armoury Crate, Fan Xpert 2+, and a user-friendly UEFI BIOS featuring CrashFree BIOS 3 and EZ Flash.

The motherboard is equipped with multiple onboard heatsinks and an array of hybrid fan headers to ensure your rig stays cool and stable under intense workloads. It features comprehensive cooling controls that are configurable via Fan Xpert 2+ software or via the UEFI BIOS. It also offers Wi-Fi 6, M.2 PCIe 5.0, Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet, USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports, and front USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C. products.description:
Asus PRIME B650M-A WIFI-CSM DDR5 AMD AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard

The Asus PRIME B650M-A WIFI-CSM supports AMD Ryzen 8000 & 7000-series processors for socket AM5. This Corporate Stable Model is a commercial program designed to provide stable and reliable motherboards. It has been expertly engineered to unleash the full potential of Ryzen 8000 & 7000 series CPUs. It comes with a robust power design, comprehensive cooling solutions, and intelligent tuning options. Asus PRIME B650M-A WIFI-CSM Motherboard is packed with flexible tools to tune every aspect of your system, enabling performance tweaks to perfectly match the way you work to maximize productivity. The motherboard is equipped with multiple onboard heatsinks and an array of hybrid fan headers to ensure your rig stays cool and stable under intense workloads. VRM heatsink and thermal pads improve heat transfer from the MOSFETs and chokes for better cooling performance. It has a 6-layer PCB Design. Multiple PCB layers optimize heat management for critical components, providing more headroom to push CPUs beyond stock speeds. It features comprehensive cooling controls that are configurable via Fan Xpert 2+ software or via the UEFI BIOS. PRIME B650M-A WIFI-CSM offers a total of two M.2 slots, the first one supports data-transfer speeds of up to 128Gbps via PCIe 5.0. It also offers Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet, Wi-Fi 6, DisplayPort, VGA, HDMI, SATA 6 Gbps, USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports, front USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C. Realtek 2.5 Gb Ethernet reduces CPU overhead and offers exceptionally high TCP and UDP throughput for faster, smoother data transfers. The Asus PRIME B650M-A WIFI-CSM Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

ASUS PRIME B760-PLUS ATX Motherboard

ASUS PRIME B760-PLUS Motherboard supports 14th 13th/ 12th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors for LGA 1700 socket. It comes with four dual-channel RAM slots, and three M.2 slots allowing you to take advantage of the full power of 13th & 12th generation Intel processors. The four SATA III ports allow users to create large storage drive arrays for large file libraries. Two PCIe x16 and one PCIe x1 slot allow you to install high-end graphics cards and other expansion cards. USB 2.0 ports are also available for lower-powered devices such as mice and keyboards.

Enhanced Power Design

This 14th Gen Motherboard is designed for gamers and enthusiasts, with a 12+1+1 dual rail power system and 8+8 pin power connectors to support the Core Boost technology, which boosts the performance of your multi-core Intel processor. The Digital Power Design, Overvoltage Protection, Load-Line Calibration, Double Power Connectors, and Supplemental PCIe Power Connectors on the motherboard all work together to provide proper electrical management through your system to stabilize your system, especially under high loads.

Premium Thermal Solution

The ASUS PRIME B760-PLUS Motherboard features Extended Heatsink Design and M.2 Shield Frozr and is designed for high-performance systems and continuous operation. This motherboard's increased cooling capabilities will keep your components working at optimal temperatures. M.2 Shield Frozr, Fully Fan Control, Frozr AI Cooling, and System Cooling all work together to keep your components cool even while under high loads when gaming or generating content.

High-Quality PCB for Enhanced Protection

The ASUS PRIME B760-PLUS features a PCB optimized for higher bandwidth and faster transfer speeds, as well as reliable circuit transmission with 2oz thickened copper that allows the motherboard to easily withstand overclocking while improving heat dissipation and system reliability. The grounding layer around the mounting holes is doubled for double ESD protection, preventing static discharge spikes from damaging the motherboard.

The ASUS PRIME B760M-F is a high-performance micro-ATX motherboard designed to accommodate Intel's 12th, 13th, and 14th generation processors with its Intel B760 chipset. Supporting the latest DDR5 RAM, the ASUS PRIME B760M-F future-proofs your system for enhanced responsiveness. The motherboard includes Realtek 1Gb Ethernet for stable and reliable network connectivity, ensuring smooth performance in gaming, streaming, and multitasking. Thermal management is optimized with a PCH heatsink, hybrid fan headers, and ASUS Fan Xpert 2+ to keep your system cool even during heavy workloads. For aesthetic customization, the board features Aura Sync RGB lighting with onboard addressable Gen 2 headers, allowing easy synchronization with other Aura Sync-capable components. The motherboard comes with a two-way AI noise cancelation feature, which significantly reduces background noise during voice chats, making it a great choice for gaming or video conferencing. With its robust feature set and future-ready capabilities, the ASUS PRIME B760M-F is perfect for those looking to build a powerful AI-powered PC, gaming setup, or professional workstation.

Asus PRIME B760M-F WIFI mATX Motherboard

The ASUS PRIME B760M-F WIFI mATX Motherboard is a compact yet powerful solution tailored for modern PC builders seeking next-gen performance, efficient connectivity, and versatile expansion in a micro-ATX form factor. Engineered around the Intel B760 chipset, it supports Intel Core 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen processors, along with Pentium Gold and Celeron CPUs, via the LGA1700 socket, making it ideal for both mainstream users and performance enthusiasts. With support for up to 96GB of DDR5 memory across two DIMM slots, users can unlock blazing-fast speeds up to DDR5-8000 (OC), perfect for multitasking, gaming, and content creation. Storage is equally impressive, featuring two PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 slots for ultra-fast NVMe SSDs and four SATA 6Gb/s ports for traditional drives, ensuring ample space and speed for demanding workflows. The Asus PRIME B760M-F WIFI board’s expansion capabilities include one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for high-end graphics cards and one PCIe 4.0 x1 slot for additional peripherals, while onboard connectivity is bolstered by Wi-Fi 6, Realtek 1Gb Ethernet, Bluetooth v5.3, and a rich array of USB ports—including four USB 5Gbps ports, two USB 2.0 ports, and headers for further expansion. Visual output is handled via HDMI and DisplayPort, supporting up to 4K resolution, and audio is delivered through three jacks backed by Realtek HD audio with shielding and premium capacitors for immersive sound. Aesthetically, the Asus PRIME B760M-F WIFI motherboard supports Aura Sync RGB lighting through two Addressable Gen 2 headers, allowing users to personalize their builds with synchronized effects. The 8-pin ProCool power connector ensures stable power delivery, while ASUS’s Fan Xpert 2+ and Digi+ VRM technologies provide intelligent cooling and energy efficiency. With intuitive BIOS controls and AI-enhanced features like two-way noise cancellation, the Asus PRIME B760M-F WIFI offers a balanced blend of performance, reliability, and customization, making it a standout choice for compact, high-performance desktop builds.

products.description:
Asus PRIME B850M-F-CSM AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard

The ASUS PRIME B850M‑F‑CSM AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard is built for stability, efficiency, and long‑term reliability. Powered by the AMD B850 chipset and supporting Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series desktop processors, this ASUS PRIME B850M‑F‑CSM Motherboard delivers next‑generation performance with DDR5 memory, PCIe 5.0 expansion, and advanced connectivity in a compact micro‑ATX form factor.

Performance and Compatibility

Featuring the AMD AM5 socket, the ASUS PRIME B850M‑F‑CSM supports the latest Ryzen CPUs, ensuring future‑ready computing power. With dual DDR5 DIMM slots, it supports up to 128GB of memory with speeds exceeding 8200+ MT/s (OC). This Asus 850 Motherboard is optimized for multitasking, productivity, and everyday performance, making it ideal for business and home users.

Expansion and Storage

The motherboard includes a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for high‑performance graphics cards and additional PCIe 4.0 slots for expansion devices. Storage flexibility is provided by 2 M.2 slots (PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0) and 4 SATA 6Gb/s ports, supporting fast NVMe SSDs and traditional drives. AMD RAIDXpert2 technology enables RAID configurations for enhanced performance and redundancy.

Connectivity and I/O Features

The ASUS PRIME B850M‑F‑CSM Motherboard offers modern connectivity with rear USB 5Gbps Type‑A ports, multiple USB 2.0 ports, and HDMI 2.1 supporting 4K@60Hz. Front panel options include USB Type‑C and additional USB headers for expansion. Networking is powered by Realtek 1Gb Ethernet with ASUS LANGuard protection, ensuring stable and secure connections.

Audio and Multimedia

Equipped with Realtek 7.1 Surround Sound HD Audio CODEC, this ASUS Prime AM5 Motherboard delivers immersive audio with support for 24‑bit/192kHz playback. Premium capacitors, audio shielding, and dedicated PCB layers ensure clear sound for entertainment, gaming, and productivity.

Cooling and Reliability

Built with ASUS 5X Protection III, the motherboard offers DIGI+ VRM, overvoltage protection, SafeSlot, and stainless‑steel back I/O for long‑term durability. Cooling solutions include aluminum heatsinks and multiple fan headers for optimized airflow. DIY‑friendly features such as BIOS FlashBack, Q‑DIMM, Q‑Slot, and Aura Sync RGB headers make installation and customization simple.

products.description:
Asus PRIME B860M-A WIFI-CSM LGA 1851 micro-ATX Motherboard

Asus PRIME B860M-A WIFI-CSM LGA 1851 micro-ATX Motherboard delivers reliable performance for modern systems powered by Intel Core Ultra Processors Series 2 on the LGA1851 socket. The Asus Motherboard uses the Intel B860 chipset and supports Intel Turbo Boost Technology 2.0 and Turbo Boost Max Technology 3.0. This Asus PRIME B860M-A WIFI-CSM Motherboard features four DDR5 DIMM slots supporting up to 256GB memory with speeds reaching 8666+MT/s overclocked. It supports Non-ECC unbuffered and Clocked Unbuffered DIMMs, dual channel architecture, DIMM Fit, XMP, and ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile III. The Asus Motherboard also supports On-Die ECC function for DDR5 memory, ensuring improved stability during heavy workloads. For graphics output, it provides two DisplayPort, one HDMI, and a USB 20Gbps Type-C port supporting DisplayPort Alt Mode. It supports up to 4K at 60Hz via DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.1, and up to 4K at 120Hz through DisplayPort. Expansion includes one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot, one PCIe 4.0 x16 slot running at x4 mode, and one PCIe 4.0 x1 slot. Storage options include two M.2 slots supporting PCIe 5.0 x4 and PCIe 4.0 x4, plus four SATA 6Gb/s ports with RAID 0,1,5,10. The Asus PRIME B860M-A WIFI-CSM LGA 1851 micro-ATX Motherboard integrates Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet with ASUS LANGuard for stable networking. It features Wi-Fi 6E supporting 2.4, 5, and 6GHz bands, plus Bluetooth 5.3 for modern wireless connectivity. Rear and front USB connectivity includes USB 20Gbps Type-C, USB 10Gbps, USB 5Gbps, and USB 2.0 ports with power delivery up to 5V/3A. Realtek 7.1 surround audio supports 24-bit 192kHz playback with shielding and premium capacitors. ASUS 5X Protection III, Q-Design, Thermal Solution, Aura Sync, and EZ DIY features enhance durability and customization. This micro-ATX board measures 9.6 inches square and supports Windows 11 and Windows 10 64-bit systems.

Asus PRIME B860M-K-CSM LGA 1851 micro-ATX Motherboard

The Asus PRIME B860M‑K‑CSM LGA 1851 micro‑ATX Motherboard is designed for stability, performance, and long‑term reliability. Built on the Intel B860M chipset, this Asus Prime Intel Motherboard supports the latest Intel Core Ultra Series 2 processors, DDR5 memory, and PCIe 5.0 storage, making it a future‑ready choice for business and productivity builds.

Performance and Compatibility

The Asus PRIME B860M‑K‑CSM Motherboard features the LGA 1851 socket, ensuring compatibility with next‑generation Intel CPUs. With dual DDR5 DIMM slots, it supports up to 128GB of high‑speed memory, optimized with ASUS AEMP III and DIMM Fit technology. This Asus mATX motherboard delivers reliable multitasking and efficient performance for professional desktops.

Expansion and Storage Options

Designed for flexibility, the Asus B860M Motherboard includes a PCIe 4.0 x16 SafeSlot Core+ for graphics cards and two PCIe 4.0 x1 slots for expansion. Storage is future‑proof with dual M.2 slots (PCIe 5.0 x4 and PCIe 4.0 x4) alongside four SATA 6Gb/s ports, ensuring fast NVMe SSD performance and traditional HDD support.

Connectivity and I/O Features

The Asus PRIME B860M‑K‑CSM LGA 1851 Motherboard offers Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet for stable networking, HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 for high‑resolution displays, and multiple USB 3.2 Gen 2, USB 3.0, and USB Type‑C ports for modern peripherals. With integrated audio powered by Realtek ALC892/897 codec, this Asus Prime Intel Motherboard ensures clear sound for everyday use.

Cooling and Reliability

Equipped with a 6+1+1+1 phase digital VRM design, the Asus PRIME B860M‑K‑CSM Motherboard delivers stable power to critical components. Onboard heatsinks and ASUS Fan Xpert 2+ software provide efficient cooling, while the compact micro‑ATX form factor ensures compatibility with a wide range of cases.

Asus Prime H510M-E/CSM Motherboard is expertly engineered to unleash the full potential of 10th and 11th Generation Intel processors. Boasting a robust power design, comprehensive cooling solutions, and intelligent tuning options, PRIME H510M-E/CSM provides daily users and DIY PC builders a range of performance tuning options via intuitive software and firmware features. Asus Prime H510M-E/CSM adds the nuanced details that improve every experience, exclusive codecs that provide pristine audio quality let you customize your system to create a uniquely personal look. Armoury Crate provides control of settings for ASUS products, including keyboard and mouse preferences. The Asus Prime H510M-E/CSM comes with 3 years of warranty.

The PRIME H510M-F R3.0 supports an Intel LGA 1200 socket, making it compatible with both 11th and 10th Gen Intel Core processors, enabling fast and powerful performance for everyday computing needs and demanding tasks alike. The inclusion of PCIe 4.0 provides twice the data transfer rates compared to its predecessor, allowing for faster communication between the CPU, GPU, and other peripherals. It also includes a 32Gbps M.2 slot, giving you lightning-fast data access for NVMe SSDs, ensuring reduced boot times and improved application performance. This motherboard offers a wide variety of options to connect your devices and peripherals. ASUS' comprehensive cooling system allows you to enjoy a stable and efficient performance, which is especially important for high-demand applications and multitasking. ASUS takes reliability seriously, which is why the PRIME H510M-F R3.0 is equipped with 5X Protection III, providing multiple layers of hardware safeguards. This includes protection against overvoltage, precise power delivery, and reinforced PCIe slots, ensuring that your components remain safe and the motherboard is protected from common electrical hazards. These features provide peace of mind, knowing that your system is built to last and is safe from unexpected damage. The ASUS PRIME series motherboards are engineered to provide a wide array of performance tuning options through intuitive software and firmware. The Armoury Crate is an all-in-one utility that gives you easy access to system settings, and the ability to monitor and control your system through a user-friendly interface. The Q-LED Core feature helps you quickly diagnose any hardware issues with visual indicators, making the building and troubleshooting process more straightforward. These features are invaluable for both beginners and experienced PC builders, allowing for effortless tuning and adjustment to get the most out of your system. The ASUS PRIME H510M-F R3.0 provides a perfect balance of performance, reliability, and expandability. With a robust power design, enhanced cooling solutions, and numerous safeguards, it offers an ideal platform for anyone looking to build a reliable and efficient PC. Whether you are using it for office productivity, home entertainment, or gaming, the motherboard’s features ensure a smooth experience with the potential to expand and upgrade as needed. The ASUS PRIME H510M-F R3.0 is an excellent choice for users seeking a durable, high-quality motherboard that combines powerful performance, ultrafast connectivity, comprehensive cooling, and easy-to-use tuning tools. It is a solid foundation for building a system that meets today’s demands while offering the flexibility to upgrade and expand for the future.

ASUS PRIME Z790-P WIFI-CSM ATX Motherboard

The ASUS PRIME Z790-P WIFI-CSM features LGA 1700 socket and the Z790 chipset. It supports  Intel 13th Gen Core Processors & 12th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron Processors. USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 port gives you up to 20 Gb/s data transfer speed for resource-demanding devices such as storage arrays and audio interfaces. ASUS Pro WS TRX50-SAGE WIFI AMD sTR5 Workstation Motherboard

The ASUS Pro WS TRX50‑SAGE WIFI Workstation Motherboard is a professional‑grade solution built for creators, engineers, and enterprises who demand uncompromising performance. Powered by the AMD TRX50 chipset and supporting Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9000 & 7000 WX‑Series processors, this ASUS Workstation WiFi Motherboard delivers cutting‑edge computing power with advanced scalability, connectivity, and durability.

Performance and Compatibility

Featuring the AMD sTR5 socket, the ASUS Pro WS TRX50‑SAGE WIFI supports Ryzen Threadripper PRO and Threadripper CPUs, offering massive multi‑core performance for rendering, simulation, and AI workloads. With 4 DDR5 DIMM slots and quad‑channel memory architecture, this ASUS Motherboard for Threadripper CPU ensures high bandwidth and stability for professional applications.

Expansion and Storage

This ASUS TRX50 Workstation Motherboard provides versatile expansion with 2 PCIe 5.0 x16 slots, 1 PCIe 5.0 x16 slot (x8 mode), 1 PCIe 4.0 x16 slot, and 1 PCIe 4.0 x16 slot (x4 mode). Storage options include 3 M.2 slots (PCIe 5.0 and 4.0), 4 SATA 6Gb/s ports, and 1 SlimSAS port supporting PCIe 4.0 NVMe devices. With AMD RAIDXpert2 technology, users can configure PCIe and SATA RAID 0/1/5/10 for performance and redundancy.

Connectivity and I/O Features

The rear I/O panel offers 1 USB 20Gbps Type‑C port, 6 USB 10Gbps Type‑A ports, and 2 USB 2.0 ports. Networking is powered by Marvell AQtion 10Gb Ethernet and Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet, while integrated Wi‑Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4 provide next‑generation wireless connectivity. Front panel support includes USB 20Gbps Type‑C with 27W PD/QC4+, USB 5Gbps, and multiple USB 2.0 headers, making this ASUS Workstation WiFi Motherboard ideal for modern professional setups.

Audio and Multimedia

Equipped with Realtek ALC1220P Surround Sound HD Audio CODEC, the ASUS Pro WS TRX50‑SAGE WIFI delivers high‑fidelity audio with 120 dB SNR playback and 113 dB SNR recording. Features include impedance sensing, premium capacitors, audio shielding, and optical S/PDIF out, ensuring clear sound for content creation and multimedia workflows.

Cooling and Reliability

Designed for 24/7 reliability, the motherboard integrates advanced thermal solutions including VRM heatsinks with active fans, M.2 heatsinks, and onboard thermal pads. ASUS Q‑Design features such as Q‑DIMM, Q‑Slot, and BIOS FlashBack™ simplify installation and maintenance. With CEB form factor (12 × 11 inches), this ASUS Workstation Motherboard fits workstation chassis while delivering enterprise‑grade durability.

products.description:
ASUS Pro WS WRX90E-SAGE SE AMD sTR5 EEB Workstation Motherboard

The ASUS Pro WS WRX90E‑SAGE SE Workstation Motherboard is a high‑end platform engineered for professionals who require extreme performance, scalability, and reliability. Built on the AMD WRX90 chipset, this ASUS Workstation Motherboard supports Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9000 & 7000 WX‑Series processors, delivering unmatched computing power for creators, engineers, and enterprise workloads.

Performance and Compatibility

Featuring the AMD sTR5 socket, the ASUS Pro WS WRX90E‑SAGE SE is designed for Ryzen Threadripper PRO CPUs, offering up to 96 cores for rendering, simulation, and AI applications. With 8 DDR5 DIMM slots, it supports large memory configurations with high bandwidth, ensuring smooth performance in multi‑threaded and professional computing environments. This ASUS Motherboard for Threadripper CPU is purpose‑built for demanding workstation tasks.

Expansion and Storage

This ASUS WRX90 Workstation Motherboard provides extensive expandability with 6 PCIe 5.0 x16 slots and an additional PCIe 5.0 x16 slot (x8 mode), enabling multi‑GPU setups and accelerator cards. Storage options include 4 M.2 slots supporting PCIe 5.0 NVMe SSDs, 2 SlimSAS ports, and 4 SATA 6Gb/s ports. With AMD RAIDXpert2 technology, users can configure PCIe and SATA RAID 0/1/5/10 for optimized performance and redundancy.

Connectivity and I/O Features

The rear I/O panel offers 2 USB4 Type‑C ports (40Gbps), 6 USB 10Gbps Type‑A ports, and a dedicated management LAN via Realtek 1Gb Ethernet. Dual Intel 10Gb Ethernet ports ensure ultra‑fast networking for data‑intensive workflows. Front panel support includes USB 20Gbps Type‑C, USB 5Gbps, and multiple USB 2.0 headers, making this ASUS Workstation Motherboard ideal for professional setups.

Audio and Multimedia

Equipped with Realtek ALC1220P Surround Sound HD Audio CODEC, the ASUS Pro WS WRX90E‑SAGE SE delivers studio‑grade audio with 120 dB SNR playback and 113 dB SNR recording. Premium capacitors, dedicated audio PCB layers, and impedance sensing ensure clear, high‑fidelity sound for professional content creation and multimedia applications.

Cooling and Reliability

Designed for 24/7 reliability, the motherboard integrates advanced thermal solutions including VRM heatsinks with active fans, M.2 heatsink backplates, and onboard thermal pads. ASUS 5X Protection III safeguards against overvoltage, ESD, and overcurrent, while Q‑Design features like Q‑DIMM, Q‑Slot, and BIOS FlashBack simplify installation and maintenance. The EEB form factor (12 × 13 inches) ensures compatibility with workstation chassis.

products.description:
Asus ProArt Z790-CREATOR WIFI ATX Motherboard

The ASUS ProArt Z790-CREATOR WIFI LGA 1700 ATX Motherboard is designed for experienced builders who want to make use of the power of Intel's 14th 13th and 12th Generation CPUs and gaming-focused components. With an Intel Z790 socket, you may easily install a wide choice of 12th and 14th Generation CPUs. Four DDR5 DIMM slots provide you with the increased speed and performance you need to streamline your production as well as edit and relive your favorite in-game moments. You may add an array of storage disks using the eight SATA and four M.2 connectors, resulting in a vast library for your media assets. Put graphics and utility cards in two PCIe 5.0 x16 slots and one PCIe 4.0 x16 (in x4 mode). With USB 2.0, 3.2 Gen 1, Gen 2, and Gen 2x2 connectivity, you may plug in your favorite peripherals such as keyboards, mice, audio interfaces, and more. Bluetooth 5.3 allows you to utilize wireless devices like keyboards, mice, and headphones. Dual RJ45 ports offer 2.5 and 10 Gigabit Ethernet speeds, allowing you to use teaming features to swiftly upload and download huge data. You may also connect to your network without a cable connection by using Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) wireless networking.

Power Design

The ASUS ProArt Z790-CREATOR WIFI ATX Motherboard A 16+1 paired power solution, 8+4 ProCool sockets, and alloy chokes with durable capacitors provide consistent electrical loads perfect for resource-hungry games.

M.2 PCIe 4.0 Storage

The ASUS ProArt Z790-CREATOR WIFI ATX Motherboard has M.2 PCIe 4.0 technology, which allows you to load programs quicker from your M.2 SSD, allowing you to get into your games and apps faster.

Thunderbolt 4

The ASUS ProArt Z790-CREATOR WIFI ATX Motherboard Dual Thunderbolt 4 ports give you up to 40 Gb/s data transfer speeds as well as DisplayPort and Power Delivery capabilities, giving you a one-cable solution to connect external storage arrays, displays, and more.

Connectivity

The ASUS ProArt Z790-CREATOR WIFI ATX Motherboard has USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 2x2 interfaces provide you with enhanced data transfer speeds up to 10 and 20 Gb/s, respectively, allowing you to utilize a wide range of peripherals such as audio interfaces, external storage solutions, and more. With front panel support, the ProArt incorporates internal headers for USB-A and USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 devices, giving you up to 5 Gb/s data transfer speeds for quick file management.

AI Noise Cancelation

The 14th Gen Motherboard is Two-way AI Noise Cancelation reduces background noise from the microphone and audio output for clear communication in games and conferences.

Comprehensive Cooling

Enlarged VRM and PCH heat sinks, M.2 heat sinks, hybrid fan headers, and Fan Xpert 2+ utility in Armoury Crate software allow you to optimize cooling capabilities whether you prefer fan or AiO liquid cooling.

Aura Sync

The ASUS ProArt Z790-CREATOR WIFI ATX Motherboard The stylish edge lighting design, addressable RGB headers, and RGB strip header enable you to add a splash of color to your system, transforming it into the focal point of your gaming area.

The Asus ROG CROSSHAIR X870E GLACIAL AMD AM5 E-ATX Motherboard is a premium gaming and enthusiast platform built to deliver uncompromising performance with striking aesthetics. Designed for the latest AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series processors, this Asus X870E Motherboard supports DDR5 memory up to 256GB and PCIe 5.0, ensuring ultra-fast data transfer speeds and next-generation GPU compatibility. Whether you are building a high-end gaming rig or a workstation for demanding creative tasks, this Asus ROG Motherboard provides the stability, speed, and scalability needed for future-ready computing, while standing out as an ASUS White Motherboard with its sleek Glacial design.

Extreme Power Delivery and Cooling

Engineered with a robust 24+2+2 power stage design, the ROG CROSSHAIR X870E GLACIAL Motherboard ensures consistent power delivery for extreme overclocking and heavy workloads. Cooling is enhanced by an integrated EK liquid cooling block, VRM heatsinks, 3D VC M.2 heatsinks, and a reinforced metal backplate. With support for up to seven M.2 slots (PCIe 5.0 and 4.0) and four SATA 6Gb/s ports, it offers unmatched storage flexibility and superior thermal management, keeping high-speed SSDs and critical components operating at peak efficiency.

Next-Gen Connectivity and Expansion

The Asus 870 Motherboard is equipped with cutting-edge connectivity options to meet the demands of modern systems. Featuring dual PCIe 5.0 x16 SafeSlots with Q-Release, it supports the latest GPUs with ease. Networking is future-proof with dual Realtek 10G Ethernet ports and WiFi 7 (MediaTek MT7927), plus Bluetooth 5.4 with LE Audio. USB connectivity is extensive, with 14 rear USB ports including 2 × USB4 40Gbps Type-C and 12 × USB 10Gbps, alongside 12 front USB ports supporting USB 20Gbps Type-C and Quick Charge 4+ up to 60W.

AI-Powered Gaming Optimization

Exclusive ASUS AI technologies make the ROG CROSSHAIR X870E GLACIAL Motherboard intelligent and adaptive. Features such as AI Cooling II, AI Overclocking, and AI Cache Boost automatically optimize system performance, ensuring smooth gameplay and efficient multitasking. Combined with Fan Xpert 4, GameFirst networking, and Aura Sync RGB lighting, the board adapts seamlessly to gaming and productivity needs, making this Asus ROG Motherboard a perfect choice for both beginners and experienced PC builders.

Premium Audio and Design

The ROG SupremeFX ALC4082 codec with ESS ES9219 Quad DAC delivers high-fidelity 7.1 surround sound, enhanced by LED-illuminated audio jacks and premium capacitors. The E-ATX form factor provides more room for advanced components and cooling solutions, while the white Glacial aesthetic makes this an iconic ASUS White Motherboard. A full-color 5-inch LCD display offers real-time system monitoring, adding both functionality and style to your build.

DIY-Friendly Features

The Asus ROG CROSSHAIR X870E GLACIAL Motherboard includes Q-Design innovations such as M.2 Q-Latch, PCIe Q-Release, SafeSlot, SafeDIMM, and a pre-mounted I/O shield. Extreme OC tools like LN2 Mode, ProbeIt, Safe Boot, and ReTry buttons are built-in, making it ideal for enthusiasts. With premium materials, advanced engineering, and a design that blends durability with aesthetics, this Asus Motherboard is the ultimate choice for gamers, creators, and overclockers seeking a future-ready platform.

The ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z790 DARK HERO Motherboard is an innovative motherboard developed to meet the needs of gamers and PC enthusiasts. The motherboard guarantees a steady and dependable power supply system with a 20+1+2 power stage architecture, twin ProCool II power connections, high-quality alloy chokes, and durable capacitors. This architecture is critical for unlocking the full potential of high-performance CPUs. The motherboard features the most recent M.2 functionality, including an integrated PCIe 5.0 M.2 slot and four PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots, all of which include extensive cooling solutions. The motherboard includes on-board Intel Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) for high-speed wireless connectivity as well as Intel 2.5 Gb Ethernet with ASUS LANGuard for dependable wired networking. AI Overclocking is an ASUS-exclusive feature that provides intelligent control for enhancing system performance. This function enables users to maximize the performance of their hardware without the complications of manual overclocking. The ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z790 DARK HERO Motherboard is a feature-packed powerhouse that combines improved power delivery, storage capacities, networking choices, and intelligent control for an unrivaled gaming and computing experience.

Asus ROG MAXIMUS Z790 HERO DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The Asus ROG MAXIMUS Z790 HERO DDR5 14th 13th & 12th Gen ATX Motherboard is a high-end motherboard designed to accommodate the latest 12th and 13th generation Intel Core processors and Windows 11. It features the Intel LGA 1700 socket and is compatible with PCIe 5.0 and DDR5 memory. This motherboard is its intelligent control, which includes ASUS-exclusive tools such as AI overclocking, AI cooling II, AI networking (GameFirst VI), and bi-directional AI noise cancellation. These features help to dissipate heat and maintain optimal operating temperatures, even under heavy loads. The motherboard has built-in WiFi 6E, Bluetooth V5.2, Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet, and ASUS LANGuard. ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z890 HERO BTF LGA1851 ATX Motherboard

The ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z890 HERO BTF is a high-end ATX motherboard that supports Intel Core Ultra Processors (Series 2) in the LGA1851 socket and is powered by the Intel Z890 chipset. It supports Intel Turbo Boost Technology 2.0 and 3.0 and has four DDR5 DIMM slots that can accommodate up to 256GB of memory at rates of 9200+MT/s (OC). The ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z890 HERO BTF Motherboard features dual-channel architecture, Intel XMP, DIMM Flex, NitroPath DRAM Technology, and ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile III (AEMP III), allowing for better memory tuning. An HDMI 2.1 port and two Thunderbolt 4 Type-C interfaces offer resolutions of up to 8K@60Hz and improved bandwidth. The expansion has one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot and two PCIe 4.0 slots that can accommodate multiple high-speed devices. Storage includes six M.2 slots and four SATA 6Gb/s connectors, as well as support for PCIe and SATA RAID. The ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z890 HERO BTF LGA1851 ATX Motherboard features Intel 2.5Gb and Realtek 5Gb Ethernet ports with ASUS LANGuard, as well as 2x2 Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4. The rear USB connectivity consists of two Thunderbolt 4 connectors, five USB 10Gbps ports, and four USB 5Gbps ports. Front panel. USB features a 20Gbps Type-C connector with 60W PD/QC4+, a 10Gbps Type-C, and headers for extra USB 5Gbps and 2.0 ports. The ROG SupremeFX ALC4082 codec powers the audio, which is further boosted by an ESS ES9219 DAC, gold-plated connectors, and Dolby Atmos support. The ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z890 HERO BTF LGA1851 ATX Motherboard features internal fan headers, an AIO pump, a thermal sensor, RGB lights, and a USB port. The board includes ASUS Q-Design tools such as M.2 Q-Latch and PCIe Q-Release for simple setup, as well as powerful VRM and M.2 thermal solutions and software such as Armoury Crate, Fan Xpert 4, GameFirst, and AI Overclocking. The ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z890 HERO BTF LGA1851 ATX Motherboard, which includes BIOS FlashBack, Clear CMOS, and Windows 11 compatibility, is designed for serious performance, future-ready connectivity, and enthusiast-grade customization.

The multiple PCIe 5.0 slots offer ultra-fast data transfer rates, supporting the latest graphics cards and storage devices, ensuring your system is ready for future upgrades. The comprehensive range of USB ports, including USB 20Gbps Type-C® with DisplayPort Alt Mode and USB PD 3.0 for up to 30W fast charging, enhances compatibility and convenience, allowing you to connect a wide array of peripherals and devices effortlessly.

Advanced Cooling and AI Optimization

Designed to handle the most demanding tasks, the ROG MAXIMUS Z890 HERO features advanced cooling solutions to maintain optimal performance. Enlarged VRM heatsinks, multiple fan headers, and M.2 heatsinks ensure that your system remains cool and stable even during intense gaming sessions or heavy workloads. The AI Cooling II technology automatically adjusts fan speeds based on system temperatures, ensuring efficient cooling without excessive noise. Asus ROG STRIX B650-A GAMING WIFI DDR5 AM5 ATX Motherboard

The ASUS ROG STRIX B650-A GAMING WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard is designed for gamers seeking solid connection and better performance, allowing experienced builders to exploit the power of AMD's Ryzen 8000 & 7000 CPUs and gaming-focused components. With an AMD AM5 socket, you may easily install a wide choice of AMD Ryzen CPUs from the 7000 Series family. Four DDR5 DIMM slots provide you with the speed and performance you need for gaming, as well as editing and recreating your favorite in-game moments. You may install an array of storage devices using the four SATA III and three M.2 ports, producing a vast library for your games, video assets, and more. Add one PCIe 4.0 x16, one PCIe 4.0 x16 (in x4 mode), and two PCIe 4.0 x1 slots for graphics and utility cards. With USB 2.0, 3.2 Gen 1, Gen 2, and Gen 2x2 connectivity, you may plug in your favorite peripherals such as keyboards, mice, audio interfaces, and more. Bluetooth 5.2 is available for wireless devices such as headphones and controllers. Use the included 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet connector for wired connections or the Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) signal for a rapid and reliable cable-free experience.

Power Design

The Asus ROG STRIX B650-A GAMING WIFI Motherboard Sporting 12+2 power stages and 8+4 pin ProCool power connectors, the ROG STRIX can deliver reliable and stable performance for your components. Hi-end chokes and capacitors are engineered to resist extreme temperatures while the eight-layer PCB quickly dissipates heat around voltage regulators and offers greater overclocking headroom.

Cooling Capabilities

The Asus ROG STRIX B650-A GAMING WIFI Motherboard Covering the power solution are two thick heat sinks with strategic airflow channels for increased heat dissipation while powering high-performance Ryzen 7000 Series processors. High-quality thermal pads are utilized between power stages and heat sinks, helping to improve heat transfer and reduce VRM operating temperatures. M.2 heat sinks cover every slot to help keep onboard NVME SSDs at optimal temperatures for consistent performance and reliability. CPU and chassis headers also allow you to leverage various liquid and air-cooling components for optimal performance.

Next-Gen M.2 Support

The Asus ROG STRIX B650-A GAMING WIFI Motherboard with Experience lightning-fast performance with PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 slots for M.2 storage drives, enhancing application loading and general system performance. Each of the M.2 SSD slots is equipped with integrated heat sinks to help support and keep your storage drives cool.

USB Ports

This Asus ROG STRIX B650-A GAMING WIFI Motherboard An array of back panel USB ports allows you to plug in your most useful and essential devices with ease. USB-A 2.0 ports offer support for keyboards and mice while the USB-A and USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 ports provide you with 10 Gb/s data transfer speeds, suitable for audio interfaces and external storage drives. For even greater performance, a USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 port offers up to 20 Gb/s speeds.

Networking

The Asus ROG STRIX B650-A GAMING WIFI Motherboard has Onboard Wi-Fi 6E technology that takes advantage of the 6 GHz bands to provide up to seven 160 MHz channels for ultrafast throughput and better performance in dense wireless environments. Low-latency gaming, speedy file transfers, and high-resolution video streaming are among the many perks of onboard Intel 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet.

Audio

ROG SupremeFX is a unique blend of hardware and software technologies that provide superior audio. The ROG STRIX B650-A GAMING WIFI implementation features the ALC4080 codec for high-resolution playback up to 32-bit/384 kHz across all channels. Front-panel output is streamed through the integrated Savitech amplifier that can drive high-fidelity acoustics to a wide variety of speakers and headsets.

DIY-Designed

ASUS developed the ROG STRIX B650-A GAMING WIFI to include a wide variety of integrated improvements designed to ease the installation process of the motherboard as well as components. PCIe Slot Q-Release and M.2 Q-Latch enable easy installation and removal of GPUs and solid-state drives. Clear CMOS internal jumper and BIOS Flashback button offer easy diagnosis and upgrading of the hardware's firmware.

Aura Sync

The Asus ROG STRIX B650-A GAMING WIFI motherboards feature ASUS Aura technology, enabling full lighting control and a variety of presets for both onboard RGB LEDs and third-party accessories. Effects can be easily synced across compatible ROG graphics cards, monitors, keyboards, and mice to give your setup a unified look.

Asus ROG STRIX B850-G GAMING WIFI mATX Motherboard

The ASUS ROG STRIX B850-G GAMING WIFI mATX Motherboard is an advanced and compact Asus Motherboard designed for enthusiasts who demand next-gen performance, high-speed connectivity, and robust customization options in a micro ATX form factor. Engineered around the AMD B850 chipset, this powerful ASUS ROG STRIX Motherboard supports the latest AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors through the AM5 socket, offering exceptional computing power for gaming, content creation, and AI-driven tasks. Memory configuration is highly scalable, supporting up to 256GB of DDR5 RAM with speeds exceeding 8000 MT/s (OC), enhanced by ASUS AEMP and EXPO profiles that simplify fine-tuned overclocking for optimal system responsiveness. The Asus B850-G Gaming WiFi Motherboard features a 14+2+1 power stage layout rated at 80A per stage, fortified with premium alloy chokes, ProCool II connectors, and expansive VRM heatsinks to maintain thermal efficiency and stable voltage delivery under demanding conditions. Audio is delivered through Realtek ALC1220P codec with Savitech AMP and support for Dolby Atmos, ensuring immersive sound with clean signal delivery. The sleek white PCB, integrated I/O shield, Aura Sync-enabled RGB lighting, and three Gen 2 addressable headers add visual flair and personalization, rounding out a board that blends aesthetics with functionality. Overall, the ASUS ROG STRIX B850-G GAMING WIFI stands as a top-tier choice among Asus AMD motherboards, offering unmatched versatility, premium components, and DIY-friendly tools that empower gamers and creators to build performance-optimized systems in compact form factors.

Asus ROG STRIX B860-I GAMING WIFI LGA 1851 Mini ITX Motherboard

The Asus ROG STRIX B860‑I GAMING WIFI LGA 1851 Mini ITX Motherboard is a compact yet powerful solution for next‑generation Intel builds. Designed with the Intel B860 chipset, this Asus ROG STRIX Motherboard delivers advanced performance, DDR5 memory support, PCIe 5.0 expansion, and seamless wireless connectivity with Wi‑Fi 7. Perfect for small form factor PCs, this Asus ITX Motherboard combines cutting‑edge features with premium design.

High‑Performance Compatibility

Built for Intel LGA 1851 socket processors, the Asus ROG STRIX B860‑I GAMING WIFI Motherboard supports Intel Core Ultra Series 2 CPUs. With dual DDR5 DIMM slots, it offers up to 96GB capacity and speeds exceeding 9066+ MT/s (OC). Enhanced by ASUS AEMP III and DIMM Fit technology, this Asus Mini ITX Motherboard ensures stable overclocking and efficient multitasking for demanding users.

Compact Design and Cooling

The Asus ROG STRIX B860‑I Motherboard features robust cooling solutions including large heatsinks, high‑conductivity thermal pads, and an L‑shaped heatpipe for efficient thermal management. Its Mini ITX form factor makes it ideal for compact builds, while DIY‑friendly features such as PCIe Slot Q‑Release Slim, Q‑LED indicators, and a pre‑mounted I/O shield simplify installation.

Storage and Expansion

Equipped with dual M.2 slots, the Asus ROG STRIX B860‑I GAMING WIFI LGA 1851 Mini ITX Motherboard supports PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 storage for ultra‑fast data transfer. A reinforced PCIe 5.0 x16 SafeSlot ensures secure GPU installation, making this Asus Motherboard future‑ready for next‑generation graphics cards.

Advanced Connectivity

Connectivity is a highlight of this Asus WiFi Motherboard. It features Wi‑Fi 7 with ASUS WiFi Q‑Antenna, Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet, Thunderbolt 4, USB 20Gbps Type‑C, USB 10Gbps Type‑A, and HDMI 2.1 output. These options ensure seamless networking, high‑speed data transfer, and compatibility with modern peripherals.

Immersive Audio and Personalization

Powered by ROG SupremeFX ALC1220P audio with Savitech amplifier, the Asus ROG STRIX B860‑I GAMING WIFI Motherboard delivers premium sound quality with Dolby Atmos support. Customizable RGB lighting with Aura Sync and dual Gen 2 ARGB headers allow users to personalize their builds with vibrant effects, making this Asus ROG STRIX Motherboard both functional and stylish.

The Asus ROG STRIX X870-F GAMING WIFI DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard is a powerful gaming and performance motherboard. The flexible expansion slots on the Asus ROG STRIX X870-F GAMING WIFI DDR5 AM5 Motherboard include PCIe 5.0 x16 for RyzenTM 9000 and 7000 series CPUs and PCIe 4.0 x16 for Ryzen 8000 processors. The front panel offers flexibility for devices with one USB 20Gbps Type-C® connector, USB 5Gbps headers, and USB 2.0 headers. The ROG SupremeFX 7.1 surround sound system, which includes a Savitech SV3H712 AMP and an ALC4080 codec, powers the audio. Aura Sync lighting, heatsinks for enhanced thermal management, and simple installation options like the BIOS FlashBack button and pre-mounted I/O shield are among the extra features. With features like Armoury Crate, Fan Xpert 4, Dolby Atmos, and AI overclocking support, the Asus ROG STRIX X870-F GAMING WIFI DDR5 AM5 Motherboard offers optimal performance for all gaming and creative applications. products.description:
Asus ROG STRIX X870E-H GAMING WIFI7 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard

The ASUS ROG STRIX X870E‑H GAMING WIFI7 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard is a high‑performance platform designed for gamers, creators, and PC enthusiasts. Powered by the AMD X870E chipset and supporting Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series processors, this ASUS ROG STRIX Motherboard delivers cutting‑edge speed, stability, and connectivity. With PCIe 5.0, DDR5 memory support, WiFi 7, and advanced cooling, it’s built to handle next‑generation gaming and productivity workloads.

Performance and Compatibility

Featuring the AMD AM5 socket, the ASUS ROG STRIX X870E‑H GAMING WIFI7 supports the latest Ryzen CPUs, ensuring future‑ready performance. With 4 DDR5 DIMM slots, it supports up to 256GB of high‑speed memory, reaching speeds beyond 8000 MT/s (OC). This Asus 870 Motherboard is optimized for overclocking, multitasking, and demanding applications, making it ideal for gamers and professionals alike.

Expansion and Storage

The motherboard offers extensive expansion with 1 PCIe 5.0 x16 SafeSlot for graphics cards and an additional PCIe 4.0 x16 slot. Storage flexibility includes 4 M.2 slots (2 PCIe 5.0, 2 PCIe 4.0) with dedicated heatsinks and Q‑Latch for tool‑free installation. This ASUS PCIe 5.0 Motherboard ensures blazing‑fast SSD performance for gaming, content creation, and AI workloads.

Connectivity and I/O Features

The ASUS ROG STRIX X870E‑H Gaming WiFi 7 Motherboard provides next‑gen connectivity with dual USB4 Type‑C ports (40Gbps), multiple USB 10Gbps Type‑A ports, and front panel USB 20Gbps Type‑C with 30W PD support. Networking is powered by Realtek 5Gb Ethernet and integrated WiFi 7 with Bluetooth 5.4, delivering ultra‑fast, stable connections for competitive gaming and professional workflows.

Audio and Gaming Experience

Equipped with SupremeFX audio powered by Realtek ALC1220P codec and Savitech AMP, this ASUS ROG STRIX Motherboard delivers immersive sound with 120dB SNR playback. Premium capacitors and shielding ensure crystal‑clear audio for gaming, streaming, and content creation.

Cooling and Design

Designed for high‑performance builds, the ASUS ROG STRIX X870E‑H GAMING WIFI7 features massive heatsinks, integrated I/O covers, and M.2 backplates for Gen5 SSDs. DIY‑friendly features like PCIe Slot Q‑Release, M.2 Q‑Latch, BIOS FlashBack™, and Clear CMOS button make installation and upgrades simple. With ROG’s bold design and RGB lighting, it enhances both aesthetics and functionality.

Asus ROG STRIX Z790-A GAMING WIFI DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-A GAMING WIFI DDR5 14th, 13th & 12th Gen ATX Motherboard is a top-of-the-line motherboard designed for gamers and enthusiasts looking to build a high-performance PC. It is equipped with an Intel LGA 1700 socket, making it ready for use with 13th-generation Intel Core and 12th-generation Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors. The Asus ROG STRIX Z790-A GAMING WIFI motherboard features a robust power solution with 16 + 1 power stages rated for 80A, dual ProCool II power connectors, high-quality alloy chokes, and durable capacitors, providing stable power to support the latest multicore processors. It also boasts optimized VRM thermals with massive heat sinks connected by an L-shaped heat pipe, high-conductivity thermal pads, and an integrated I/O shroud. With four PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots all with heatsinks, including the tallest having a combo sink extension and backplate for additional cooling, the motherboard provides extensive M.2 support. Additionally, it offers abundant connectivity with a USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C rear I/O port and additional front panel connector, seven USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 1 ports, PCIe 5.0 x16 SafeSlot, HDMI 2.1, and DisplayPort 1.4. The Asus ROG STRIX Z790-A GAMING WIFI 14th Gen Motherboard is equipped with built-in WiFi 6E (802.11ax) and 2.5Gb Intel Ethernet with ASUS LANGuard for high-performance networking. It also features intelligent control with ASUS-exclusive AI overclocking, AI II cooling, AI networking, and bi-directional AI noise cancellation to simplify setup and improve performance.
