products.description:
ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-E GAMING WIFI ATX Motherboard

ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-E GAMING WIFI 14th Gen  Motherboard features LGA 1700 socket and Z790 chipset which supports Intel Socket LGA1700 for 13th Gen Intel Core & 12th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron Processors. This motherboard comes with 4 x DIMM that supports DDR5 Dual-Channel RAM up to 128GB of memory with speeds up to 7200 MHz when overclocked. This provides you with increased multitasking and rendering capabilities. It comes with 5x M.2 PCIe and four SATA III storage interfaces allow you to combine an array of storage drives to build a massive gaming library. It also has a single PCIe 5.0 x16 slot that supports resource-intensive graphics cards, while two PCIe 4.0 x16 (in x4 mode) and one PCIe 3.0 x1 slots support a variety of utility cards. Several USB 2.0, 3.2 Gen 1, Gen 2, and Gen 2x2 interfaces are accessible via the back panel and internal headers, providing ample support for peripherals such as mice, keyboards, and controllers as well as resource-demanding devices such as external drives. Bluetooth 5.2 technology can be used by wireless devices to provide a reliable cable-free experience. Use Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) to connect to your wireless network, or the integrated 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port if you prefer a wired connection.

AI Overclocking

The ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-E GAMING WIFI can boost performance with automatic AI overclocking and cooling, enhancing your games and productivity without sacrificing thermal capabilities. AI noise cancellation is an audio-focused utility that reduces background noise, allowing others to hear you more clearly when playing team-based games or delivering presentations remotely. GameFirst VI is an artificial intelligence networking tool that prioritizes and optimizes your network connection for smoother online gameplay, which is essential for competitive online titles.

Enhanced Power Solution

ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-E GAMING WIFI delivers stable power throughout the entire motherboard, maintaining electrical volume whether performing simple tasks or operating at full power during resource-demanding processes, thanks to 16+1 70A power stages with ProCool II connectors, alloy chokes, and durable capacitors.

Comprehensive Cooling

The 14th Gen Motherboard incorporates a large VRM heatsink for capacitors and chokes, as well as integrated double-sided M.2 heatsinks and a unique PCH fanless heatsink, to ensure your system remains cool under heavy loads, delivering better thermal performance while preventing throttling. Fan Xpert 4 software and hybrid fan headers control fans and liquid pump elements for enhanced cooling that can be customized.

ROG SupremeFX 7.1 Surround Sound High Definition Audio

Immerse yourself in your favorite games with the help of high-fidelity audio powered by the Savitech SV3H712 amplifier and ROG SupremeFX 7.1-channel ALC4080 codec. Premium capacitors and audio jacks with gold plating enhance audio conductivity for a dependable signal and reduce static and other interference.

Leading Connectivity

The ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-E GAMING WIFI ATX Motherboard provides reliable connectivity for your peripherals between the internal headers and the backplate. Webcams, microphones, and external storage drives can transfer data at speeds of up to 5 and 10 Gb/s through USB-A and USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 and Gen 2 ports, respectively. For devices that require a lot of resources, like storage arrays and audio interfaces, a USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 port offers up to 20 Gb/s data transfer speed. In addition to facilitating data transfer, a front panel USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 port provides up to 30W Power Delivery to charge and support peripherals that require a lot of resources. With an internal Thunderbolt 4 header, you can increase your connectivity and take advantage of high-speed connectivity that supports quick transfer rates and Power Delivery technologies.

Asus ROG STRIX Z790-H GAMING WIFI DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-H GAMING WIFI DDR5 14th 13th & 14th Gen ATX Motherboard is a top-of-the-line motherboard designed for gamers and enthusiasts looking to build a high-performance PC. It is equipped with an Intel LGA 1700 socket, making it ready for use with 13th-generation Intel Core and 12th-generation Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors. The motherboard features a robust power solution with 16 + 1 power stages rated for 80A, dual ProCool II power connectors, high-quality alloy chokes, and durable capacitors, providing stable power to support the latest multicore processors. It also boasts optimized VRM thermals with massive heat sinks connected by an L-shaped heat pipe, high-conductivity thermal pads, and an integrated I/O shroud. With four PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots all with heatsinks, including the tallest having a combo sink extension and backplate for additional cooling, the motherboard provides extensive M.2 support. Additionally, it offers abundant connectivity with a USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C rear I/O port and additional front panel connector, seven USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 1 ports, PCIe 5.0 x16 SafeSlot, HDMI 2.1, and DisplayPort 1.4. The motherboard is equipped with built-in WiFi 6E (802.11ax) and 2.5Gb Intel Ethernet with ASUS LANGuard for high-performance networking. It also features intelligent control with ASUS-exclusive AI overclocking, AI II cooling, AI networking, and bi-directional AI noise cancellation to simplify setup and improve performance.

This Asus LGA1851 motherboard provides the power and speed required for premium gaming and sophisticated AI PC applications. products.description:
ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI LGA1851 ATX Motherboard

The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI is a high-end ATX motherboard designed for Intel Core Ultra Processors (Series 2), featuring the LGA1851 socket and Intel Z890 chipset. It supports Intel Turbo Boost Technology 2.0 and 3.0, as well as high-speed DDR5 memory support for up to 256GB across four DIMM slots at rates of 9200+MT/s (OC). The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI Motherboard includes a dual-channel memory architecture, Intel XMP, DIMM Flex, NitroPath DRAM Technology, and ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile III (AEMP III). One DisplayPort, one HDMI port, and two Thunderbolt 4 ports provide 8K@60Hz output, with extra USB Type-C DP alt mode capability. One PCIe 5.0 x16 slot and one PCIe 4.0 x16 slot are dedicated to expansion. The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI LGA1851 Motherboard has seven M.2 slots and four SATA 6Gb/s connections for storage, with M.2_1, M.2_3, and M.2_4 supporting PCIe 5.0 x4 as well as PCIe and SATA RAID. The network configuration comprises Realtek 5Gb Ethernet with LANGuard and 2x2 Wi-Fi 7 with Bluetooth v5.4. The rear USB ports feature two Thunderbolt 4 Type-C, nine USB 10Gbps, and three USB 5Gbps. The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI LGA1851 ATX Motherboard features a front panel with one USB 20Gbps Type-C, four USB 5Gbps, and six USB 2.0 connections. The ROG SupremeFX ALC4080 codec provides 7.1 surround sound, gold-plated jacks, a Savitech amplifier, S/PDIF output, and premium capacitors. The internal connectors include fan headers, an AIO pump, a temperature sensor, and several RGB headers. ASUS Q-Design with M.2 Q-Latch and PCIe Slot Q-Release, robust thermal solutions for M.2 and VRM, and software such as Armoury Crate, Aura Creator, Fan Xpert 4, and AI Overclocking are among the standout features. The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI LGA1851 ATX Motherboard runs Windows 11 (22H2 and later), has a 256Mb UEFI BIOS, and includes proprietary tools such as BIOS FlashBack, USB Wattage Watcher, and Dolby Atmos support, making it an excellent choice for performance-driven PC setups.

ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-H GAMING WIFI LGA1851 ATX Motherboard

The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-H GAMING WIFI ATX Motherboard is a high-performance gaming and enthusiast board designed to support the latest Intel Core Ultra Processors (Series 2) using the LGA1851 socket, powered by the advanced Intel Z890 chipset. The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-H GAMING WIFI Motherboard supports up to 256GB of DDR5 RAM across 4 DIMM slots, with overclocking speeds reaching 9066+ MT/s, enhanced by cutting-edge technologies like DIMM Flex, NitroPath DRAM, AEMP III, and Intel XMP. For visual output, it includes 1x HDMI 2.1 and 1x DisplayPort 1.4, supporting resolutions up to 8K@60Hz and 4K@60Hz, making it ideal for next-gen displays. Storage and speed are at the core of the ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-H GAMING WIFI, featuring 4x M.2 slots (PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0/SATA supported) and 4x SATA 6Gb/s ports, backed by Intel Rapid Storage Technology with RAID 0/1/5/10 support. Connectivity is ultra-fast with Realtek 5Gb Ethernet, Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) delivering up to 5.8Gbps, and Bluetooth 5.4 for superior wireless performance. The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-H GAMING WIFI Motherboard also delivers studio-grade sound with the Realtek ALC1220P 7.1 Surround Sound Audio CODEC, Savitech SV3H712 AMP, and gold-plated audio jacks, ensuring immersive audio experiences. The rear I/O includes 10 USB ports (including dual USB Type-C 20Gbps with 30W PD fast charging), while the front panel offers 7 more USB connections. The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-H GAMING WIFI ATX Motherboard is built with premium durability, featuring 5K black metallic capacitors, VRM and M.2 heatsinks, ProCool II power connectors, and Q-Design elements like Q-Latch, Q-Release, and Q-Antenna for easy DIY installation. Enhanced cooling is supported by multiple fan headers, a thermal sensor, and AI Cooling II via Fan Xpert 4. Bundled software includes Armoury Crate, ROG CPU-Z, Aura Sync, Dolby Atmos, and trial versions of AIDA64 Extreme, Norton 360 for Gamers, and Adobe Creative Cloud. Overall, the ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-H GAMING WIFI Motherboard is an ideal choice for gamers, overclockers, and PC enthusiasts seeking elite performance, top-tier features, and future-proof connectivity.

It comes with ASUS TUF PROTECTION features for enhanced durability, ASUS Q-Design for easy installation and maintenance, and ASUS Thermal Solution for efficient cooling. ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II LGA1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard

The ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II is a powerful micro-ATX motherboard based on the Intel B760 chipset. It supports Intel Core 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation processors, including Pentium Gold and Celeron, using the LGA1700 socket. It supports Intel Turbo Boost Technology 2.0 and 3.0, which provides high-performance computing. This ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II Motherboard has four DDR5 DIMM slots that can accommodate up to 192GB of memory at speeds up to 7800+MT/s (OC) in dual-channel architecture. It supports Intel XMP and ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile II (AEMP II) for better tweaking. The graphics output features one DisplayPort 1.4 and one HDMI 2.1 connector, both of which enable 4K at 60Hz. Expansion slots include a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot from the CPU, one PCIe 4.0 x4, and one PCIe 3.0 x1. Asus ROG STRIX B850-G GAMING WIFI mATX Motherboard

The ASUS TUF GAMING B850-BTF WIFI W ATX Motherboard is a robust and innovative Asus TUF Gaming Motherboard designed for builders who demand high-end performance and advanced cable management in full-size builds. As part of the forward-looking Asus BTF Motherboard lineup, it features the AMD B850 chipset and supports Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors via the AM5 socket, ensuring exceptional power and compatibility for gaming and creative workloads. This Asus 850 Motherboard supports up to 256GB of DDR5 memory with speeds reaching beyond 8000 MT/s (OC), enhanced with AMD EXPO and ASUS AEMP profiles for seamless memory tuning. Unique to the BTF design, all connectors are cleverly placed at the rear, enabling ultra-clean cable routing and a sleek finish when paired with compatible cases and GPUs featuring hidden power delivery—up to 600W directly via the board. As a top-tier Asus B850 BTF Motherboard, it incorporates a 14+2+1 power stage design with 80A stages, ProCool connectors, premium alloy chokes, and massive VRM heatsinks to ensure stable voltage under heavy loads. Storage and expansion are future-ready with three M.2 slots (including one PCIe 5.0 x4), four SATA 6Gb/s ports, and PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 expansion slots, while this high-performance Asus WiFi Motherboard includes cutting-edge WiFi 7, Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet, and HDMI/DisplayPort outputs for versatile connectivity. USB support is extensive with USB 20Gbps Type-C, USB 10Gbps front panel ports, and a rich selection of rear I/O for comprehensive peripheral support. Audio is delivered through the Realtek ALC1220P codec with DTS and premium signal isolation, providing crystal-clear sound for immersive gaming and media. DIY enhancements like PCIe Slot Q-Release Slim, M.2 Q-Latch, Q-Antenna, BIOS FlashBack, and Q-LEDs simplify installation and maintenance, while three Gen 2 ARGB headers and Aura Sync lighting enable bold customization. Altogether, the ASUS TUF GAMING B850-BTF WIFI W ATX Motherboard blends performance, innovation, and visual refinement, making it a standout choice among modern Asus Motherboards for gamers and creators building clean and powerful desktop systems.

The Asus TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard is a high-performance platform engineered for gamers and professionals, offering full compatibility with AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors via the advanced AM5 socket and powered by the latest chipset technology. The Asus TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI ATX Motherboard supports up to 256GB of DDR5 RAM across 4 DIMM slots, with speeds reaching 8000+ MT/s (OC) and enhanced compatibility through AMD EXPO and ASUS AEMP profiles. products.description:
ASUS TUF GAMING Z790-PLUS WIFI D4 ATX Motherboard

ASUS TUF GAMING Z790-PLUS WIFI D4 Motherboard comes with LGA 1700 socket and Z790 chipset. It supports 14th Gen, 13th Gen Intel Core Processors & 12th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron Processors. The motherboard has 4x DDR4 Dual-Channel RAM slots that allow you to equip up to 128GB of memory for enhanced multitasking capabilities and complex photo and video rendering. ASUS TUF GAMING Z790-PLUS WIFI D4 Motherboard also supports 4 x M.2 slots and 4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports so you can build a large library of storage drives for your games or creative projects. while PCIe 5.0 x16, 4.0 x16, 4.0 x4, and two 3.0 x1 slots accommodate adapter cards. Connect to wired peripherals through two USB-A 3.2 Gen 2 and four 3.2 Gen 1 ports, or two USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 and four 3.2 Gen 2 ports. DisplayPort 1.4 or HDMI 2.1 interfaces are used to output video. An RJ45 port enables 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet, and the bundled antenna supports Wi-Fi 6. The rear I/O panel also includes five 1/8" audio jacks and a digital audio S/PDIF output. Fans, Clear CMOS, Thunderbolt 4, RGB lighting, and front-panel USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 and USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 and 2.0 ports are all supported by internal headers. The ASUS TUF GAMING Z-790 PLUS WIFI D4 LGA 1700 ATX Motherboard is 64-bit compatible with Windows 10 and later.

Enhanced Power Solution

The ASUS TUF GAMING Z790-PLUS WIFI D4 delivers consistent power throughout the entire motherboard, preserving electrical volume whether you are performing simple chores or operating at full power during resource-demanding procedures. It is equipped with a 16+1 Phase Power DrMOS, six-layer PCB, ProCool sockets, alloy chokes, and durable capacitors that allow for stable power delivery.

Comprehensive Cooling

The ASUS TUF GAMING Z790-PLUS WIFI D4 motherboard has a large VRM heatsink for capacitors and chokes, as well as integrated M.2 heatsinks and backplates for greater thermal performance and throttling prevention. Fan Xpert 4 software and hybrid fan headers control fans and liquid cooling elements for increased cooling that may be customized.

Connectivity to the Core

Fast internals and accessories can be connected to via PCIe 5.0 and Thunderbolt 4 headers, as well as a front-panel USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 port. USB 3.2 Gen 2 doubles the speed of its predecessor, with a maximum throughput of 10 Gb/s when utilized with compatible devices, and is synonymous with USB 3.1 Gen 2.

Aura Sync RGB Effects

This 14th Gen Motherboard offers an edge lighting design, addressable RGB headers, and RGB strip header support to let you set the mood for your favorite games.

products.description:
ASUS TUF GAMING Z790-PLUS WIFI DDR5 Motherboard

The ASUS TUF GAMING Z790-PLUS WIFI DDR5 Motherboard adds performance and connectivity to your project. This motherboard supports 14th Generation Intel CPUs by utilizing the Intel Z790 chipset and LGA 1700 socket. Up to 128GB of DDR5 RAM may be installed across four memory slots. There are four M.2 and four SATA III connections for storage, as well as PCIe 5.0 x16, 4.0 x16, 4.0 x4, and two 3.0 x1 slots for adaptor cards. Connect to wired peripherals through two USB-A 3.2 Gen 2 and four 3.2 Gen 1 ports, or two USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 and four 3.2 Gen 2 ports. DisplayPort 1.4 or HDMI 2.1 interfaces are used to output video. Its RJ45 connection enables 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet, and the bundled antenna supports Wi-Fi 6E. The rear I/O panel also includes five 1/8" audio connectors and a digital audio S/PDIF output. Fans, Clear CMOS, Thunderbolt 4, RGB lighting, and front-panel USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 and USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 and 2.0 ports are all supported through internal headers. The ASUS TUF GAMING Z-790 PLUS WIFI LGA 1700 ATX Motherboard is Windows 10 and 11 64-bit compatible.

Enhanced Power Solution

The ASUS TUF GAMING Z790-PLUS WIFI DDR5 Motherboard delivers consistent power throughout the entire motherboard, preserving electrical volume whether you are performing simple chores or operating at full power during resource-demanding procedures. It is equipped with a 16+1 Phase Power DrMOS, six-layer PCB, ProCool sockets, alloy chokes, and durable capacitors that allow for stable power delivery.

Connectivity to the Core

Fast internals and accessories can be connected to via PCIe 5.0 and Thunderbolt 4 headers, as well as a front-panel USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 port. USB 3.2 Gen 2 doubles the speed of its predecessor, with a maximum throughput of 10 Gb/s when utilized with compatible devices, and is synonymous with USB 3.1 Gen 2.

Aura Sync RGB Effects

The ASUS TUF GAMING Z790-PLUS WIFI DDR5 14th Gen Motherboard offers an edge lighting design, addressable RGB headers, and RGB strip header support to let you set the mood for your favorite games.

ASUS TUF GAMING Z890-PLUS WIFI LGA1851 ATX Motherboard

The ASUS TUF GAMING Z890-PLUS WIFI motherboard is a high-performance option intended for professionals and gamers. supporting Intel Turbo Boost Technology 2.0 and 3.0 on Intel Core Ultra CPUs (Series 2). With four DIMM slots that handle up to 256GB of DDR5 RAM at rates surpassing 9066 MT/s, this Asus Z890 motherboard, which has the potent Intel Z890 chipset, delivers remarkable memory capabilities. ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile III and Intel XMP further boost this performance. With DisplayPort, HDMI, and Thunderbolt 4, the ASUS TUF GAMING Z890-PLUS WIFI Motherboard offers a wide range of graphics output capabilities, including up to 8K at 60Hz resolution. PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 slots for GPUs and add-ons offer expansion choices, and four M.2 slots and four SATA 6Gb/s ports, with RAID configurations available, meet storage needs. With military-grade parts, an enhanced power supply, and a thorough cooling system, this Asus TUF Gaming Z890 motherboard surpasses expectations in terms of reliable and steady performance for extended gaming sessions. To make sure they can withstand situations where others could fail, the ASUS TUF GAMING Z890-PLUS WIFI motherboard is also put through a thorough endurance test. The power and connectivity required by sophisticated AI PC applications are provided by this platform. With dual-band Wi-Fi 7 for lightning-fast speeds up to 2.9Gbps, Bluetooth 5.4, and Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet, the ASUS TUF GAMING Z890-PLUS WIFI motherboard boasts cutting-edge connectivity. Front panel USB headers and rear ports with Thunderbolt 4, USB-C, and Type-A connections are examples of extensive USB support. With support for high-resolution playback and exceptional clarity and immersive experiences, Realtek ALC1220P 7.1 Surround Sound elevates audio. With ASUS TUF PROTECTION features including ESD guards, SafeSlot, and overvoltage protection, the sturdy ASUS TUF GAMING Z890-PLUS WIFI motherboard ensures long-term dependability. Multiple fan headers, an AIO pump header, M.2 heatsinks, and VRM heatsinks maximize its thermal management. M.2 Q-Latch and PCIe Slot Q-Release are two examples of ASUS Q-Design technologies that make installation and maintenance easier.

Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W AM5 ATX Motherboard

The Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W AM5 ATX Motherboard is a powerhouse platform engineered for high-end gaming and content creation. Built on the latest AMD X870 chipset, it supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors via the AM5 socket, delivering top-tier performance and future-ready features. This Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W Motherboard supports up to 256GB of DDR5 RAM across four DIMM slots, with overclocking capabilities reaching 8000+ MT/s, along with ECC/Non-ECC support, dual-channel architecture, AMD EXPO, and ASUS AEMP profiles for enhanced memory tuning. For graphics, the Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W AM5 ATX Motherboard provides an HDMI 2.1 port and two USB4 Type-C ports supporting up to 4K@60Hz output, depending on CPU specifications. Expansion options include a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for Ryzen 9000/7000 CPUs, additional PCIe 4.0 and 3.0 slots, and three M.2 slots (PCIe 5.0 & 4.0), along with four SATA 6Gb/s ports. RAID configurations are supported via AMD RAIDXpert2, including RAID 0/1/5/10 for Ryzen 9000 processors. This Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W motherboard offers comprehensive connectivity, including 2 x USB4 (40Gbps), 10 rear USB ports, 7 front USB ports (with a USB 20Gbps Type-C supporting 30W PD fast-charging), and Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet. Wireless features include Wi-Fi 6 with 2.4/5GHz support and Bluetooth 5.2. Audiophiles will appreciate the premium Realtek 7.1 Surround Sound High Definition Audio CODEC, which supports 24-bit/192kHz playback, audio shielding, and premium capacitors. Internally, the Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W AM5 ATX Motherboard features multiple fan headers, addressable RGB Gen 2 headers, SPI TPM, S/PDIF out, and front audio connectors. ASUS-exclusive features like Q-Design (M.2 Q-Latch, PCIe Q-Release, Q-LEDs), 5X Protection III (DIGI+ VRM, SafeSlot, LANGuard), and pre-mounted I/O shield enhance durability and ease of installation. The motherboard supports advanced cooling via VRM and M.2 heatsinks, while Fan Xpert 4 offers AI-powered thermal control. With Aura Sync RGB, BIOS Flashback, and bundled software like Armoury Crate, Aura Creator, ASUS DriverHub, and more, the Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W Motherboard is the ultimate choice for gamers and PC enthusiasts seeking performance, reliability, and customization.

Asus X870 MAX GAMING WIFI7 W AM5 ATX Motherboard

The Asus X870 MAX GAMING WIFI7 W AM5 ATX Motherboard is a powerhouse platform designed for elite gamers and creators, supporting AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors via the AM5 socket. Built on the cutting-edge AMD X870 chipset, the Asus X870 MAX GAMING WIFI7 W delivers next-gen performance with support for up to 256GB of DDR5 RAM across 4 DIMM slots, overclockable to 8000+ MT/s. For graphics, it includes one HDMI 2.1 port and two USB4 Type-C ports with DisplayPort 1.4a, enabling up to 4K@60Hz video output depending on the processor. This Asus X870 MAX GAMING WIFI7 W ATX Motherboard provides extensive expandability with one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot (for Ryzen 9000/7000), additional PCIe 4.0 and 3.0 slots, and three M.2 slots with PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 interface, plus four SATA 6Gb/s ports supporting RAID 0/1/5/10 (on Ryzen 9000). Note: certain ports share bandwidth and can be managed via BIOS settings. For connectivity, the Asus X870 MAX GAMING WIFI7 W includes 2 x USB4 (40Gbps) ports, 10 rear USB ports, 7 front USB ports (including USB 20Gbps Type-C with 30W fast-charging), and Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet. Wireless features include Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) and Bluetooth 5.2. Audio is driven by Realtek 7.1 Surround Sound High Definition Audio, offering jack detection, multi-streaming, and 24-bit/192kHz quality with premium components. The Asus X870 MAX GAMING WIFI7 W AM5 ATX Motherboard also features extensive internal I/O including multiple fan headers, RGB Gen 2 headers, TPM, S/PDIF, and COM ports. products.description:
ASUS Z790-AYW WIFI W II LGA1700 ATX Motherboard

The ASUS Z790-AYW WIFI W II LGA1700 ATX motherboard is a high-performance platform that supports Intel's newest 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron CPUs. The ASUS motherboard employs the powerful Intel Z790 chipset. It supports Intel Turbo Boost Technology 2.0 and 3.0, allowing for more powerful and efficient computing. It has four DDR5 DIMM slots and can support up to 192GB of high-speed memory at rates of up to 8000MHz (OC). Intel XMP and OptiMem II technology are also included for improved memory reliability and performance. The ASUS Z790-AYW WIFI W II motherboard has numerous expansion slots, including a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot and several PCIe 4.0 and 3.0 slots for sophisticated graphics and peripherals. Storage options are extensive, with three M.2 slots and four SATA 6Gb/s connectors that allow PCIe and SATA RAID setups. With Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet and ASUS LANGuard protection, networking is quick and dependable. The ASUS Z790-AYW WIFI W II LGA1700 ATX motherboard's integrated Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3 provide high-speed wireless communication over dual 2.4/5GHz bands. The rear I/O panel has eight USB ports, including USB 10Gbps Type-A and Type-C, HDMI, audio jacks, and a BIOS FlashBack button for simple firmware changes. The ASUS Z790-AYW WIFI W II ATX motherboard's front panel features nine more USB ports, including a USB 10Gbps Type-C header. The audio is powered by a Realtek 7.1 surround sound codec with superior capacitors and shielding for immersive sound. The ASUS WIFI motherboard offers complete RGB customization via Aura Sync and has numerous Gen 2 addressable RGB connectors. Cooling is improved with multiple fan headers, AIO pump support, and dedicated VRM and M.2 heatsinks. The ASUS Z790-AYW WIFI W II LGA1700 ATX motherboard also includes ASUS-exclusive innovations like Q-Latch, Q-DIMM, Q-LED, and a pre-installed I/O shield for easy installation. It is designed in the ATX form factor and runs Windows 10 and 11, offering it a future-proof base for any performance-driven PC build.

GIGABYTE is reputable for its product durability and high standard of the manufactured process. Needless to say, we use the best, high-quality components on B550 motherboards and reinforce each part of the components to be solid and durable. The GIGABYTE B450M DS3H V2 Micro-ATX Motherboard Supports AMD Ryzen 5000 series / Ryzen 5000 G-Series/ 3rd Gen Ryzen/ 2nd Gen Ryzen/ 1st Gen Ryzen/ 2nd Gen Ryzen with Radeon Vega Graphics/ 1st Gen Ryzen with Radeon Vega Graphics/ Athlon with Radeon Vega Graphics Processors. The DS3H is constructed using AMD's B450 chipset, providing you access to an AM4 CPU socket that works with specific Ryzen processors. You can install different memory modules for faster multitasking with the help of four dual-channel DIMMs. Utilize the four SATA III ports and one M.2 PCIe connector to benefit from increased storage capacity. Install many graphics and utility cards using a single PCIe x16 slot. Utility cards can also be installed in PCIe x4 and x1 slots.

Ultimate Power Design

The Gigabyte B450M DS3H V2 Micro ATX Motherboard's glass fabric printed circuit board and 4+2 phase digital VRM solution design balance voltage, prevent moisture and stabilize system performance. This board can easily handle a range of current levels due to the improvement in transient response provided by digital PWM and Low RDS(on) MOSFET components. Connectors with solid pins encourage toughness and conductivity for reliable electrical connections. Resistors are given an extra layer of safety by having an anti-sulfur design, which stops impurities from damaging your motherboard and causing component failure. Furthermore, this motherboard complies with CEC 2019 criteria and is approved by the California Energy Commission.

Networking Connectivity

Gigabyte B450M DS3H V2 comes with an 8118 Gaming LAN adapter, which is necessary for competitive online gaming and live broadcasting, enables faster network rates. The multi-gig configurations are also backward compatible with this.

Hi-Fi Audio

The Gigabyte B450M DS3H V2 is designed for gaming and media aficionados, with high-quality audio components and Audio Noise Guard with LED trace route lighting to deliver a deep and immersive audio experience.

Smart Fan 5

Smart Fan 5, a free suite focused on ensuring your components work properly, may be used to monitor your build's cooling performance. Five temperature sensors, as well as three hybrid fan headers, are distributed throughout the board to provide optimal control and cooling. When the appropriate temperature is reached, the fans shut down automatically, extending fan life.

products.description:
Gigabyte B450M DS3H V3 AMD AM4 Micro ATX Motherboard

The Gigabyte B450M DS3H V3 is a compact yet powerful Micro ATX motherboard engineered for AMD AM4 socket processors, making it a versatile foundation for gaming rigs, productivity setups, and budget-friendly builds. With robust support for a wide range of AMD Ryzen CPUs including the latest Ryzen 5000 Series, 5000G, 4000G, and earlier generations with Radeon Vega Graphics and Athlon processors this Gigabyte motherboard ensures future-ready compatibility and performance scalability. Powered by the reliable AMD B450 chipset, it features four DDR4 DIMM slots supporting up to 128GB of system memory, dual-channel architecture, and XMP profiles for enhanced memory tuning. Whether you're running DDR4 2933 or stepping down to 2133 MT/s, the Gigabyte B450M DS3H V3 motherboard handles both ECC and non-ECC unbuffered modules with ease, offering flexibility for creators and multitaskers alike. Graphics output is handled via an integrated HDMI 2.1 port with support for 4K resolution at 60Hz and HDCP 2.2, making it ideal for media streaming, casual gaming, or multi-monitor productivity. Audio is powered by Realtek HD codec, delivering immersive 7.1-channel sound with S/PDIF Out support and customizable jack functionality through bundled software. Networking is seamless thanks to the Realtek Gigabit LAN chip, ensuring stable and fast internet connectivity for online gaming, streaming, or remote work. Expansion options include one PCIe 3.0 x16 slot for high-performance GPUs, a secondary PCIe x16 slot running at x1, and a PCIe x1 slot for additional cards. Storage is future-proofed with a high-speed M.2 connector supporting both SATA and PCIe NVMe SSDs (up to 22110 form factor), alongside four SATA 6Gb/s ports with RAID 0, 1, and 10 support for data redundancy and speed. USB connectivity is generous, with four USB 3.1 Gen 1 ports on the rear I/O, two more via internal headers, and six USB 2.0 ports for legacy peripherals. The Gigabyte B450M DS3H V3 AMD AM4 also includes RGB Fusion support with multiple LED headers standard and addressable allowing builders to customize lighting effects and sync with other RGB components. Smart Fan control, temperature and voltage monitoring, and fail warnings ensure thermal stability and system longevity. BIOS features include a 128Mbit AMI UEFI BIOS with support for Q-Flash and Xpress Install, making updates and setup intuitive even for first-time builders. Bundled with Norton Internet Security and LAN bandwidth management software, the B450M DS3H V3 is optimized for secure, high-speed performance. It supports Windows 11, 10, and even Windows 7 (with Pinnacle Ridge or Summit Ridge CPUs), making it a flexible choice for users with legacy systems or modern OS needs. Measuring 24.4cm x 21.5cm, this Gigabyte B450M DS3H V3 Micro ATX motherboard fits comfortably in most mid-tower and compact cases, offering a perfect blend of affordability, reliability, and feature-rich design for DIY PC enthusiasts, gamers, and professionals alike.

GIGABYTE B450M H AMD AM4 Micro-ATX Motherboard

GIGABYTE AM4 motherboards are ready to support the latest AMD Ryzen 3000 Processors and are backward compatible with AMD Ryzen 2000 and 1000 Processors. With a rich list of features on GIGABYTE AM4 motherboards such as Armor for PCIe/ memory slots, USB Type-C interfaces on select boards, refined audio quality, high-speed Ethernet, and the latest standard WIFI design, GIGABYTE AM4 motherboards are perfect for users looking to build the best AMD platform systems. GIGABYTE 400-series motherboards maximize your PC's potential with AMD StoreMI technology. StoreMI accelerates traditional storage devices to reduce boot times and enhance the overall user experience. This easy-to-use utility combines the speed of SSDs with the high capacity of HDDs into a single drive, enhances the read/write speeds of the device to match that of SSDs, bolsters data performance for incredible value, and transforms the everyday PC to a performance-driven system. GIGABYTE M.2 solution offers considerably faster storage performance and support for both PCIe and SATA interfaces for M.2 SSD devices. Realtek 8118 LAN is a high performance and friendly network chip for gaming players with automatic bandwidth allocation to ensure the highest network priority of the game or application. It can provide users the most comprehensive features and the fastest and smoothest Internet experience. With Smart Fan, 5 users can ensure that their gaming PC can maintain its performance while staying cool. Smart Fan 5 allows users to interchange their fan headers to reflect different thermal sensors at different locations on the motherboard. Not only that, with Smart Fan, but 5 more hybrid fan headers that support both PWM and Voltage mode fans have also been introduced to make the motherboard more liquid cooling friendly. Achieve fan silence. With Fan Stop, map any fan to stop completely when temperatures drop below a specified threshold. Which fan stops, based on readings from which sensor, and at what temperatureâ€”all of it can be customized to your liking. GIGABYTE motherboards use high-end audio capacitors. These high-quality capacitors help deliver high resolution and high fidelity audio to provide the most realistic sound effects for gamers. GIGABYTE motherboards use ICs with up to 3 times the ESD resistance levels compared to traditional ICs. This helps to better protect the motherboard and its components against potential damage caused by static electricity. GIGABYTE motherboards also feature special anti-surge ICs that protect your motherboard, and your PC from any surge in power delivery that may occur, helping to ensure that your PC is equipped to deal with any potentially irregular and inconsistent power delivery. GIGABYTE motherboards use Low RDS(on) MOSFETs which reduce energy wastage through unnecessary residual heat dissipation. This all amounts to tangible energy savings which are beneficial for both end-users and the environment without impacting system performance.

High-End Audio Capacitors

GIGABYTE motherboards use high-end audio capacitors. These high quality capacitors help deliver high resolution and high fidelity audio to provide the most realistic sound effects for gamers. GIGABYTE motherboards feature an audio noise guard that essentially separates the boardâ€™s sensitive analog audio components from potential noise pollution at the PCB level.

RGB FUSION 2.0

Gigabyte B550M K WIFI6E AMD AM4 mATX Motherboard

The Gigabyte B550M K WIFI6E Motherboard is built for gamers, creators, and professionals who demand stability, speed, and next-generation connectivity. Powered by the AMD B550 chipset, this Gigabyte Ryzen Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 5000, 4000 G-Series, and 3000 Series processors, delivering reliable performance in a compact micro ATX form factor.

Powerful CPU and Memory Support

Designed for AMD Socket AM4, the Gigabyte B550M Motherboard supports the latest Ryzen processors with advanced PCIe 4.0 compatibility. With four DDR4 DIMM slots, it supports up to 128GB memory with speeds reaching DDR4 4733(O.C.), ensuring extreme bandwidth for multitasking and gaming. Dual-channel architecture, ECC and non-ECC DIMM support, plus XMP compatibility make this Gigabyte Motherboard versatile for performance-driven builds.

Graphics and Expansion

Integrated graphics deliver stunning visuals with DisplayPort 1.4 (up to 5120×2880@60Hz) and HDMI 2.1 (up to 4096×2160@60Hz), both supporting HDR and HDCP 2.3. Expansion options include PCIe 4.0 x16 for Ryzen 5000/3000 processors and PCIe 3.0 x16 for Ryzen G-Series processors, plus a PCIe 3.0 x1 slot for add-in cards. This ensures compatibility with modern GPUs and peripherals.

Connectivity and Storage

The Gigabyte WiFi Motherboard offers extensive connectivity with 4 × USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports, 2 × USB 3.2 Gen 1 headers, and 6 × USB 2.0 ports. Networking is powered by Realtek GbE LAN and integrated Wi-Fi 6E for ultra-fast wireless connections. Storage options include dual M.2 slots (PCIe 4.0/3.0 support depending on CPU) and 4 × SATA 6Gb/s connectors with RAID 0, 1, and 10 support, ensuring flexible and high-speed storage solutions.

Audio and Special Features

Powered by Realtek HD Audio CODEC, the Gigabyte B550M K WIFI6E Motherboard delivers 2/4/5.1/7.1-channel high-definition audio. Special features include Gigabyte APP Center, @BIOS, EasyTune, Smart Backup, System Information Viewer, Q-Flash, and Xpress Install. Bundled software includes Norton Internet Security OEM and LAN bandwidth management tools, enhancing both security and performance.

Compact and Reliable Design

With a micro ATX form factor (24.4cm × 24.4cm), the Gigabyte B550M K WIFI6E AMD AM4 Motherboard fits seamlessly into compact builds while offering robust features. Internal I/O includes CPU and system fan headers, TPM support, and front panel connectors, making it a reliable foundation for modern gaming and productivity setups.

HDMI 2.1, which is backward compatible with HDMI 2.0/ 1.4 and offering 48 Gb/s of bandwidth â€“ twice times more than the previous generation. This unlocks the potential for users to transfer multiple video streams, as well as a native cinematic 21:9 ratio (which most movies are shot in), Full HDR, and HDCP 2.3 support, to offer the best visual experience for viewers. GIGABYTE motherboards use high-end audio capacitors. These high-quality capacitors help deliver high resolution and high fidelity audio to provide the most realistic sound effects for gamers. GIGABYTE motherboards feature an audio noise guard that essentially separates the boardâ€™s sensitive analog audio components from potential noise pollution at the PCB level. With Smart Fan, 5 users can ensure that their gaming PC can maintain its performance while staying cool. Smart Fan 5 allows users to interchange their fan headers to reflect different thermal sensors at different locations on the motherboard. Not only that, with Smart Fan, but 5 more hybrid fan headers that support both PWM and Voltage mode fans have also been introduced to make the motherboard more liquid cooling friendly. Achieve fan silence. With Fan Stop, map any fan to stop completely when temperatures drop below a specified threshold. Which fan stops, based on readings from which sensor, and at what temperatureâ€”all of it can be customized to your liking. With B550 Motherboards, RGB Fusion 2.0 is even better with Addressable LEDs. RGB Fusion 2.0 offers users the option to control onboard RGB and external RGB / Addressable LED light strips* for their PC build. Already feature filled with colors and patterns, RGB Fusion 2.0 is now upgraded to improve the Addressable LED support. With external Addressable LED strips, where each LED is digitally addressable that users can experience even more patterns, styles, and illuminations. From motherboards, graphics cards to the peripheral products, you can personalize your gaming rig with your own style and show off your build by sharing the profiles. In addition, the new gaming mode makes the lighting effects interactive with selected games to bring you the most immersive gaming experience. With GIGABYTE Q-Flash Plus, you donâ€™t need to install the CPU, memory, and graphics card nor enter the BIOS menu to flash the BIOS. Just download and save a new BIOS file (rename to gigabyte.bin) on the USB flash drive, then press the dedicated Q-Flash Plus button and youâ€™re good to go! GIGABYTE B650 AORUS ELITE AX DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650 AORUS ELITE AX Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 8000 & 7000-series processors for socket AM5. It also supports Multi-Gig(10/100/1000/2500Mbps) RJ-45 Ethernet. The USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports provide speeds up to 10Gbps. With twice the bandwidth compared to its previous generation, The GIGABYTE B650 AORUS ELITE AX Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

products.description:
GIGABYTE B650 EAGLE AX DDR5 AM5 Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650 EAGLE AX DDR5 AM5 Motherboard is designed to support AMD's latest Ryzen 7000 and 8000 series processors, offering unparalleled performance for both gaming and professional applications. This motherboard features a robust 12+2+2 phase digital VRM solution, ensuring stable power delivery and efficient performance under heavy workloads. With its dual-channel DDR5 memory support, the board includes 4 SMD DIMM slots compatible with AMD EXPO and Intel XMP memory modules, providing enhanced performance and flexibility. The motherboard's SuperSpeed storage features, which include two PCIe 4.0 M.2 and one PCIe 5.0 M.2 connection, allow for quick data access and transfer. VRM power stability and excellent performance for 25110 M.2 SSDs are guaranteed by its sophisticated thermal design, which includes an M.2 thermal protection. The GIGABYTE B650 UD AC is a high-performance ATX motherboard designed for AMD's latest processors, utilizing the AM5 socket to support AMD Ryzen 7000, 8000, and 9000 series processors. It offers robust performance and advanced features suitable for gaming and professional applications. The motherboard features a 6+2+2 phases digital VRM solution, ensuring stable and efficient power delivery, even under heavy loads, which supports overclocking and maintains system stability. It supports dual-channel DDR5 memory with four SMD DIMM slots, accommodating high-speed RAM modules and offering AMD EXPO and Intel XMP profiles for easy overclocking. Network connectivity is ensured through built-in Wi-Fi 802.11ac and a Gigabit Ethernet LAN port, offering fast and reliable options for online gaming and streaming. The motherboard also includes DisplayPort and HDMI outputs, supporting high-resolution displays and multiple monitor setups. The rear I/O features high-speed USB 10Gb/s ports for quick data transfers and peripheral connectivity. The Smart Fan 6 technology provides comprehensive cooling management with multiple temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers, including a FAN STOP function for quieter operation. The Q-Flash Plus feature allows users to update the BIOS without needing to install a CPU, memory, or graphics card, simplifying firmware updates. Overall, the GIGABYTE B650 UD AC is a well-rounded motherboard offering high-end features and connectivity for building a powerful and future-proof PC, making it an excellent choice for gamers, content creators, and enthusiasts alike.

products.description:
GIGABYTE B650 UD AX AMD AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650 UD AX AMD AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard is a high-performance platform designed to support the latest AMD Ryzen 7000, 8000, and 9000 Series processors using the advanced AM5 socket. Built on the AMD B650 chipset and ATX form factor, GIGABYTE AMD Motherboard delivers exceptional speed, connectivity, and expandability for gamers, content creators, and professionals. It supports up to 256 gigabytes of DDR5 memory across four DIMM slots, with speeds reaching up to 8000 megatransfers per second when overclocked. The dual-channel memory architecture is compatible with AMD EXPO and Intel XMP profiles, enabling seamless overclocking and optimized performance for demanding applications. For graphics and expansion, the GIGABYTE AMD ATX Motherboard includes one PCI Express 4.0 x16 slot integrated into the CPU, ideal for high-end graphics cards or NVMe solid-state drives. Additional PCI Express 3.0 x1 slots provide flexibility for add-on cards, although availability may vary depending on the installed processor. Integrated graphics support includes DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.1 outputs, capable of delivering 4K resolution at high refresh rates for immersive visual experiences. Connectivity is future-ready with Realtek RTL8851 WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0, offering fast and stable wireless networking across dual 2.4 and 5 gigahertz bands. Wired networking is powered by the Realtek RTL8111H Gigabit LAN chip, ensuring reliable and high-speed Ethernet performance. The rear input and output panel features a wide range of ports, including USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A, USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C, USB 2.0, RJ-45 LAN, audio jacks, and legacy PS2 support for keyboard and mouse. Storage options are extensive, with three M.2 connectors supporting PCI Express 5.0 and 4.0 SSDs, depending on CPU compatibility, and four SATA 6 gigabits per second connectors for traditional drives. The GIGABYTE B650 UD AX supports RAID 0, RAID 1, and RAID 10 configurations for both NVMe and SATA devices, offering flexibility in performance and data redundancy. Audio is powered by the Realtek ALC897 codec, delivering high-definition 7.1-channel surround sound. Users can customize audio jack functionality through bundled software, ensuring optimal sound configuration for gaming, media consumption, or professional audio tasks. Internally, the GIGABYTE B650 UD AX includes a comprehensive array of headers and connectors such as RGB and addressable RGB Gen2 LED strip headers, multiple fan and pump headers for advanced cooling setups, USB 3.2 Gen 1 and USB 2.0 headers, TPM support, and a Q-Flash Plus button for easy BIOS updates. The BIOS is a licensed AMI UEFI interface with support for ACPI 5.0, DMI 2.7, and other advanced standards. Software support includes Windows 10 and Windows 11 64-bit editions, bundled Norton Internet Security OEM version, and GIGABYTE Control Center for system monitoring, RGB control, and performance tuning. Hardware monitoring features include voltage, temperature, fan speed, and water cooling flow rate detection, with fail warnings and speed control options. Measuring 30.5 centimeters by 24.4 centimeters, the ATX form factor ensures compatibility with a wide range of cases and cooling solutions. Whether building a next-generation gaming PC, a content creation powerhouse, or a future-ready workstation, the GIGABYTE B650 UD AX delivers the reliability, speed, and flexibility needed for modern computing.

GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX ICE DDR5 AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX ICE DDR5 AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard is a premium platform built for gamers and creators who demand speed, stability, and advanced features. Powered by the AMD B650 chipset, this GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX ICE DDR5 Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 7000, 8000, and 9000 Series processors on the AM5 socket. With DDR5 memory support, PCIe 5.0 storage, and Wi-Fi 6E, this Gigabyte B650M White Motherboard delivers next-generation performance in a stylish micro ATX design.

Memory, Graphics, and Expansion

The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX ICE micro atx Motherboard supports up to 256GB DDR5 memory with speeds reaching 8000+ MT/s (OC), offering extreme bandwidth for multitasking and gaming. Integrated AMD Radeon graphics provide 4K resolution via DisplayPort 1.4 at 144Hz and HDMI 2.1 at 60Hz. Expansion options include PCIe 4.0 x16 and PCIe 4.0 x4 slots, ensuring compatibility with modern GPUs and add-in cards. This GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX ICE DDR5 Motherboard is engineered for performance-driven builds with advanced overclocking support.

Connectivity and Features

Networking is powered by Realtek 2.5GbE LAN and Wi-Fi 6E with Bluetooth 5.3, ensuring ultra-fast connections. Storage options include dual M.2 slots supporting PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSDs, plus four SATA 6Gb/s connectors with RAID support. USB connectivity is extensive, featuring USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C, multiple USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 1 ports, and legacy USB 2.0 support. Enhanced with Realtek HD Audio, RGB headers, EZ Debug LEDs, and TPM 2.0 support, the Gigabyte B650M White Motherboard combines speed, security, and customization for modern gaming and productivity setups.

GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX DDR5 AMD AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 8000 & 7000-series processors for socket AM5. It equips the best VRM design ever built with the highest quality components and comes with direct 12+2+1 Phases Digital VRM Solution. It offers advanced thermal heatsinks to improve thermal efficiency with better airflow and heat exchange. It comes with 2x PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 Connectors. The M.2 Thermal Guard prevents throttling and bottlenecks from high-speed M.2 SSDs as it helps to dissipate heat before it becomes an issue. This motherboard features 2X copper PCBs design effectively lowering the component temperature through its high thermal conductivity and low impedance. The Smart Fan 6 contains several unique cooling features that ensure the gaming PC maintains its performance while staying cool and quiet. Each fan headers support PWM and DC fan and Water Cooling Pump, and up to 24W (12V x 2A) with Over-Current Protection. The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX Motherboard comes with 2.5G LAN which provides up to 2.5 GbE network connectivity, with at least 2 times faster transfer speeds compared to general 1GbE networking. It also supports Multi-Gig(10/100/1000/2500Mbps) RJ-45 Ethernet. The USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports provide speeds up to 10Gbps. With twice the bandwidth compared to its previous generation, The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

GIGABYTE B650M DS3H DDR5 AMD AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650M DS3H Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 8000 & 7000-series processors for socket AM5. It equips the best VRM design ever built with the highest quality components and comes with direct 6+2+1 Phases Digital VRM Solution. It offers advanced thermal heatsinks to improve thermal efficiency with better airflow and heat exchange. It comes with 2x PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 Connectors. The M.2 Thermal Guard prevents throttling and bottlenecks from high-speed M.2 SSDs as it helps to dissipate heat before it becomes an issue. This motherboard features 2X copper PCBs design effectively lowering the component temperature through its high thermal conductivity and low impedance. The Smart Fan 6 contains several unique cooling features that ensure the gaming PC maintains its performance while staying cool and quiet. Each fan headers support PWM and DC fan and Water Cooling Pump, and up to 24W (12V x 2A) with Over-Current Protection. The GIGABYTE B650M DS3H comes with 2.5G LAN which provides up to 2.5 GbE network connectivity, with at least 2 times faster transfer speeds compared to general 1GbE networking. It also supports Multi-Gig(10/100/1000/2500Mbps) RJ-45 Ethernet. The USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports provide speeds up to 10Gbps. With twice the bandwidth compared to its previous generation, The GIGABYTE B650M DS3H Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

products.description:
GIGABYTE B650M GAMING X AX DDR5 AM5 Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650M GAMING X AX Motherboard is a powerhouse designed to cater to the demands of gaming enthusiasts and professionals seeking top-tier performance and reliability. It seamlessly supports the latest Ryzen 8000/7000 Series Processors with its Socket AM5, making it a future-proof cornerstone for any high-performance gaming setup. The motherboard distinguishes itself with support for up to 192GB of DDR5 RAM across four slots, capable of reaching speeds up to 8000MHz when overclocked. This vast and speedy memory support is further enhanced by compatibility with AMD EXPO and Intel XMP, ensuring easy and stable overclocking for peak performance. Strong visual output is offered by two Display Ports and one HDMI connector, offering a variety of high-definition connectivity choices for immersive gaming or multiple monitor configurations. The motherboard's core technology is a Direct 6+2+1 Phases Digital VRM Solution, which has been painstakingly designed to provide reliable and effective power distribution to crucial system components under a range of load scenarios. The dual-channel DDR5 architecture perfectly complements the high-performance CPUs it supports by increasing system speed and bandwidth. including two PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 connections for super-fast storage, which drastically cuts down on game load times and guarantees quick data access. Additionally, GIGABYTE has given thermal management a lot of thought. To maintain ideal temperatures and avoid performance throttling during demanding gaming sessions or high workload activities, the company has included an M.2 Thermal Guard coupled with an innovative thermal design. The EZ-Latch design on the PCIe x16 slot and M.2 connections, which enables rapid and tool-free component installation or upgrades, is proof that ease of use is a top priority. With both 2.5GbE LAN and Wi-Fi 6E 802.11ax available, the networking capabilities are state-of-the-art, guaranteeing dependable and fast internet connections whether connected cable or wirelessly. A variety of connectors, such as two Display connectors, two USB-C 10Gb/s, and HDMI, enable extended connectivity and can support a large number of external devices and peripherals. With its FAN STOP feature for silent operation under low loads, Smart Fan 6 technology intelligently handles cooling by utilizing numerous temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers to maximize cooling efficiency and noise levels. Moreover, BIOS upgrades are made easier by the motherboard's Q-Flash Plus function, which streamlines the upgrading and troubleshooting procedure by removing the need to install the CPU, RAM, or graphics card. For those who want nothing less than the finest, the GIGABYTE B650M GAMING X AX Motherboard delivers an amazing combination of performance, expandability, and cutting-edge features. It seems like the perfect option for creating an ultra-high-end gaming PC that defies convention.

GIGABYTE B650M H AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650M H AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard is a compact and feature-rich platform designed to support AMD's latest Ryzen 7000, 8000, and 9000 series processors, utilizing the AM5 socket. This motherboard offers a robust power delivery system with a 5+2+2 phases digital VRM solution, ensuring stable and efficient performance, especially under demanding conditions. It supports Dual Channel DDR5 memory through 2 SMD DIMMs, compatible with both AMD EXPO and Intel XMP memory modules, allowing users to easily overclock and optimize their system's memory performance. The B650M H provides a PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 connector, offering high-speed storage capabilities that significantly enhance system responsiveness. The EZ-Latch feature on the PCIe x16 slot simplifies the installation and removal of graphics cards with a quick-release design, making hardware upgrades and maintenance straightforward. Equipped with Gigabit Ethernet LAN, the motherboard ensures reliable and fast network connectivity, ideal for gaming and data-intensive tasks. The motherboard also includes versatile connectivity options with DisplayPort and HDMI outputs, supporting various display setups and multi-monitor configurations. Its Smart Fan 6 technology provides multiple temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers, including the capability to stop fans completely when not needed, ensuring optimal cooling and minimal noise. Additionally, the Q-Flash Plus feature allows for easy BIOS updates without the need to install a CPU, memory, or graphics card, simplifying system maintenance and upgrades. The GIGABYTE B650M H AM5 Micro-ATX motherboard offers a well-rounded package for users seeking a reliable and efficient system build, whether for gaming or professional use.

products.description:
GIGABYTE B760 GAMING X AX ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B760 GAMING X AX is a high-performance motherboard designed for gaming enthusiasts and power users. It supports both 14th, 13th, and 12th-generation Intel processors with its LGA 1700 socket, ensuring compatibility with the latest CPU technologies. This 14th Gen motherboard is its Hybrid 8+1+1 Phases Digital VRM solution, which provides exceptional power delivery and stability for optimal performance. This ensures that the motherboard can handle demanding tasks and overclocking without any issues. The motherboard supports Dual Channel DDR5 memory, allowing for faster data transfer rates and improved multitasking capabilities. With four DIMM slots and XMP memory module support, users can easily install and configure high-speed RAM for smooth and responsive system performance. The GIGABYTE B760 GAMING X AX motherboard. It features two PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 connectors, enabling lightning-fast storage solutions. Additionally, the motherboard incorporates an advanced thermal design and M.2 Thermal Guard to maintain VRM power stability and optimize M.2 SSD performance, preventing thermal throttling and ensuring reliable operation. The EZ-Latch feature of the PCIe 4.0x16 slot allows for easy installation and removal of graphics cards, making it convenient for users who frequently upgrade their GPUs. The motherboard also offers fast networking capabilities with 2.5GbE LAN and Wi-Fi 6E 802.11ax support, ensuring low latency and high-speed connectivity for online gaming and other network-intensive tasks. The GIGABYTE B760 GAMING X AX provides a front USB-C® port with a 10Gb/s transfer speed, as well as DisplayPort (DP) and HDMI ports for multiple display setups. This allows users to connect various peripherals and external devices with ease. The Smart Fan 6 feature is designed to keep the system cool and quiet. It includes multiple temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers with FAN STOP technology, enabling precise control over fan speeds and optimizing cooling performance while minimizing noise levels. The Q-Flash Plus, allows users to update the motherboard's BIOS firmware without the need to install the CPU, memory, and graphics card. This feature provides a convenient and hassle-free method for keeping the system up to date with the latest firmware releases. The GIGABYTE B760 GAMING X AX motherboard offers a comprehensive range of features and technologies for gamers and power users seeking exceptional performance, reliable connectivity, and convenient upgradability.

GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 mATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 mATX Motherboard is a powerful and compact option for gamers, creators, and professionals seeking modern capabilities without sacrificing stability or performance. Built with the Intel B760 Express chipset, it supports 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron CPUs via the LGA1700 socket, making it ideal for a variety of designs. Memory support is future-ready, with four DDR5 DIMM ports supporting up to 256GB capacity and overclocking rates of up to DDR5-7600 when combined with high-end processors. The GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 Motherboard also supports dual-channel architecture, ECC and non-ECC modules, and Intel XMP profiles for smooth overclocking. Graphics are handled by integrated Intel HD Graphics, which supports HDMI 2.1 with resolutions of up to 4K at 60Hz and multiple DisplayPort outputs, allowing for triple-display setups for productivity and enjoyment. With Realtek 2.5GbE LAN and Intel Wi-Fi 6E AX210 module, the GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 Motherboard provides Wi-Fi 6E connection across 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands, as well as Bluetooth 5.3 for current wireless devices. Storage options include two M.2 PCIe 4.0 x4 connectors for NVMe SSDs and four SATA 6Gb/s ports with RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 support, allowing for high-speed and redundant storage configurations. Expansion is robust, with one PCIe 5.0 x16 port for next-generation GPUs and two PCIe 3.0 x1 slots for add-on cards. The GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 Motherboard's rear panel features USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-C, USB 3.2 Gen1, USB 2.0, HDMI, DisplayPort, RJ-45 LAN and audio ports, as well as Wi-Fi antenna connectors. Other features include RGB and ARGB headers, Q-Flash Plus for simple BIOS updates, fan monitoring, Smart Backup, and support for GIGABYTE Control Center software. With Windows 10 and 11 compatibility and a micro ATX form factor of 24.4cm x 24.4cm, the GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 is a dependable motherboard that combines performance, connectivity, and expandability for modern PC designs.

The Q-Flash Plus, allows users to update the motherboard's BIOS firmware without the need to install the CPU, memory, and graphics card. This feature provides a convenient and hassle-free method for keeping the system up to date with the latest firmware releases. The GIGABYTE B760M GAMING X AX DDR5 motherboard offers a comprehensive range of features and technologies for gamers and power users seeking exceptional performance, reliable connectivity, and convenient upgradability.

GIGABYTE B840M EAGLE WIFI6 AMD AM5 Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B840M EAGLE WIFI6 AM5 Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors on the AMD Socket AM5 platform. Powered by the AMD B840 chipset, the GIGABYTE Motherboard ensures stable computing with a digital 5+2+2 phases VRM solution. Dual channel DDR5 architecture supports up to 128GB across two DIMMs with speeds reaching 7600 MT/s overclocked. AMD EXPO and XMP profiles optimize memory, while D5 Bionic Corsa enhances infinite memory performance. The GIGABYTE B840M EAGLE WIFI6 Motherboard has EZ-Latch PCIe and M.2 slots feature quick release and screwless design for effortless installation. M.2 heatsinks also use screwless EZ-Latch design, supported by VRM Thermal Armor Advanced and M.2 Thermal Guard. The GIGABYTE Motherboard includes two M.2 connectors and four SATA 6Gb/s ports with RAID 0,1,5,10 support. PCIe UD Slot provides 10X strength for graphics cards and improved heat dissipation. The GIGABYTE B840M EAGLE WIFI6 Motherboard integrated AMD Radeon Graphics supports DisplayPort 1.4 at 3840x2160@144Hz and HDMI 2.1 at 4096x2160@60Hz with HDR. Realtek 2.5GbE LAN and Realtek Wi-Fi 6 RTL8851BE with Bluetooth 5.3 deliver fast networking. Expansion includes PCIe 4.0 x16 CPU slot and PCIe 3.0 x4 chipset slot. USB connectivity covers USB 3.2 Gen1, USB Type-C header, and multiple USB 2.0 ports. The GIGABYTE B840M EAGLE WIFI6 AM5 Motherboard has internal connectors include ATX power, fan and pump headers, RGB Gen2 headers, TPM header, and Clear CMOS jumper. Back panel offers PS/2, Q-Flash Plus button, SMA antenna connectors, RJ-45, audio jacks, HDMI, and DisplayPort. Licensed AMI UEFI BIOS with 256 Mbit flash supports Q-Flash, Smart Backup, and GCC software. Micro ATX form factor ensures compatibility with Windows 11 and Windows 10 64-bit systems.

GIGABYTE B850M AORUS ELITE WIFI6E ICE AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B850M AORUS ELITE WIFI6E ICE is a high-performance AMD AM5 Micro ATX motherboard with impressive features and excellent connections. It supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 processors, providing ample computational capability for gaming and productivity. Built on the AMD B850 chipset, it can support up to 256GB of DDR5 memory at speeds of up to 8200MHz and is overclockable with AMD EXPO and XMP profiles. products.description:
GIGABYTE B850M D3HP AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B850M D3HP is a powerful AMD AM5 Micro ATX motherboard that provides a good balance of power, expandability, and durability. It is compatible with AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series processors, providing a stable base for gaming and professional applications. With four DDR5 DIMM slots, it can accommodate up to 256GB of RAM at speeds of up to 8200MHz, offering high-speed performance and overclocking capability with AMD EXPO and XMP. The GIGABYTE B850M D3HP DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard features integrated AMD Radeon graphics with HDMI 2.1 and dual DisplayPort outputs, allowing for resolutions of up to 4K at 144Hz and triple-display capabilities. The GIGABYTE B850 Motherboard features two M.2 slots for PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 SSDs, as well as four SATA 6Gb/s connections with RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 compatibility. Expansion slots include a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for graphics cards and a PCIe 3.0 x4 slot for extra devices. Realtek GbE LAN provides robust wired connectivity. The GIGABYTE B850M D3HP AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard has several USB ports, including USB 3.2 Gen 1 and USB Type-C connectors on the back and front panel headers. RGB customization is possible using addressable Gen2 LED strip headers. Smart Fan controls, Q-Flash Plus for quick BIOS updates, and Windows 11 compatibility are among the other features. The GIGABYTE B850M D3HP AM5 Micro ATX Motherboard has a compact form factor and offers robust performance, comprehensive connections, and upgrade potential, making it an excellent choice for gaming, content creation, and productivity-focused systems.

products.description:
GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E AM5 Motherboard is a next-generation Micro ATX motherboard engineered for enthusiasts, gamers, and professionals seeking high-end performance with future-ready connectivity. Designed for AMD Socket AM5, it supports the latest AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, unlocking extreme multitasking and gaming capabilities. This advanced GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard features four DDR5 memory slots, supporting up to 256GB of RAM with speeds up to DDR5 8200 MHz (OC). With full support for AMD EXPO and Intel XMP profiles, it ensures seamless overclocking and memory optimization across dual-channel architecture. For high-speed storage, the motherboard includes two M.2 PCIe slots—one supporting PCIe 5.0 x4 and the other PCIe 4.0 x4/x2—making it ideal for blazing-fast NVMe SSDs. It also includes four SATA 6Gb/s ports with RAID 0, 1, 5 (exclusive to Ryzen 9000), and 10 support, delivering reliable storage redundancy and performance. The GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E Motherboard also boasts advanced display outputs, including 2x DisplayPorts (up to 3840x2160@144Hz) and 1x HDMI 2.1 port (4096x2160@60Hz), supporting up to triple-display output, perfect for multitasking or immersive visuals. Connectivity is cutting-edge, with onboard Intel Wi-Fi 6E (Realtek RTL8852CE) supporting 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands, Bluetooth 5.3, and a Realtek 2.5GbE LAN port, ensuring ultra-low latency for both wired and wireless networking. Expansion slots include a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for high-end GPUs (when paired with Ryzen 9000/7000 CPUs) and a secondary PCIe 3.0 x4 slot. The board also features a rich I/O panel with a USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C port, USB 3.2 Gen 1, USB 2.0, PS/2 port, 3 audio jacks, and antenna connectors, complemented by multiple internal headers for additional USB, ARGB Gen2, RGB LED strips, fans, and water cooling systems. The GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E AM5 DDR5 Motherboard supports Q-Flash, Q-Flash Plus, Smart Backup, and is fully compatible with the GIGABYTE Control Center (GCC) software, allowing users to monitor, control, and optimize system performance with ease. High-definition audio is delivered through the Realtek Audio Codec, with support for configurable 2/4/5.1/7.1-channel sound. Measuring 24.4cm x 24.4cm, this Micro ATX board is compact yet feature-packed, making it perfect for high-performance builds in smaller enclosures. Whether you're building a next-gen gaming PC or a workstation, the GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard is a powerful and future-proof choice designed to deliver exceptional performance, reliability, and connectivity.

GIGABYTE B850M GAMING X WIFI6E AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B850M GAMING X WIFI6E motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 processors with the AM5 socket. With four DDR5 DIMM slots, it can accommodate up to 256GB of RAM at rates of up to 8200 MT/s when overclocked, delivering outstanding memory bandwidth for demanding workloads. Users can use AMD EXPO and XMP profiles to optimize system memory for greater stability and speed. The GIGABYTE B850M GAMING X WIFI6E AM5 Micro ATX Motherboard has PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 expansion slots, making it excellent for high-performance GPUs and NVMe SSDs. Storage options include two M.2 slots for PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 SSDs, as well as four SATA 6Gb/s connections with RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 support for improved data redundancy and performance. HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 are supported by the integrated graphics, enabling for up to three displays with high refresh rates. The GIGABYTE B850M GAMING X WIFI6E Motherboard's Realtek 2.5GbE LAN and Wi-Fi 6E with Bluetooth 5.3 enable fast networking for flawless online gaming and streaming. Multiple USB 3.2 Gen 2 and USB Type-C connections enable quick data transfers and peripheral connectivity. A Realtek audio codec powers high-definition audio, which supports 7.1-channel surround sound. GIGABYTE B850M GAMING X WIFI6E AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard also includes sophisticated cooling solutions, various RGB headers, and support for GIGABYTE Control Center, which allows for simple system customization.

GIGABYTE B860M AORUS ELITE WIFI6E LGA1851 Micro ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B860M AORUS ELITE WIFI6E LGA1851 Micro ATX Motherboard is a powerful powerhouse that supports Intel Core Ultra Processors with its innovative LGA1851 socket and Intel B860 Express Chipset, resulting in remarkable speed and dependability. This GIGABYTE B860M AORUS ELITE WIFI6E Micro ATX Motherboard supports up to 256 GB of DDR5 memory over four DIMM slots at blazing-fast rates of up to 9200 MT/s OC. The motherboard also features dual-channel memory architecture, support for ECC and non-ECC unbuffered DIMMs, and Extreme Memory Profile XMP for effortless overclocking. Graphics performance stands out with quad-display support, featuring a USB4 Type-C port and DisplayPort 2.1 capable of resolutions up to 3840x2160 at 144Hz, alongside HDMI 2.1 for stunning 4K output at 60Hz. Expandability is made easy with a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for high-performance GPUs or NVMe SSDs, plus an additional PCIe 4.0 x16 slot x4 mode. Storage is versatile, featuring three M.2 slots, one supporting PCIe 5.0 x4 and two with PCIe 4.0 x4, along with four SATA 6Gb/s ports and RAID support. USB options are plentiful, with a USB4 Type-C port, two USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A ports, and numerous USB 3.2 Gen 1 and USB 2.0/1.1 ports across the back panel and internal headers. The GIGABYTE B860M AORUS ELITE WIFI6E also features advanced cooling support with multiple fan and pump headers, plus RGB Gen2 LED headers for customizable lighting. Onboard buttons for power, reset, and Q-Flash Plus make BIOS updates simple and convenient. Optimized for Windows 11, this feature-rich GIGABYTE Motherboard delivers exceptional performance, making the GIGABYTE B860M AORUS ELITE WIFI6E Motherboard the perfect choice for gamers, content creators, and tech enthusiasts looking for cutting-edge technology in a compact Micro ATX form factor.

GIGABYTE X670 GAMING X AX DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE X670 GAMING X AX Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 8000 & 7000 Series Processors for AMD socket AM5. It can deliver unparalleled performance with direct 16+2+2 phase Digital VRM Solution. The GIGABYTE X670 GAMING X AX Motherboard comes with 4x SMD DIMMs with AMD EXPO & Intel XMP Memory Module Support. It supports DDR5 6400 (OC), 6200 (OC), 6000 (OC), 5600 (OC), 5200, 4800, and 4400 MT/s memory modules. It features 4x PCIe 5.0 x4 M.2 Connectors for next-generation storage. It has a Fins-Array III & M.2 Thermal Guard III to Ensure VRM Power Stability & 25110 PCIe 5.0 M.2 SSD Performance. The new generation Fins-Array III delivers the ultimate thermal performance by using Extended Irregular fins to fill all available space and vastly increase surface area. A piece of Fins-Array III heatsink surface area is larger than 2 full-size ATX motherboard PCBs; therefore, it tremendously boosts thermal efficiency and heat exchange performance. It also comes with SMD PCIe 5.0 x16 Slot & M.2 Connectors with Quick Release & Screwless Design. M.2 Thermal Guard III is constructed with a 9X optimized heat dissipation surface to prevent throttling and bottlenecks that the high-speed and large capacity of PCIe 5.0 M.2 SSDs may cause, especially under a heavy workload. The special design of heatsink grooves in the direction of the CPU further enhances the in-chassis air flow and optimizes heat convection efficiency. The GIGABYTE X670 GAMING X AX Motherboard is equipped with the latest wireless solution, 802.11ax Wi-Fi 6E, with a new dedicated 6GHz band, enables gigabit wireless performance, provides smooth video streaming, a better gaming experience, few dropped connections, and speeds up to 2.4 GHz. Moreover, Bluetooth 5 provides a 4X range over BT 4.2 and faster transmission. The GIGABYTEX670 GAMING X AX comes with a 3 years warranty.

products.description:
GIGABYTE X870 GAMING WIFI6 DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE X870 GAMING X WIFI7 DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard is a high-performance motherboard designed to support AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, leveraging the power of the AMD Socket AM5 and advanced DDR5 memory technology. With four DIMM slots supporting dual-channel DDR5 memory and AMD EXPO Memory Module Support, it offers overclocking capabilities up to 8600MT/s, ensuring top-tier performance and compatibility. The motherboard features a robust digital twin 16+2+2 phases VRM solution, providing consistent and high-powered performance, ideal for overclocking and demanding applications. Efficient cooling solutions, such as the DDR Wind Blade for active cooling of memory modules and VRM Thermal Armor Advanced with I/O ZONE, keep your system cool under pressure. It also offers ultra-fast storage options with four M.2 slots, including three PCIe 5.0 x4 slots, for quick data access and transfer. Enhanced connectivity features such as 2.5GbE LAN, Wi-Fi 7, dual USB4 Type-C with DP-Alt, and HDMI provide versatile and high-speed networking options. The user-friendly design includes M.2 EZ-Match magnetic alignment, EZ-Latch Plus for PCIe and M.2 slots, and a friendly UI with multi-theme support, making installation and management a breeze. Additionally, the motherboard delivers superior audio quality with Realtek ALC1220 HD Audio and WIMA audiophile-grade capacitors, ensuring an immersive audio experience. Overall, the GIGABYTE X870 GAMING X WIFI7 DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard is the ultimate choice for those seeking to unleash the full potential of their system with advanced memory support, robust power delivery, efficient cooling solutions, and extensive connectivity options

GIGABYTE Z790 AERO G ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE Z790 AERO G ATX Motherboard comes with Intel Socket LGA 1700 that supports 13th and 12th Gen Series Processors. The motherboard comes with 4x SMD DIMMs with XMP 3.0 Memory Module Support. It offers support for DDR5 7600(O.C.) /7400(O.C.) /7200(O.C.) /7000(O.C.) /6800(O.C.) /6600(O.C.) / 6400(O.C.) / 6200(O.C.) / 6000(O.C.) / 5800(O.C.) / 5600(O.C.) / 5400(O.C.) / 5200(O.C.) / 4800 / 4000 memory modules. The sockets support up to 128 GB (32 GB single DIMM capacity) of system memory. It comes with a GIGABYTE VisionLINK port, and you can transfer data, video, and power charging via a single USB Type-C cable. The 14th Gen motherboard is equipped with the PCIe 5.0 x16 slot and M.2 socket designed to optimize multitasking and large workloads, which is also ready for a new PCIe 5.0 graphics card or storage device. It supports new PCIe 5.0 SSD with up to type 25110 M.2 slot designed to provide high power M.2 PCIe 5.0 SSD solutions. A total of five onboard M.2 slots are available for data-intensive tasks and creative work without additional configuration. The GIGABYTE Z790 AERO G is equipped with Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet provides an immediate boost to overall network performance, smooth video editing, and fast data transfers. Wi-Fi 6E brings the ability to conduct AR/VR experiences, get creative with fewer dropped connections, and download large files at faster speeds without lag. The advanced cooling solution also provides the perfect aesthetic heatsink design to keep your PC at an optimal temperature, preventing you from unexpected system crashes during the creative process. The GIGABYTE Z790 AERO G 14th Gen Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

The GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS MASTER E-ATX Motherboard comes with Intel Socket LGA 1700 that supports 14th 13th and 12th Gen Series Processors. It comes with a direct 20+1+2 Phases Digital VRM Solution. The motherboard comes with 4x SMD DIMMs with XMP 3.0 Memory Module Support. The GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS MASTER E-ATX Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

This motherboard is compatible with Intel Core 14th and 13th generation processors, guaranteeing that it is ready for Intel's latest and best CPUs. The motherboard features a strong 20+1+2 power phase architecture that ensures optimal power supply to your CPU for optimum performance and stability. With 4 DIMM slots and XMP 3.0 memory module compatibility, you may experience lightning-fast memory speeds and enough capacity for multitasking and gaming. This motherboard has a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot with 10X strength for your graphics card, which provides enough bandwidth for the newest GPUs while also future-proofing your system. M.2 heatsinks with screwless designs make it simple to install and cool your M.2 NVMe SSDs, assuring maximum performance. The PCIe 5.0 x16 slot and M.2 slots have a quick-release design that makes hardware installation and upgrades easier. The user-centered BIOS interface provides a straightforward user experience with a Quick Access option, allowing users to adjust and optimize their system settings more easily. You may experience very high storage speeds for your games, programs, and data with five M.2 slots, including one PCIe 5.0 x4 slot. The VRM Thermal Armor Fins-Array and M.2 Thermal Guard XL assist in heat dissipation, keeping your system cool and stable even during strenuous workloads. The GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS MASTER X Motherboard has a 10GbE LAN and Wi-Fi 7, as well as an ultra-high gain antenna, for lightning-fast and dependable network access. You have plenty of connectivity choices for all your peripherals and devices with DisplayPort, a front USB-C connector with 10Gb/s transfer rates, and front and twin rear USB-C ports with 20Gb/s transfer speeds. The audio capabilities of the motherboard are excellent, with the ALC1220 audio codec and a back ESS SABRE Hi-Fi 9118 DAC providing high-quality sound for gaming and entertainment.
