The 14th Gen motherboard is equipped with the PCIe 5.0 x16 slot and M.2 socket designed to optimize multitasking and large workloads, which is also ready for a new PCIe 5.0 graphics card or storage device. It supports new PCIe 5.0 SSD with up to type 25110 M.2 slot designed to provide high power M.2 PCIe 5.0 SSD solutions. The GIGABYTE Z790 D DDR4 is equipped with Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet provides an immediate boost to overall network performance, smooth video editing, and fast data transfers. The advanced cooling solution also provides the perfect aesthetic heatsink design to keep your PC at an optimal temperature, preventing you from unexpected system crashes during the creative process. The GIGABYTE Z790 D DDR4 ATX Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

products.description:
GIGABYTE Z790 D DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE Z790 D DDR5 ATX motherboard is a high-performance platform with several sophisticated features designed to enhance system performance, stability, and connection for both gaming and professional applications. It is compatible with Intel's 14th, 13th, and 12th-generation Core CPUs. In addition to a dual 12+1+1 phases digital VRM solution that ensures robust and consistent power delivery to the CPU, it boasts a 6+6 phases parallel power architecture for efficient and reliable power management. The motherboard features four DIMM slots, supports dual-channel DDR5 memory, and offers XMP 3.0, which simplifies memory module optimization and overclocking. The Z790 D's three PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 storage ports allow for next-generation storage solutions with rapid access times and high data transfer rates. Its cutting-edge thermal design, which incorporates M.2 Thermal Guards, keeps the VRM and M.2 SSDs operating at stable temperatures and guarantees their steady performance. The quick-release design of the EZ-Latch PCIe 4.0 x16 slot makes it easier to install or remove graphics cards. A 2.5GbE LAN connection improves networking by offering dependable and quick connectivity for data transfers and games. Numerous back I/O choices include a rear USB-C 10Gb/s connector for fast data transmission and peripheral access, as well as DisplayPort and HDMI outputs for flexible display connectivity. Multiple temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers with a FAN STOP function are components of the Smart Fan 6 technology, which improves cooling and lowers noise levels. The Q-Flash Plus feature allows users to update the BIOS without the need to install the CPU, memory, or graphics card, simplifying maintenance and setup. The GIGABYTE Z790 D DDR5 ATX motherboard is ideal for enthusiasts and professionals who demand high performance, extensive connectivity options, and advanced features to support their computing needs.

GIGABYTE Z790 EAGLE DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE Z790 EAGLE DDR5 ATX Motherboard stands out as a top-tier choice for both gaming enthusiasts and professionals, offering unmatched performance and versatility. It is designed to support Intel Core processors from the 14th, 13th, and 12th generations, ensuring compatibility with the latest CPU advancements and providing a future-proof platform. This motherboard's power delivery system is exceptional, featuring a Twin 12+1+1 phases digital VRM solution that guarantees stable and efficient power for demanding workloads and overclocking scenarios. This is critical for maintaining peak performance and ensuring the longevity of your components. The Z790 EAGLE supports dual-channel DDR5 with up to four DIMM slots and XMP 3.0 memory module support. This allows for high-speed memory configurations, enhancing system responsiveness and multitasking capabilities. The motherboard's storage options are equally impressive, with three PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 connectors that offer ultra-fast data access and reduced load times. These connectors are ideal for NVMe SSDs, enabling quicker boot times and faster application launches. Thermal management is a crucial aspect of any high-performance system, and the GIGABYTE Z790 EAGLE excels in this area with its advanced thermal design. It features a comprehensive cooling solution that ensures VRM power stability and optimal M.2 SSD performance. The inclusion of an M.2 thermal guard helps maintain ideal operating temperatures for high-performance SSDs, thereby prolonging their lifespan and ensuring consistent performance. The motherboard's user-friendly features include the EZ-Latch PCIe 5.0x16 slot, which simplifies the installation or removal of graphics cards. This quick-release design reduces the risk of damage during upgrades, making the process more convenient. Networking capabilities are enhanced with a 2.5GbE LAN port, which provides high-speed, stable network connectivity, crucial for gaming, streaming, and data transfers. This ensures low latency and high bandwidth for demanding applications. Connectivity is a highlight of the Z790 EAGLE, offering a variety of ports including DisplayPort and HDMI for multi-monitor setups, and a rear USB-C port supporting 10Gb/s data transfer speeds. This wide array of connectivity options accommodates numerous peripherals and external devices, making it a versatile choice for various setups. The Smart Fan 6 feature provides advanced cooling management with multiple temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers that support FAN STOP. This allows for precise control over system cooling and noise levels, maintaining optimal temperatures and ensuring quiet operation. The Q-Flash Plus feature allows for BIOS updates without the need to install the CPU, memory, or graphics card, providing a convenient solution for maintaining system firmware. This is particularly useful for ensuring compatibility with new hardware and enhancing system stability. The GIGABYTE Z790 EAGLE DDR5 ATX Motherboard is a comprehensive and powerful platform that combines state-of-the-art technology with user-friendly features, making it an excellent choice for building a high-performance PC tailored to your needs. Whether you are a gamer, a content creator, or a professional, this motherboard provides the stability, speed, and connectivity necessary for today's demanding applications.

products.description:
Gigabyte Z890 UD LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard

The Gigabyte Z890 UD LGA 1851 ATX motherboard is optimized for the latest Intel Core Ultra processors. Its sturdy digital dual 12+1+2 phase VRM architecture guarantees steady power delivery for demanding workloads and overclocking. With support for XMP and ECC un-buffered DIMMs, it can hold up to 256 GB of DDR5 memory over four DIMM slots at up to 9200 MT/s. For extremely quick storage configurations, the Gigabyte Z890 UD mobo offers four M.2 slots, one with PCIe 5.0 x4 compatibility, and four SATA 6Gb/s connectors. With PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 slots made for graphics cards or NVMe SSDs, expansion is easy. The Gigabyte Z890 UD LGA 1851 ATX motherboard offers improved cooling options with VRM Thermal Armor Advanced and M.2 Thermal Guard, and incorporates AI Perfdrive for customized BIOS presets. AIO fan control, Q-Flash Auto Scan for simple updates, and multi-theme customization are all features of the BIOS's user-friendly interface. A 2.5GbE LAN port allows for quick networking, and USB4 Type-C with DisplayPort Alt Mode and USB 3.2 connectors provide longer communication. DisplayPort 2.1 and USB4 integrated graphics support resolutions of up to 3840x2160 @ 144 Hz. The Realtek High Definition Audio on the Gigabyte Z890 UD LGA 1851 ATX motherboard supports up to 7.1-channel configurations and may be adjusted via audio software. Voltage, temperature, and fan speed monitoring are among the onboard diagnostics that guarantee peak performance. Software like Norton Internet Security and LAN bandwidth control tools are pre-installed on this ATX form factor board, which is compatible with Windows 11. With cutting-edge features like RGB lighting management, PCIe EZ-Latch, Thunderbolt add-in card support, and an extensive array of internal ports, the Gigabyte Z890 UD ATX motherboard redefines performance and versatility for both professionals and enthusiasts.

Intel HD Graphics with USB4 and DisplayPort outputs are supported by the onboard graphics. The Realtek Audio CODEC manages audio and produces multi-channel, high-definition sound. For high-performance setups, the Gigabyte Z890 UD WIFI6E LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard is a great option because it is dependable and supports both ECC and non-ECC memory modules. Usability is further improved by extra features such as the new power monitor in HWinfo for real-time CPU power phase monitoring and the EZ-Latch PCIe x16 slot for simple GPU installation. Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X LGA1851 Micro ATX Motherboard

The Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X Micro ATX Motherboard is an Ultra Powerful motherboard designed to support Intel Core Ultra processors with an LGA1851 socket. Featuring the Intel Z890 Express Chipset, this Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X Motherboard offers exceptional performance and DDR5 memory support, with memory speeds ranging from 6400 MT/s to 9066 MT/s across 4 x DIMM slots, supporting up to 256 GB of system memory. It also supports dual-channel memory architecture, ECC and non-ECC un-buffered DIMMs, and Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) modules for high-speed memory configurations. For integrated graphics, the Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X motherboard includes HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 2.1 outputs, supporting triple-display setups at resolutions up to 4096x2304 @60 Hz with HDCP 2.3 compatibility. Powered by a Realtek Audio CODEC, it delivers high-definition audio with support for 2/4/5.1/7.1-channel configurations and includes a Realtek® 2.5GbE LAN chip for fast, reliable networking. The Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X Motherboard also offers extensive expansion options, with a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for graphics cards or NVMe SSDs, a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot running at x4 for additional expansion, and multiple M.2 connectors supporting PCIe 4.0/5.0 SSDs along with four SATA 6Gb/s connectors, supporting RAID for both NVMe and SATA devices. Featuring a wide range of internal and external I/O connectors, including USB 3.2 Gen 1, USB Type-C, fan headers for cooling, addressable RGB lighting, and Thunderbolt add-in card connectors, the Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X motherboard is highly customizable. It’s compatible with Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) and uses a 256 Mbit flash BIOS with AMI UEFI BIOS, offering an intuitive interface for advanced configuration. The Micro ATX form factor (24.4cm x 24.4cm) makes the Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X Micro ATX Motherboard perfect for compact PC builds without compromising on performance. Whether for gaming or professional use, the Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X Motherboard delivers unbeatable features and future-proof capabilities, making it the ideal choice for building a high-performance gaming rig or workstation.

MSI B850M GAMING PLUS WIFI6E AM5 mATX Motherboard

The MSI B850M GAMING PLUS WIFI6E AM5 mATX Motherboard is a feature-rich and performance-oriented motherboard designed for the latest generation of AMD processors. It supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors with the AM5 socket, offering high efficiency and future-ready performance for gamers and PC builders. This AMD B850 chipset motherboard ensures system stability and next-gen capability in a compact micro-ATX form factor.This motherboard supports up to 256GB of DDR5 memory across four DIMM slots. It delivers high memory speeds up to 8200+ MT/s (OC), depending on the Ryzen CPU series and module configuration. The dual-channel memory architecture enhances performance, and it supports AMD EXPO, non-ECC, unbuffered memory, and CUDIMM. This makes it ideal for both gaming and productivity tasks requiring high-speed memory bandwidth.For storage, the MSI B850M GAMING PLUS WIFI6E includes two M.2 slots and four SATA 6Gb/s ports. The M.2_1 slot supports up to PCIe 5.0 x4, ensuring ultra-fast SSD performance for demanding tasks and fast game loading. The M.2_2 slot supports up to PCIe 4.0 x4, enabling efficient secondary storage options. RAID support includes RAID 0, 1, and 10 for SATA and RAID 0 and 1 for NVMe storage, adding flexibility and reliability to your setup.The MSI Motherboard offers extensive expansion options. It includes one PCIe 4.0 x16 slot and two PCIe 3.0 x1 slots. The PCIe x16 slot dynamically adjusts bandwidth depending on the installed Ryzen CPU model, making it optimized for various gaming GPUs and add-in cards. This enables compatibility with both high-end and mid-tier graphics cards.For graphics output, the B850M GAMING PLUS WIFI6E motherboard provides 1x HDMI 2.1 and 1x DisplayPort 1.4, both supporting 4K resolution at 60Hz. This allows users to enjoy crisp, high-resolution displays for gaming, content creation, and media playback. The integrated graphics output is especially useful when building systems without a dedicated GPU. It includes Realtek 8125D 2.5G LAN for fast, stable wired connections. For wireless connectivity, the Wi-Fi 6E module supports tri-band (2.4GHz/5GHz/6GHz), delivering speeds up to 2.4Gbps with MU-MIMO and OFDMA technology. The B850M Motherboard also supports Bluetooth 5.3, allowing seamless pairing with wireless peripherals, audio devices, and accessories.The audio system uses the Realtek ALC897 7.1-channel codec, delivering immersive high-definition audio. Whether gaming, streaming, or creating content, this setup ensures crystal-clear sound output.For internal connectivity, the motherboard includes headers for CPU and system fans, RGB and ARGB lighting, front panel audio, TPM 2.0 module, and EZ Debug LED indicators. The EZ Debug LEDs and EZ Memory Detection LED help simplify troubleshooting and system building for new users and advanced builders alike.This MSI B850M GAMING PLUS WIFI6E micro-ATX DDR5 motherboard fits easily into compact cases while offering powerful features. The design is sleek and gamer-focused, matching the aesthetics of modern gaming builds. Its enhanced power delivery, durable components, and advanced thermal design ensure long-term stability under load.Whether you're building a new AMD gaming PC or upgrading an older system, the MSI B850M GAMING PLUS WIFI6E motherboard offers a perfect mix of speed, compatibility, and value. It’s optimized for next-gen Ryzen CPUs, PCIe 5.0 NVMe storage, Wi-Fi 6E, and DDR5 memory, making it one of the best AM5 micro-ATX motherboards.

products.description:
MSI B850M GAMING WIFI7 AM5 mATX Motherboard

The MSI B850M GAMING WIFI AM5 mATX Motherboard is built for AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors on the AM5 socket. This Motherboard runs on the AMD B850 chipset and supports two DDR5 UDIMM slots with a maximum capacity of 128GB. DDR5 memory speeds reach up to 8200 MT/s via overclocking, with JEDEC speeds supported from 4800 to 5600 MT/s for broad compatibility. AMD EXPO and dual-channel memory support maximize bandwidth and performance across all supported Ryzen processor generations.

The MSI B850M GAMING WIFI AM5 Motherboard features a primary PCIe 5.0 x16 slot delivering up to 128GB/s bandwidth for next-generation GPU performance. A secondary PCIe 4.0 x4 slot from the chipset provides additional expansion capability for other peripherals and cards. Two M.2 slots include M.2_1 supporting PCIe 5.0 x4 from the CPU and M.2_2 supporting PCIe 4.0 x4 for ultra-fast NVMe storage. Both M.2 slots benefit from M.2 Shield Frozr thermal protection that prevents throttling and keeps SSDs running at peak speeds.

The MSI B850M GAMING WIFI mATX Motherboard has four SATA 6G ports support RAID 0, 1, and 10 configurations for flexible traditional storage setups. The MSI WIFI7 Motherboard includes a pre-installed Wi-Fi 7 module supporting 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands at up to 2.9Gbps with Bluetooth 5.4, MLO, and 4KQAM. A Realtek 8126 5G LAN controller delivers premium wired network performance for low-latency gaming and streaming.

Onboard graphics output includes HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4, both supporting up to 4K 60Hz resolution. This MSI B850M GAMING WIFI AMD Motherboard has realtek ALC897 powers 7.1-channel HD audio for immersive studio-grade sound quality. The MSI AMD AM5 Motherboard features four EZ Debug LEDs and one EZ Memory Detection LED for simplified hardware troubleshooting. An extended PWM heatsink and enhanced circuit design keep even high-end processors running at full speed consistently. The MSI mATX Motherboard measures 226×243.84mm and fully supports Windows 11 64-bit operating systems.

products.description:
MSI H510M PLUS II 10th/11th Gen mATX Motherboard

The MSI H510M PLUS II Motherboard is a dependable and cost-effective alternative for building a compact yet powerful desktop computer, providing the key capabilities required for smooth gaming, productivity, and everyday use. It is powered by the Intel H510 chipset and supports 10th and 11th-generation Intel Core processors, as well as Pentium Gold and Celeron CPUs, allowing consumers flexibility across various system designs. Memory compatibility includes two DDR4 slots with dual-channel capabilities, allowing for a maximum capacity of 64GB. Depending on the CPU installed, the MSI H510M PLUS II Motherboard supports speeds of up to 2933MHz for Intel Core i9 and Core i7 processors and up to 2666MHz for Core i5, Core i3, Pentium Gold, and Celeron CPUs, with Intel Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) support for easy overclocking. Onboard graphics include HDMI 1.4, which supports 4K resolution at 30Hz, and a VGA output with resolutions up to 2048x1536, though availability varies depending on the CPU used. For expansion, the board has one PCIe 3.0 x16 slot for a dedicated graphics card and one PCIe 3.0 x1 slot for other devices. Storage is handled by a fast M.2 slot that supports PCIe 3.0 x4 and SATA modes, as well as four SATA 6Gb/s connectors. The MSI H510M PLUS II Motherboard supports both SSDs and traditional hard drives. The audio system uses the Realtek ALC897 codec to provide 7.1-channel high-definition sound, which improves entertainment and gaming experiences. Connectivity is practical, with four USB 2.0 connections on the back and four on the front, as well as two USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-A connectors on both the front and back for fast transfers. MSI H510M PLUS II Motherboard's networking is powered by Realtek 8111H Gigabit LAN for reliable wired connectivity. Additional internal I/O includes CPU and system fan headers, RGB lighting, chassis intrusion detection, COM port, TPM 2.0, and front audio. EZ Debug LEDs are a useful feature that makes troubleshooting easier. The MSI H510M PLUS II, with a tiny micro-ATX form factor of 202mm x 236mm, is compatible with Windows 10 and Windows 11, making it a reliable motherboard that balances performance, expandability, and value for budget-conscious consumers.

products.description:
MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK WIFI DDR4 ATX Motherboard

MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK WIFI DDR4 Motherboard supports 12th/ 13th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors for LGA 1700 socket. It comes with four dual-channel RAM slots, and three M.2 slots allowing you to take advantage of the full power of 13th & 12th generation Intel processors. The Six SATA III ports allow users to create large storage drive arrays for large file libraries. Two PCIe x16 and one PCIe x1 slot allow you to install high-end graphics cards and other expansion cards. Connect to a wireless network with Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, or make a wired connection with the integrated 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port. Resource-demanding peripherals such as storage drives can be connected to the USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 2x2 ports to quickly transfer data with enhanced speeds. USB 2.0 ports are also available for lower-powered devices such as mice and keyboards. Wireless peripherals such as headphones and controllers can be connected thanks to integrated Bluetooth 5.3 technology. This motherboard is compatible with both Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-Bit).

Enhanced Power Design

MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK WIFI DDR4 motherboard is designed for gamers and enthusiasts, with a 12+1+1 dual rail power system and 8+8 pin power connectors to support the Core Boost technology, which boosts the performance of your multi-core Intel processor. Overclock your CPU with ease thanks to MSI Game Boost technology, which allows for 1-second rapid overclocking. The Digital Power Design, Overvoltage Protection, Load-Line Calibration, Double Power Connectors, and Supplemental PCIe Power Connectors on the motherboard all work together to provide proper electrical management through your system to stabilize your system, especially under high loads.

Premium Thermal Solution

The MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK WIFI DDR4 Motherboard features Extended Heatsink Design and M.2 Shield Frozr and is designed for high-performance systems and continuous operation. This motherboard's increased cooling capabilities will keep your components working at optimal temperatures. M.2 Shield Frozr, Fully Fan Control, Frozr AI Cooling, and System Cooling all work together to keep your components cool even while under high loads when gaming or generating content.

High-Quality PCB for Enhanced Protection

The MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK WIFI DDR4 13th Gen Motherboard features a PCB optimized for higher bandwidth and faster transfer speeds, as well as reliable circuit transmission with 2oz thickened copper that allows the motherboard to easily withstand overclocking while improving heat dissipation and system reliability. The MSI PCI Express Steel Armor slot is soldered to the motherboard to handle the weight of large graphics cards and avoid GPU droop, which can damage PCIe slots. The grounding layer around the mounting holes is doubled for double ESD protection, preventing static discharge spikes from damaging the motherboard.

7.1-Channel USB High-Performance Audio

The 14th Gen Motherboard includes the Realtek ALC897 Codec as well as 7.1-Channel USB High-Performance Audio. Immerse yourself in your favorite media with Audio Boost technology, which includes high-quality audio capacitors, 3.5mm audio connectors with S/SPDIF, and a dedicated high-definition audio processor. The printed circuit board isolates audio layers for clear left and right channels, as well as isolating audio circuits to reduce crossover talk and electrical interference. To protect your ears, de-pop protection eliminates the popping sound caused by plugging or unplugging audio devices.

Lightning Fast Connectivity

Connect to your network wirelessly using Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, which provides faster wireless rates and efficiency, making it ideal for uploading and downloading large files. This motherboard also has a 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet connection for wired networking. MSI's LAN Manager software prioritizes your connection, eliminating lag and maintaining a pleasant online experience.

MSI MAG B850 TOMAHAWK WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard

The MSI MAG B850 TOMAHAWK WIFI Motherboard is engineered for gamers, creators, and PC enthusiasts who demand cutting-edge performance, stability, and connectivity. Built on the AMD B650 chipset with an AM5 socket, it supports the latest AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, making it a future-ready foundation for high-performance builds.

CPU and Memory Performance

The MSI MAG B850 motherboard supports AMD Ryzen processors with up to 256GB DDR5 memory across 4 DIMM slots. With overclocking speeds reaching 8200+ MT/s depending on configuration, this MSI AMD motherboard ensures smooth multitasking, faster load times, and optimized gaming performance. It’s designed to handle heavy workloads and advanced applications with ease.

Expansion and Storage

Equipped with 2 PCI-E x16 slots and 1 PCI-E x1 slot, the MSI 850 motherboard supports PCIe 5.0 for next-gen GPUs and expansion cards. Storage options include 3 M.2 slots and 4 SATA 6Gb/s ports, with PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD support. RAID 0 and RAID 1 are available for M.2 NVMe drives, providing flexibility for speed and redundancy.

Networking and Connectivity

The MSI MAG B850 TOMAHAWK WIFI Motherboard features Realtek 8126VB 5G LAN and Wi-Fi 7 support, delivering ultra-fast wired and wireless networking. Wi-Fi 7 includes MU-MIMO, 2.4GHz/5GHz/6GHz bands, and speeds up to 2.9Gbps, ensuring low-latency gaming and smooth streaming. Bluetooth 5.4 adds modern wireless connectivity for peripherals.

Audio and Multimedia

With the Realtek ALC4080 codec, the MSI MAG B850 motherboard delivers 7.1-channel high-performance audio with support for up to 32-bit/384kHz playback. S/PDIF output and premium audio components ensure immersive sound quality for gaming, movies, and music.

Ports and I/O

The MSI WiFi Motherboard offers extensive connectivity including HDMI 2.1 with support for 8K 60Hz resolution (depending on CPU graphics), multiple USB ports such as USB 20Gbps Type-C, USB 10Gbps Type-A and Type-C, USB 5Gbps, and USB 2.0. This ensures compatibility with modern peripherals and high-speed data transfer.

Cooling and Build Quality

With multiple fan headers, pump support, and RGB connectors, the MSI MAG B850 TOMAHAWK WIFI Motherboard is optimized for cooling and customization. Its robust ATX design ensures durability, while MSI’s signature build quality provides stability for long-term use.

products.description:
MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI AM5 mATX Motherboard

The MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI is a powerful MSI motherboard based on the advanced AMD B850 chipset, designed specifically for customers who want to take advantage of the power of AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors with the AM5 socket. The MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI Motherboard supports up to 256GB of DDR5 memory over four dual-latch DIMM slots and offers excellent memory speeds of up to 8200+ MT/s (OC) depending on CPU and setup. It supports AMD EXPO, dual-channel architecture, JEDEC and AMD POR speeds, non-ECC UDIMMs, and CUDIMM clock driver bypass mode, providing maximum compatibility and overclocking freedom. Designed for enthusiasts, the MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI features a robust 12+2+1 Duet Rail Power System, dual 8-pin CPU power connectors, Core Boost, and Memory Boost technologies—reinforced by an 8-layer 2oz thickened copper PCB to enhance power delivery, signal integrity, and thermal performance. Expansion and high-speed storage capabilities on the MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI mATX Motherboard include one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot, one PCIe 4.0 x4 slot, and three M.2 slots—two of which support PCIe 5.0 x4 (when using Ryzen 9000/7000 CPUs) and one PCIe 4.0 x2 via the chipset, in addition to four SATA 6Gbps ports. RAID functionality supports RAID 0/1/10 for SATA and RAID 0/1/5 for M.2 NVMe drives, with RAID 5 available exclusively for Ryzen 9000 processors. Thermally, the MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI AM5 mATX Motherboard incorporates MSI’s Frozr Guard thermal design, which includes extended heatsinks, high-performance thermal pads (7W/mK), choke cooling, and EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II for optimal M.2 SSD performance and installation ease. Connectivity is next-gen with onboard Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, and Realtek 8126-VB 5G LAN, delivering blazing-fast network speeds for gaming, streaming, and professional workloads. The MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI Motherboard also features extensive USB connectivity: four USB 2.0 front ports, two USB 5Gbps Type-A front, four USB 5Gbps Type-A rear, three USB 10Gbps Type-A rear, a 10Gbps Type-C port on both front and rear panels, and a blazing-fast 20Gbps USB Type-C port on the rear I/O. For integrated graphics users, an HDMI 2.1 FRL port supports up to 8K resolution at 60Hz, depending on the installed APU. Audio is powered by the Realtek ALC4080 Codec, supporting 7.1-channel HD audio, 32-bit/384kHz playback, and S/PDIF output, enhanced by Audio Boost 5 for a studio-grade sound experience. The board has a number of internal connections and headers for fans, RGB lighting (3x JARGB_V2, 1x JRGB), front panel I/O, TPM 2.0, and more. MSI's EZ DIY features, including EZ PCIe Release, EZ M.2 Clip II, and EZ Antenna, make constructing and upgrading easier than ever. Troubleshooting is made easier with EZ Debug LEDs and an EZ Memory Detection LED. The MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI mATX Motherboard, with its 243.84mm x 243.84mm mATX form size, combines high-end performance, overclocking headroom, cutting-edge connectivity, and user-friendly features, making it one of the most powerful and future-ready MSI motherboards in the AM5 family.

products.description:
MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard

The MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard is a powerful, ready for the future platform designed specifically for gamers and power users that want unparalleled stability, thermal performance, and cutting-edge connectivity. This MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI Motherboard is based on the sophisticated AMD X870E chipset and is compatible with the newest AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors, as well as the sturdy AM5 socket. It supports up to 256GB of DDR5 UDIMM across four DIMM slots, giving speeds ranging from DDR5 4800 MT/s JEDEC to an overclocked DDR5 8400+ MT/s, and has AMD EXPO profiles, dual-channel mode, and CUDIMM compatibility. Optimized memory routing on an 8-layer PCB made with 2oz thickened copper ensures signal integrity and consistent performance, while double-latch DIMM slots boost installation reliability. This MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI motherboard features triple PCIe x16 slots, with the primary slot offering full PCIe 5.0 x16 bandwidth, perfect for next-gen GPUs, while other slots support PCIe 4.0 and 3.0, enabling wide expansion options. For storage, the MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI ATX Motherboard includes four ultra-fast M.2 slots—two PCIe 5.0 x4 CPU sourced and two PCIe 4.0 x4 chipset sourced—supporting RAID 0/1/5/10 configurations depending on CPU, plus four SATA 6Gb/s ports for traditional drives. High-speed networking is delivered via a Realtek 8126 5G LAN and Wi-Fi 7 module, which includes Bluetooth 5.4, MLO, and up to 5.8Gbps wireless throughput. Rear I/O connectivity is extensive, including USB 40Gbps Type-C, USB 20Gbps Type-C, and multiple USB 10Gbps and 5Gbps ports, alongside USB4 with DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.1, supporting up to 8K at 60Hz resolution with compatible processors. Audio is powered by Realtek ALC4080, offering 7.1-channel high-resolution output with Audio Boost 5, ensuring a rich and immersive sound experience. With a 14+2+1 Duet Rail Power System, dual 8-pin CPU connectors, and additional PCIe power input, the MSI Motherboard ensures stable power delivery even under heavy loads. Advanced thermal features like Frozr Guard, thermal pads, extended heatsinks, and EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II guarantee optimal cooling. Designed with user convenience in mind, it includes EZ Debug LEDs, EZ M.2 Clip II, and EZ PCIe Release for simplified DIY building. With TPM 2.0 support, ARGB headers, and full compatibility with modern gaming and productivity setups, the MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard stands out as a top-tier choice for next-gen PC builds.

Performance aficionados will love the MSI MEG X870E GODLIKE Motherboard's remarkable overclocking capabilities. Two Type-C DisplayPort USB4 connections with a maximum resolution of 4K@60Hz and support for DisplayPort 1.4 with HBR3 over USB Type-C are part of the onboard graphics. With two PCI-E x16 slots and one PCI-E x4 slot, the MSI DDR5 Motherboard expands seamlessly and supports PCIe 5.0 and 4.0, enabling a flexible configuration with Ryzen 9000, 8000, or 7000 Series processors. With the Realtek ALC4082 Codec and ESS9219Q Combo DAC/HPA, the MSI MEG X870E Godlike AM5 E-ATX Motherboard offers 7.1-Channel USB high-performance audio, S/PDIF output, and 32-Bit/384 kHz playback on the front panel. With four SATA 6G connections and seven M.2 slots, this device offers a wide range of storage options and supports PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 for fast data transfer. RAID configurations are also supported by the MSI MEG X870E GODLIKE Motherboard, guaranteeing data redundancy and performance enhancement. Multiple USB connections, including USB 2.0, 5Gbps, 10Gbps, 20Gbps, and 40Gbps Type-C choices, provide excellent connectivity. Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4 compatibility, combined with a 10Gbps Marvell AQC113CS LAN and a 5Gbps Realtek 8126 LAN, provide this AM5 motherboard with state-of-the-art wireless capabilities. To meet demanding cooling and customization requirements, internal IO comprises RGB LED connectors, fan headers, and several power connectors. Advanced LED features like the EZ Digit Debug LED and Dynamic Dashboard III are included on the motherboard. The best option for building a powerful, feature-rich PC is the MSI MEG X870E GODLIKE AM5 E-ATX Motherboard, which is made for Windows 11 64-bit.

The MSI MEG Z890 GODLIKE LGA 1851 E-ATX Motherboard is a cutting-edge powerhouse designed for tremendous performance and unparalleled dependability, making it the ideal choice for high-end PC setups. This motherboard, based on the powerful Intel Z890 chipset, supports the latest Intel Core Ultra Series 2 processors via its LGA 1851 socket, offering smooth compatibility and peak processing capacity. Storage possibilities are unequaled, with eight M.2 slots (including PCIe Gen 5 x4 and Gen 4 x4) and four SATA 6G connectors to meet a wide range of storage requirements. Additional features include dual PCIe 5.0 slots for high-performance GPUs, powerful networking (10Gbps and 5Gbps LAN), and Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. The Realtek ALC4082 Codec and ESS9219Q DAC deliver exceptional audio performance, while several USB ports, including USB-C 20Gbps, enable unparalleled connection. MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard

The MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard is a high-performance motherboard that supports Intel Core Ultra CPUs (Series 2) and features an Intel Z890 chipset. As one of the most powerful MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X ATX Motherboards, it supports DDR5 memory with a maximum capacity of 128GB and boasts memory speeds ranging from 9600 MT/s (OC) to 6400 MT/s (JEDEC). The MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X Motherboard features dual-channel, non-ECC, unbuffered memory and supports Intel XMP 3.0 and memory overclocking. This MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X motherboard has several PCIe slots, including three PCIe x16 slots (Gen 5.0 and Gen 4.0), one PCIe x1, and six M.2 slots that enable PCIe 5.0 x4 for lightning-fast storage choices. Furthermore, the MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X motherboard has six SATA 6G ports, providing enough storage space. It has two Type-C DisplayPort with Thunderbolt 4 connectors, which allow 8K monitors and high-resolution output at up to 120Hz. The connectivity choices are extensive, with two Thunderbolt 4 connections capable of transferring data at up to 40Gbps and various USB interfaces, including 10Gbps Type-A and Type-C. The MSI Motherboard also has an Intel Killer E5000B 5G LAN and a pre-installed Intel Killer BE1750x Wi-Fi 7 module, which can offer rates of up to 5.8 Gbps. The Realtek ALC4080 Codec supports 7.1-channel USB High-Performance Audio at 32-bit/384 kHz. With RAID support for both SATA and M.2 NVMe devices, this motherboard is ideal for high-end gaming, multimedia production, and professional applications. The MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X Motherboard is compatible with Windows 11 64-bit, making it an excellent choice for power users.

products.description:
MSI MPG B650 CARBON WIFI DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard

The MSI MPG B650 CARBON WIFI Motherboard supports AMD's Ryzen 8000 & 7000-series processors with up to 16 Zen 4 cores as well as dual-channel DDR5 memory, with a Maximum Memory Capacity of up to 128GB and a bus speed of up to 6600+(OC) MHz. It features a Core Boost technology that combines MSI's premium layout and optimized power design which allows for faster and undistorted current delivery to the CPU at pin-point precision. Not only supports multi-core CPUs, but also creates the perfect conditions for your CPU overclocking. It has an extended Heatsink, MOSFET thermal pads rated for 7W/mK, additional choke thermal pads and a Double-sided M.2 Shield Frozr built for a high-performance system and a non-stop gaming experience. The motherboard is made of a 6-layer PCB made of 2oz thickened copper and server-grade level material. It can deliver a lightning-fast game experience with PCIe 4.0 slots, Lightning Gen 4 x4 M.2 with M.2 Shield Frozr design keeps M.2 SSDs safe while preventing throttling, making them run faster. The rear I/O panel now offers easy ways of directly entering the safe boot, a one-click toggle for all RGB lights, and directly activating Turbo mode. The MSI MPG B650 CARBON WIFI offers Built-in USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 port, offers 20Gbps transmission speed, 4X faster than USB 3.2 Gen 1. It comes with an upgraded network solution for professional and multimedia use. Delivers a secure, stable and fast network connection. The MAG B650 series motherboards offer a wide variety of options to connect and boost your USB devices, offering never before seen USB speeds up to 20Gb/s when connecting the Rear USB Type-C. The MSI MPG B650 CARBON WIFI comes with 3 years of warranty.

The MSI MPG X670E CARBON WIFI Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 8000 & 7000 Series Desktop Processors. The latest MSI MPG X670E CARBON WIFI supports DDR5 Memory, Maximum Memory Capacity of up to 128GB. It features an 18+2+1 Duet Rail Power System, Dual 8-pin CPU power connectors, Core Boost, and Memory Boost. It has an extended Heatsink with a Direct Touched Heat-pipe, MOSFET thermal pads rated for 7W/mK, additional choke thermal pads, and a Double-sided M.2 Shield Frozr are built for a high-performance system and non-stop gaming experience. The motherboard is made of an 8-layer PCB made of 2oz thickened copper and server-grade level material. The MSI MPG X670E CARBON WIFI offer PCIe Gen 5 transfers from both the primary GPU slot and the primary M.2 slot and DisplayPort 2.0-out from the rear USB Type-C. It also supports ARGB Gen2 for connecting various RGB lighting peripherals. The rear I/O panel now offers easy ways of directly entering the safe boot, a one-click toggle for all RGB lights, and directly activating Turbo mode. The MSI MPG X670E CARBON WIFI Motherboard offers 2x PCIe Gen 5 x16 slots and 4x M.2 slots. There's an 18+2 90A VRM power phase system, which is cooled by an extended heatsink. The MEG series offers a stacked fin array heatsink and a heatpipe along with a MOSFET baseplate for effective heat dissipation from the VRMs. Four onboard M.2 slots are available including one PCIe Gen 5 slot. MSI additionally offers an M.2 Xpander-Z add-on card in the box that provides for two additional PCIe Gen 5 x4 M.2 slots. The MSI MPG X670E CARBON WIFI comes with 3 years of warranty.

The MSI PRO A620M-B AM5 mATX Motherboard is a high-performance, compact solution intended for contemporary AMD systems, making it an excellent choice for customers looking to build using cutting-edge technology. Powered by the AMD A620 chipset, the MSI PRO A620M-B Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors via the sophisticated AM5 socket, providing long-term compatibility and cutting-edge performance. The MSI PRO A620M-B has two DDR5 memory slots and can handle up to 128GB of non-ECC, unbuffered dual-channel DDR5 RAM at overclocked speeds of up to 6800+ MHz (1DPC 1R) and 6000+ MHz (1DPC 2R), as well as complete support for AMD EXPO memory profiles. Onboard graphics capability includes an HDMI 2.1 connector with 4K at 60Hz output and a legacy VGA port, which are both accessible on CPUs with integrated graphics, increasing adaptability for various display configurations. The MSI PRO A620M-B AM5 mATX Motherboard has a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot that converts to x16, x8, or x4 depending on the CPU used, as well as an extra PCIe 3.0 x1 slot. Networking is driven by the Realtek RTL8125BG 2.5G LAN, providing ultra-fast wired connections, while the integrated Realtek ALC897 audio codec delivers 7.1-channel high-definition sound for immersive multimedia experiences. Connectivity on the rear I/O includes USB 3.2 Gen 1 5Gbps Type-A ports, USB 2.0, HDMI, VGA, audio jacks, LAN, and PS/2 keyboard and mouse support, while internal headers provide power connections, fan headers, USB ports, audio, TPM 2.0 support, addressable RGB (JARGB_V2) and RGB (JRGB) headers for lighting, and EZ Debug LEDs for simplified troubleshooting. The MSI PRO A620M-B measures 215mm by 243.84mm and fits inside micro-ATX cases, making it ideal for small yet powerful desktop configurations. The MSI Motherboard is compatible with Windows 11 and Windows 10 64-bit, providing a future-ready platform for gamers, artists, and professionals. Whether you call it the MSI PRO A620M-B, MSI PRO A620M-B Motherboard, or simply the MSI Motherboard, this board is a solid basis for any high-performance AMD system.

MSI PRO B760-P WIFI DDR4 ATX Motherboard

MSI PRO B760-P WIFI DDR4 Motherboard supports 14th/13th/ 12th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors for LGA 1700 sockets. It comes with four dual-channel RAM slots, and two M.2 slots allowing you to take advantage of the full power of 13th & 12th generation Intel processors. The four SATA III ports allow users to create large storage drive arrays for large file libraries. Two PCIe x16 and one PCIe x1 slot allow you to install high-end graphics cards and other expansion cards. Connect to a wireless network with Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, or make a wired connection with the integrated 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port. Resource-demanding peripherals such as storage drives can be connected to the USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 2x2 ports to quickly transfer data with enhanced speeds. USB 2.0 ports are also available for lower-powered devices such as mice and keyboards. Wireless peripherals such as headphones and controllers can be connected thanks to integrated Bluetooth 5.3 technology. This motherboard is compatible with both Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit).

Enhanced Power Design

products.description:
MSI PRO B760M-P DDR5 mATX Motherboard

The MSI PRO B760M-P Motherboard supports 14th/13th/ 12th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors for LGA 1700 socket. It comes with four dual-channel RAM slots, and two M.2 slots allowing you to take advantage of the full power of 14th 13th & 12th generation Intel processors. The four SATA III ports allow users to create large storage drive arrays for large file libraries. Two PCIe x16 and one PCIe x1 slot allow you to install high-end graphics cards and other expansion cards. Connect to a wireless network with Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, or make a wired connection with the integrated 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port. Resource-demanding peripherals such as storage drives can be connected to the USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 2x2 ports to quickly transfer data with enhanced speeds. USB 2.0 ports are also available for lower-powered devices such as mice and keyboards. Wireless peripherals such as headphones and controllers can be connected thanks to integrated Bluetooth 5.3 technology. This motherboard is compatible with both Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-Bit).

Enhanced Power Design

The MSI PRO B760M-P motherboard is designed for gamers and enthusiasts, with a 12+1 Duet Rail Power System with P-PAK, 8-pin + 4-pin CPU power connectors, Core Boost, Memory Boost technology, which boosts the performance of your multi-core Intel processor. Overclock your CPU with ease thanks to MSI Game Boost technology, which allows for 1-second rapid overclocking. MSI PRO B840M-P WIFI6E AM5 mATX Motherboard

The MSI PRO B840M-P WIFI6E motherboard is intended for modern PC builders who require performance, stability, and flexibility in a single compact micro-ATX board. It is based on the AMD B840 chipset and supports the latest AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series desktop CPUs with socket AM5, making it a future-ready option for both gaming and professional applications. Memory performance is a notable highlight, as it supports up to 256GB of DDR5 across four UDIMM slots with dual-channel design. The MSI PRO B840M-P WIFI6E Motherboard can reach overclocked rates of 8000+ MT/s depending on the CPU and configuration. Support for AMD EXPO makes RAM overclocking easier and more stable. The board's design prioritizes durability and thermal performance, with features such as a 7+2+1 power phase system, expanded heatsinks, and MOSFET thermal pads rated at 7W/mK, which ensure consistent cooling for high-performance applications. The MSI PRO B840M-P WIFI6E Motherboard boasts equally amazing storage with two M.2 slots that enable PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe SSDs and four SATA 6Gb/s connections, as well as RAID setups for both SATA and M.2 devices. A PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for graphics cards and a PCIe 3.0 x1 slot for additional peripherals are among the expansion choices. It has a Realtek 8125D 2.5G LAN and built-in Wi-Fi 6E with Bluetooth 5.3, ensuring high-speed, robust networking in gaming and professional environments. Onboard graphics are supported via HDMI 2.1 at 4K @ 60Hz, depending on the CPU. The MSI PRO B840M-P WIFI6E Motherboard's audio system is driven by the Realtek ALC897, which provides 7.1-channel high-definition audio for immersive entertainment. USB connectivity is diverse, with USB 2.0, USB 3.2 Gen1 5Gbps, and speedier 10Gbps Type-A and Type-C connectors on both the back and front panels. Additional features such as the EZ M.2 Clip, EZ PCIe Clip, and EZ Debug LEDs facilitate construction and debugging. The MSI PRO B840M-P WIFI6E, which supports Windows 11 64-bit, RGB headers, and durable thermal solutions, provides a balanced combination of performance, durability, and user-friendly design for a powerful desktop setup.

This motherboard, built for stability, performance, and future-ready connectivity. With the AMD B850 chipset, this MSI motherboard delivers high-speed performance with features packed into an efficient micro-ATX form factor (243.84mm x 243.84mm).For superior memory support, the PRO B850M-A WIFI features 4x DDR5 UDIMM slots that can handle up to 256GB of high-speed RAM. It supports DDR5 speeds from 4800 MT/s (JEDEC) up to an impressive 8200+ MT/s (OC), with full compatibility for AMD EXPO technology, dual-channel architecture, and clock driver bypass mode. Whether you're overclocking for speed or running stable stock settings, this MSI PRO B850M-A WIFI ensures smooth and responsive performance.In terms of graphics and display capabilities, this is equipped with 1x HDMI 2.1 and 1x DisplayPort 1.4, both supporting up to 4K resolution at 60Hz — ideal for users running APUs with integrated graphics. Expansion is handled via 3 PCIe slots, including PCIe 5.0 x16 for GPUs (Ryzen 9000/7000), PCIe 4.0 x4, and PCIe 3.0 x1, ensuring flexible upgrade paths for graphics cards and other PCIe devices.For ultra-fast storage, the MSI PRO B850M-A WIFI Motherboard includes 2x M.2 slots with advanced PCIe lanes. The M2_1 slot supports PCIe 5.0 x4 with Ryzen 9000/7000 and PCIe 4.0 x4 with Ryzen 8000, while the M2_2 slot supports PCIe 4.0 x4 or x2, depending on CPU model. Also, 4x SATA 6Gb/s ports provide support for traditional SSDs or HDDs with RAID 0, 1, and 10 configurations. NVMe drives in M.2 slots also support RAID 0 and 1, enhancing storage flexibility and speed.On the networking front, the MSI B850M-A WIFI features Realtek 8126VB 5G LAN for ultra-fast wired internet and a built-in Wi-Fi 7 module, supporting dual-band (2.4GHz/5GHz/6GHz), MU-MIMO, and Bluetooth 5.4 — perfect for lag-free online gaming, wireless peripherals, and seamless streaming. Future-proof wireless support is ensured with Windows 11 24H2 readiness for full Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4 functionality.For audio, the PRO B850M-A WIFI Motherboard integrates Realtek ALC897 7.1-channel high-definition audio, delivering rich, immersive sound for gamers and media users. Internal headers and connectors include multiple USB options (including USB 10Gbps Type-C and Type-A), addressable RGB headers, TPM 2.0 support, and EZ Debug LEDs for quick troubleshooting.With robust build quality, modern connectivity, and high-speed memory and storage support, the MSI PRO B850M-A WIFI AM5 motherboard is an exceptional choice for users looking to build a reliable and performance-driven PC using the latest AMD technologies.

The MSI PRO B850M-G Motherboard is a powerful, feature-rich board that is ideal for professionals, gamers, and PC builders looking for great performance and dependability. The MSI PRO B850M-G AM5 Motherboard, based on the AMD B850 chipset, supports the latest AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors on the AM5 socket, ensuring top-tier compatibility and future-proof performance. This MSI PRO B850M-G AM5 ATX Motherboard (mATX form factor, 226 x 243.84mm) delivers excellent power efficiency and expansion potential in a compact size. The motherboard also includes Realtek 8126VB 5G LAN for lightning-fast internet speeds and a wide array of USB options, including USB 10Gbps Type-C, USB 5Gbps Type-A, and USB 2.0 ports for enhanced connectivity. Expansion capabilities are powered by two PCIe x16 slots, where the primary slot supports PCIe 5.0 x16 for advanced GPUs, ensuring maximum gaming and rendering performance. Audio quality is powered by the Realtek ALC897 7.1-Channel HD Audio Codec, delivering immersive, studio-grade sound. Other standout features include EZ Debug LEDs, EZ Memory Detection LED, Flash BIOS Button, and multiple ARGB V2 and RGB headers for easy setup, troubleshooting, and aesthetic customization. With its premium build, high-speed performance, and future-ready AM5 platform, the MSI PRO B850M-G AM5 Motherboard stands as a reliable, compact, and powerful choice for modern PC builds.

products.description:
MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI AM5 mATX Motherboard

The MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI is a next-generation micro-ATX motherboard engineered for users who demand uncompromising performance, future-ready connectivity, and efficient thermal management in a compact form factor. Designed to support AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors on the AM5 socket, it unlocks the full potential of DDR5 memory with speeds reaching up to 8200+ MT/s (OC), ensuring ultra-fast responsiveness for gaming, productivity, and creative workloads. The board’s advanced 7+2+1 direct power phase system, reinforced by Core Boost and Memory Boost technologies, delivers stable and efficient power delivery across all cores—even under intense multitasking or overclocking conditions.Built with a 6-layer PCB using 2oz thickened copper and server-grade materials, the PRO B850M-P WIFI offers enhanced durability, signal integrity, and heat resistance. MSI’s Frozr Guard thermal architecture includes extended heatsinks, high-performance MOSFET pads rated at 7W/mK, and additional choke pads to maintain optimal temperatures during heavy loads. The EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II and tool-less installation clips simplify DIY builds, while the chipset heatsink minimizes dust and noise for long-term reliability.Connectivity is a standout feature, with integrated Wi-Fi 7 and Realtek 8126VB 5G LAN delivering ultra-fast, low-latency networking for streaming, gaming, and professional use. The MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI supports PCIe 5.0 graphics and Gen 5 x4 M.2 SSDs, enabling lightning-fast data transfer and next-gen GPU compatibility. Storage flexibility includes three M.2 slots and four SATA 6G ports, with support for RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 configurations depending on CPU series. Audio Boost technology powered by Realtek ALC897 ensures immersive, studio-grade sound for gaming and media consumption.The rear I/O panel is packed with high-speed USB 10Gbps Type-A and Type-C ports, HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 for 4K 60Hz output, and dedicated buttons for Flash BIOS and Clear CMOS. Internal headers support RGB and ARGB lighting, multiple fan configurations, TPM 2.0, and front panel USB connectivity, making it ideal for custom builds and future upgrades. With full support for Windows 11 64-bit and compatibility across a wide range of Ryzen processors, the MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI AMD DDR5 AM5 mATX Motherboard is a versatile, high-performance foundation for users building compact yet powerful systems.

products.name: MSI PRO X870E-P WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard
products.description:
MSI PRO X870E-P WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard

The MSI PRO X870E-P WIFI AM5 ATX motherboard is a high-performance option that supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors using the AM5 socket. With four DDR5 UDIMM slots, it supports up to 256 GB of memory at rates ranging from DDR5 8200 to 4800 MT/s, as well as AMD EXPO, JEDEC, and memory overclocking capabilities. The MSI PRO X870E-P WIFI motherboard supports dual-channel operation, non-ECC unbuffered RAM, and clock driver bypass mode for advanced tweaking. Onboard graphics include HDMI 2.1 and USB4 Type-C DisplayPort 1.4 outputs, both of which offer 4K resolution at 60 Hz. The MSI AM5 motherboard has four PCIe slots, including PCI\_E1, which provides Gen 5.0 x16 capability for Ryzen 9000 and 7000 series processors. The Realtek ALC897 codec powers the audio, allowing for high-definition sound in 7.1 channels. Storage compatibility includes three M.2 slots with PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 interfaces, as well as four SATA 6G connections. The MSI PRO X870E-P WIFI motherboard has M.2\_1 operating at PCIe 5.0 x4 for Ryzen 9000 and 7000 series, and the board supports RAID 0, 1, and 10 for SATA, and RAID 0, 1, and 5 for NVMe on Ryzen 9000 CPUs. Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, and a Realtek 8126VB 5G LAN enable high-speed networking. USB compatibility is extensive, with USB 2.0, 5Gbps, 10Gbps, 20Gbps, and a USB4 40Gbps Type-C port. The MSI PRO X870E-P WIFI AM5 ATX motherboard also features internal headers for CPU and system fan connectors, RGB and ARGB headers, TPM 2.0, a tuning controller connector, and EZ Debug and Memory Detection LEDs. This ATX motherboard is 243.84 mm by 304.8 mm and runs Windows 11 64-bit, making it suitable for high-end gaming and workstation setups that require cutting-edge connection, performance, and future-proof features.

MSI PRO Z790-A MAX WIFI DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The MSI PRO Z790-A MAX WIFI DDR5 ATX Motherboard is a high-performance motherboard designed to meet current computer and gaming demands. It is designed to handle Intel Core 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation CPUs, as well as Intel Pentium Gold and Celeron processors, and it makes use of the LGA 1700 socket for broad processor compatibility. Its compatibility for DDR5 memory, which operates at Dual Channel DDR5 speeds of 7800+MHz (when overclocked), ensures fast data access and better multitasking. The motherboard delivers superior power delivery and efficiency because of its 16+1+1 digital power system, 80A smart power stages, twin 8-pin CPU power connections, Core Boost, and Memory Boost technologies. It also excels in thermal management with an extended heatsink, MOSFET thermal pads, choke thermal pads, and M.2 Shield Frozr, all contributing to sustained high performance during extended gaming sessions. Durability and dependability are ensured by a high-quality 6-layer PCB composed of 2oz thicker copper and server-grade components. PCIe 5.0 slots, Lightning Gen 4 x4 M.2, and USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 connectors provide lightning-fast connection. Intel Turbo USB 3.2 Gen 2 provides robust and fast USB communication. The 2.5G LAN with Wi-Fi 7 Solution provides professional and multimedia users with enhanced networking capabilities, enabling safe, stable, and fast network connections. Finally, AUDIO BOOST 5 pampers your ears with studio-grade sound quality, giving an immersive gaming experience with remarkable audio clarity and fidelity. The MSI PRO Z790-A MAX WIFI DDR5 ATX Motherboard is an excellent choice for gamers and content makers seeking top-tier performance and connection on a single board.

products.name: MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI DDR4 ATX Motherboard
products.description:
MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI DDR4 ATX Motherboard

The MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI DDR4 ATX Motherboard supports LGA 1700 CPUs from the 12th/13th generation Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron families. This ATX motherboard, which uses the Intel Z790 chipset and the LGA 1700 socket, has four DDR4 RAM slots that allow twin-channel memory and speeds up to 5333 MHz when overclocked. Six SATA III connections and four M.2 interfaces give abundant storage space and enable RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 through SATA or 0, 1, and 5 via M.2. GPUs and other adaptor cards may be installed through PCIe 5.0 x16, PCIe 4.0 x16, PCIe 3.0 x16, and PCIe 3.0 x1 slots. Benefit from speedy networking with a 2.5 GbE Intel LAN and Wi-Fi 6E; quickly connect to wireless peripherals with Bluetooth 5.2. The Realtek ALC4080 audio codec offers 7.1 channel surround sound, and the rear ports can be used for analog or digital output. Connect connected peripherals through two USB 2.0, two USB 3.2 Gen 1, and three USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-A ports, or a USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C port. DisplayPort and HDMI are used to output video. A Flash BIOS button is also located on the rear I/O panel, and internal headers support front-panel USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C and USB 3.2 Gen 1 and 2.0 Type-A ports, RGB connections, chassis intrusion, a TPM module, and other features. The MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI DDR4 13th Gen ATX Motherboard comes with a 03-year warranty.

MSI PRO Z890-P WIFI6E LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard

The MSI PRO Z890-P WIFI6E LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard for Intel Core Ultra Series 2 processors through the LGA 1851 socket. This motherboard supports four DDR5 UDIMM slots with a maximum capacity of 256GB and overclocking speeds up to 9200+ MT/s.

The MSI PRO Z890-P WIFI6E ATX Motherboard includes three PCIe x16 slots and one PCIe x1 slot, with PCI_E1 running PCIe 5.0 x16 directly from the CPU. Four M.2 slots support PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 NVMe drives, with the fourth slot also supporting SATA mode for added flexibility. The MSI LGA 1851 Motherboard provides four SATA 6G ports with RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 support for both SATA and M.2 NVMe storage devices.

This comprehensive RAID support gives users flexible options for data redundancy and performance configurations. The MSI PRO Z890-P WIFI6E Motherboard features Realtek ALC897 7.1-channel high-definition audio for immersive sound during gaming and media playback. Onboard graphics output includes one HDMI 2.1 port and one DisplayPort 1.4, both supporting 4K at 60Hz.

The MSI LGA 1851 Motherboard offers extensive USB connectivity, including USB 10Gbps Type-A, USB 10Gbps Type-C, and USB 20Gbps Type-C ports. Realtek 8126 5Gbps LAN delivers fast wired networking for demanding online gaming and large file transfers. The MSI ATX Motherboard includes built-in Wi-Fi 6E supporting 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands up to 2.4Gbps, alongside Bluetooth 5.3.

MSI PRO Z890-P WIFI6E Motherboard has three Addressable V2 RGB headers and one standard RGB header support extensive lighting customization options. The MSI DDR5 Motherboard provides five system fan headers, a CPU fan header, and a combo pump and system fan header for comprehensive cooling control. Four EZ Debug LEDs simplify troubleshooting during system builds and upgrades. A TPM 2.0 header adds hardware-level security support for Windows 11 systems. The MSI Motherboard measures 243.84mm by 304.8mm in standard ATX form factor, fits most ATX cases.

The MSI PRO Z890-S WIFI6E LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard supports Intel Core Ultra Series 2 processors through the Intel Z890 socket. This Motherboard includes four DDR5 slots supporting 256GB memory, DDR5 8800 overclocking, Intel XMP 3.0, and dual-channel architecture for stable gaming performance. MSI DDR5 Motherboard technology supports non-ECC unbuffered memory, CUDIMM modules, Intel POR speeds, and optimized overclocking performance for professional multitasking environments and content creation workloads.

MSI PRO Z890-S WIFI6E LGA 1851 Motherboard provides HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 outputs supporting smooth 4K 60Hz visuals with compatible processors for multimedia entertainment. MSI ATX Motherboard expansion includes PCIe 5.0 x16 connectivity, PCIe 4.0 slots, and flexible bandwidth options supporting advanced graphics cards and peripherals for enthusiasts everywhere. MSI PRO Z890-S WIFI6E ATX Motherboard features Realtek ALC897 7.1-channel audio, delivering immersive sound quality for gaming, streaming, productivity, and entertainment experiences during everyday usage.

MSI Motherboard storage options include three M.2 slots, PCIe 5.0 NVMe support, SATA compatibility, RAID functionality, and four reliable SATA 6G ports for flexible storage. MSI PRO Z890-S WIFI6E Motherboard offers extensive connectivity through USB 20Gbps Type-C ports, multiple USB 5Gbps connections, and convenient front USB headers for modern devices. MSI LGA 1851 Motherboard integrates Realtek 2.5Gbps LAN, Wi-Fi 6E technology, Bluetooth 5.3, and MU-MIMO support for dependable high-speed wireless networking across homes and offices.

MSI PRO Z890-S WIFI6E LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard includes dedicated power connectors, multiple cooling headers, RGB connectors, and TPM 2.0 compatibility for secure system management. MSI ATX Motherboard design features EZ Debug LEDs, chassis intrusion support, Windows 11 compatibility, and durable PCB construction for dependable long-term reliability under continuous workloads.

products.description:
MSI X870E GAMING PLUS WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard

The MSI X870E GAMING PLUS WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard is a powerful, feature-rich solution designed for enthusiasts, gamers, and creators using AMD's most recent desktop CPUs. This MSI motherboard, built on the powerful AMD X870E chipset, supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series CPUs on the sophisticated AM5 socket for future-proof performance and compatibility. The MSI X870E GAMING PLUS WIFI ATX Motherboard has four DDR5 UDIMM slots that can handle up to 256GB of dual-channel memory at rates of up to DDR5-8200+ MT/s using AMD EXPO and overclocking settings, which are specifically tuned for Ryzen 9000 CPUs. Memory features including CUDIMM support, Clock Driver bypass mode, and non-ECC unbuffered DIMMs provide cutting-edge performance, while double-sided latching DIMM slots increase installation reliability. The MSI X870E GAMING PLUS WIFI Motherboard delivers versatile display connectivity via HDMI 2.1 (4K at 60Hz) and a USB4 Type-C port with DisplayPort 1.4 support (4K at 120Hz) available on processors with integrated graphics, making it ideal for high-resolution, multi-display setups. With three PCIe x16 slots, including one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot directly from the CPU, the MSI X870E GAMING PLUS WIFI ensures maximum bandwidth for next-gen GPUs and expansion cards. Storage options include three M.2 slots with one PCIe 5.0 x4 slot and four SATA 6Gbps ports, enabling advanced RAID configurations: RAID 0, 1, 10 for SATA and RAID 0, 1, 5 for M.2 NVMe drives (RAID 5 exclusive to Ryzen 9000 Series). The Realtek ALC897 codec powers immersive 7.1-channel HD audio, enhancing the gaming and content creation experience. Networking is equally powerful, with Realtek 8126VB 5G LAN and a built-in Wi-Fi 7 module (802.11be, MU-MIMO, and Bluetooth 5.4), offering ultra-fast, low-latency wireless connections. The MSI X870E GAMING PLUS WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard is equipped with extensive USB connectivity, including USB4 40Gbps Type-C, USB 20Gbps Type-C, USB 10Gbps ports, and multiple USB 5Gbps and 2.0 ports, ensuring high-speed data transfer and peripheral compatibility. Engineered for performance and stability, the board features a 14+2+1 Duet Rail Power System, dual 8-pin CPU power connectors, Core Boost, Memory Boost, and an 8-layer PCB with 2oz thickened copper for enhanced thermal and electrical performance. MSI’s Frozr Guard cooling system includes an extended heatsink, 7W/mK MOSFET thermal pads, choke thermal pads, and EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II, delivering reliable thermal regulation during intense workloads. For builders, DIY-friendly features such as EZ Debug LEDs, EZ M.2 Clip II, EZ PCIe Clip II, and EZ Antenna simplify setup and troubleshooting. Whether you're building a cutting-edge gaming rig or a professional workstation, the MSI X870E GAMING PLUS WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard offers unmatched performance, connectivity, and durability, solidifying its position as one of the most advanced and versatile options in the MSI motherboard lineup.

This motherboard supports a wide range of Intel processors, including the 14th, 13th, and 12th generation Intel Core processors, as well as Intel Pentium Gold and Celeron processors, making it compatible with a variety of CPU options for the LGA 1700 socket. This motherboard is its support for DDR5 memory, with overclocking capabilities reaching up to an impressive 7200+ MHz. This means you can achieve blazing-fast memory speeds to enhance your system's overall performance. To ensure stable and efficient power delivery to the CPU, the MSI Z790 GAMING PLUS WIFI motherboard features an Enhanced Power Design. MSI Z890 GAMING WIFI6E LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard

The MSI Z890 GAMING WIFI6E LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard compitable with Intel Core Ultra Series 2 processors through the LGA 1851 socket. This motherboard supports four DDR5 UDIMM slots with a maximum capacity of 256GB and overclocking speeds up to 8800+ MT/s. The MSI Z890 GAMING WIFI6E ATX Motherboard includes four PCIe x16 slots, with the primary PCI_E1 slot running PCIe 5.0 x16 directly from the CPU.

Three M.2 slots support PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 NVMe drives, with the third slot also supporting SATA mode for storage flexibility. The MSI GAMING Motherboard provides four SATA 6G ports with RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 support for SATA devices. RAID 0, 1, and 5 support extends to M.2 NVMe storage for flexible data redundancy configurations. The MSI Z890 Motherboard features Realtek ALC897 7.1-channel high-definition audio for immersive sound during gaming and media playback.

MSI Z890 GAMING WIFI6E Motherboard has Realtek 8125D 2.5Gbps LAN delivers fast wired networking for demanding online gaming and large file transfers. The MSI ATX Motherboard includes built-in Wi-Fi 6E supporting 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands up to 2.4Gbps, alongside Bluetooth 5.3. Three Addressable V2 RGB headers and one standard RGB header support extensive lighting customization options.

The MSI DDR5 Motherboard provides four system fan headers, a CPU fan header, and a combo pump and system fan header for comprehensive cooling control. The MSI Z890 GAMING WIFI6E Motherboard has four EZ Debug LEDs simplify troubleshooting during system builds and upgrades. A TPM 2.0 header adds hardware-level security support for Windows 11 systems.
